Misconceptions about us abound. Violence is just one tool in our arsenal, not our sole means to an end. Cooperation is our usual aim, but in a world of betrayal and deception, we must make sure backstabbing us is never worth the risk. To maintain efficient cooperation, we demand an ironclad contract with consequences... and that's where necessary violence comes in play.

You're quite good with your sword, but in a world like this, fighting alone will not suffice. Picture this: a single hound may not scare you, but what about a pack? Fear creeps in as you're trapped alone, with no one to guard your back, surrounded by enemies on all fronts. They aren't leaving without blood. Strength comes in numbers... Keep that in mind.

As a leader, one must excel in the art of deception, projecting an image of unwavering composure and offering false reassurance... Every decision you make could change lives. If a day comes when you are in charge of other people, or even the entire world, what choices will you make? Will you bear the weight of their fate, or prioritize your own desires above all else?

You've done your homework on us, it seems. As mercenaries, we take on any job and always deliver... The pay is our only concern. Wherever war and chaos go, the Ghost Hounds will follow. We exist, because there is always demand for our service. How do you perceive us? Though I couldn't care less about others' opinions... I'm open to your thoughts.

Someday, I may need your aid. If my actions steer the Ghost Hounds off course, I'll count on you to right my wrongs... or put an end to my existence. For now, I am happy to enjoy our current alliance.
Search, rescue, transportation, recon, group combat... Dogs are loyal and skilled in many ways. Me? I don't keep dogs. It's too dangerous... for the dogs, that is.
Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...
Huanglong's emergency rations. They taste slightly better than those made elsewhere.
...Out in the wild, food preferences don't matter. I only care about what's edible.
Humans or Tacet Discords, I'll eradicate any danger to the Ghost Hounds. It is my sole focus to protect my people, and secure any form of momentary respite when I can.

The deaths of our kind are likely to go unnoticed. It's our destiny—fleeting, like dust in the wind. Each of us bears a dog tag with our name and story etched upon it, as a form of legacy... A symbol of our existence, no less than a declaration of it.

In the Underworld, it's all about survival of the fittest. Either you dominate as the apex predator, or you're doomed to be devoured by those above you. It's the brutal law of the land. In a world where might makes right, we must rise to the very top to remain free from others' schemes, and preserve our autonomy.

He's a capable leader. He once recommended me an ancient tome on the art of war from Huanglong, one that I regret not acquiring sooner—it could have saved me some effort. As for the deal between us... *scoff* It was merely an exchange of interests. Nothing more.

Pretentious, arrogant, and self-absorbed... That man epitomizes every trait associated with those snooty New Federation nobles. That said, I cannot deny his talent in crafting Tacetite Weapons. I can arrange a meeting with our trusted arms dealer, if he's interested.
Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.
Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.
I met her once. A prodigy in the field of botany at such a young age... Impressive.
Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.
Keep your fangs sharp.
...I see my way clear.
Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.
I'll handle your commission, alone.
You should have the payment ready by now.
Curious you'd want me to join you in person...
Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.
This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?
...Your kindness, I have certainly received. Naturally, I'll work for you in return.
Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.
*amused huff* Impressive, you've got a much bigger ambition than I thought. The offer you made is too enticing to ignore... Very well. I will repay you with my unwavering loyalty.

I owe you a debt that cannot be easily repaid. The Ghost Hounds have their stance to maintain, and I cannot make decisions for my people lightly. However, I am willing to accept this "contract"... on my own terms. Speak, and your wish will be granted, no questions asked.

...This should come in handy.

Words hold incredible power. In Huanglong, we believe spoken words may manifest into reality. Then if even jokes have a chance to come true, why not good wishes and blessings? That's why we should always express our positive thoughts out loud. Who knows, maybe there is a higher power listening and ready to grant our desires. So, I make sure to say my Lucky Greetings to everyone, as often as possible!

I wish I could show you my hometown, but it's not the same anymore. It's been turned into a Tacet Field, without any life or joy. I prefer living in vibrant places, where there's energy and excitement. But one day, when we overcome the Lament and bring back the beauty of this land, I'll take you there. You'll see the tallest trees, twinkling fireflies, and a river glittering with stars... Yes, we'll see that day...

I'm no longer afraid of letting people see my real appearance, but... I guess I still look rather different, and not everyone is so accepting of that. Sometimes I just want to lend a helping hand, and they'd assume I'm trying to claw at them or something... Erm, what do you think, Rover? Do I look scary to you?

I love people-watching. It's fascinating to see so many different faces and backgrounds come to watch the liondance. Each person brings their own story and personality... I guess they're just, just like... leaves? I've never come across two identical leaves. Every one of them is unique. And you, Rover, I want to know more about you so bad... Tell me more, please?

"Feel the drum and dance along," they say. In lion dancing, there isn't really a set melody we dance to. It's all about finding the perfect balance between movement and music. Everyone in our troupe must attend both Mr. Wufang's liondance classes and Mr. Qixing's drumming classes. And let me tell you, I struggle with the drums. Catching the beat is always tricky. I do better in the liondance class, but I often get lost in the dance and forget to keep up with the beat... Luckily, I can still manage to pull off the performance smoothly, thanks to my fellow troupe members. They often tweak the drumbeat tempo to match my rhythm. As my Master likes to point out, I'm a classic case of being "good at some things but not so much at others".

Medium-rare is the way to go for grilled meat. That tender texture with a hint of secret spices... mmm, delicious! Trust me, I know all about it. Have you tried those "Medium Rare" skewers in Jinzhou? I'm the genius behind them, and now they're all the rage!
Hmm... you've got a point there. Would grilled veggies taste any better?

The liondance tradition is all about banishing evil, guarding fortune, and beckoning blessings. I want to be the best dancer out there to keep this tradition thriving. My Master always reminds me not to aim too high and bite off more than I can chew. I know there's still a long road ahead in perfecting my skills, but as long as I keep moving steadily from one pole to another, like we do in the tournaments, I'll surely reach my goal, no matter how high or far away it may seem.

Why do I keep this liondance head with me? Well, when I first got to Jinzhou, I was afraid to take it off. I didn't want people to see that I looked different from everyone else. Wearing the head made me feel safe, like I could hide my appearance and just focus on dancing. Maybe back then, I thought that only by wearing the liondance head could I truly be myself without judgement.

For some reason, people seem obsessed with my tail. Sometimes my seniors like to play their little drums to the beat of my swishing tail. But honestly, I have no idea how to control it. It's more like some kind of... reflex? When I feel happy—like right now, it just starts wagging on its own.

In Jinzhou, the liondance tradition started as a way to celebrate victories in battle. And nowadays, we always perform before our soldiers go into battle—it's like a good luck charm and morale booster. Our Liondance Troupe has been traveling between military camps in various regions to deliver performances. I'll never forget my first time leading a pre-battle show. I was nervous and messed up here and there, but General Jiyan didn't get mad at me. He actually encouraged me a lot. He isn't as strict as he seems in public, is he? No wonder the soldiers admire him so much... He's really a strong and kind person.

Liondance is a fusion of martial arts and dance. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures. Miss Jianxin practices Fengyiquan, a contrasting style to liondance, but just as impressive. I once saw her effortlessly take down seven men with a single punch! The Fengyiquan truly lives up to its reputation: conquering the unyielding with the yielding.

The Qixing Drum's sound echoes far and wide, and people say it scares evil spirits and beasts away. I never thought anyone could sleep through that loud banging, but then I met this pink-haired lady called Taoqi... Turns out she's the Chief Officer of border defense at the Ministry of Development. With all the defenses in Jinzhou, I'd be tired too... Maybe she is just too exhausted from work? I hope she can catch some good rest.

Uncle Yuanwu keeps lots of street cats at his boxing gym. I often bring them fish I've caught as thank-yous for, let's say, helping me practice. I wonder if those cats are picking up on his moves? Maybe I can draw some inspiration from that. By the way, Uncle Yuanwu's dried fish is super delicious!

Don't let Mr. Mortefi's permanent 'Do-Not-Disturb' face fool you, he's actually a big kid at heart. He's the genius behind all those fun toys for Jinzhou's children, and he even created some sick merch for our Liondance Troupe! So when you need his help, don't hesitate to tell him—just do it politely and he'll surely lend you a hand!
Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!

I love Yangyang's singing! I've been trying to convince her to sing at our theater, but she keeps turning me down.... Says she's embarrassed to sing in front of a crowd. I don't get it! It's just like liondancing—once you take that first step, the rest falls into place!
The Remnant Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called You'Tan, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was...

Happy birthday! May your life be filled with joy and delight, as you chase your dreams and reach new heights. May happiness follow wherever you go, may your journey be a wonderful show! Hehe, I've come up with a special liondance just for you! Can you spend some more time here with me today? Because, well, this dance might run a little long.
Awoo—Lion up! Victory is mine at this year's Greens-plucking Tournament!
Warm-up's done. Ready for stage!
Hmm? Did I just hear something? It feels off to not hear the drums...
Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head!
Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!
Hmm? Where are you going? Count me in!
Shh... I sneaked myself out. Promise you won't tell, okay?
Here's to a safe journey ahead.
Great! That's a new move for me!
No more slacking off now that you're here to help! I should practice harder.
So this is what they mean by "Beyond the mountain lies a broader world"... Thank you, Rover! I couldn't have made it this far without you. Now I'm ready to challenge higher Plum Blossom Poles.

My Master once told me this: Never lose reverence for the "highest pole", no matter how much you've achieved. There's always someone better, and always more to learn, so we should always stay humble. I'll keep cultivating myself with this reverence in mind. Besides, there's someone right in front of me that I want to catch up to.

Legend has it that the liondance was created by ancient sages, inspired by the movement of constellations in the sky. True mastery of it allows one to draw power from the world, to form a miniature cosmos within. ...Now I think I've finally caught a glimpse into that realm. I've still got a long way ahead, but at least I can better protect you now.

You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!

Erm, actually... I wonder just how you seem to know so much. I've been to the cities a few times, but I know very little compared to you. Can I ask you for help next time I run into things I don't understand? Please bear with me, though, as it may take me some time to catch on...

I grew up in my sect, on a remote, secluded mountain. Most people may find it a bit challenging to make it there, but it should be easy for you. I can take you there if you want. Hehe, honestly, I've always wanted to bring you home as my guest!

I wasn't the brightest kid, but I was lucky to find my talent in martial arts. That's why I really admire people with both brains and courage. Of all the smart people I know, you're the best, being a great martial artist and a true defender of justice. You are the one I look up to the most, beside my masters.

I adore being part of nature's harmony. Every songbird in the sky, every leaf on the ground, and every glimmer of sunlight makes me feel a serene joy, as the sweet breezes surround me, whispering life's many blessings. Your presence brings me the same kind of feeling, Rover. With you, everything feels so right, like I belong where I should.

My life's goal is to one day fully master Fengyiquan. For me, every place—be it in the valley, on a mountain peak, or a bustling market—provides an opportunity to perfect my art. I find joy in connecting with various energies and Chi available across different places; this connection gives me new chances of growth.

Worthy opponents are always hard to find. I always yearn for a good fight from which I can learn and improve myself. That said, I'm not too invested in looking for challenges anymore. One can only find inner peace when they let go of their desires. I can find my growth without engaging in frequent battles.

My favorite food? It's the Guokui Flatbread! We'd always have it at our sect, and when I was little, I got extra servings like other younger disciples. Master Shiling even said that I'd followed his scent of freshly made flatbread all the way up the mountain, and that's how I joined our sect. I'm not sure if it was true or not though, he loves to rib us like that sometimes.

There isn't any particular food that I dislike. I'm not much of a food person, I guess. People mix various ingredients for a variety of purposes—to gain muscle, to treat illnesses, or to stay healthy. The flavors of these food combinations are just natural outcomes. All types of food serve a purpose and can be beneficial.
Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.

I got the Mirrors of Clarity from Master Shiling when I was little. The mirrors represented my masters' good wishes for me: to stay dedicated, disciplined, and become a well-rounded individual. Each day, I carry them with me to honor their teachings, but more importantly, to remind myself of how much they cared for me.

To reach where our sect is, one must take the Ancient Path—it's the only way up the mountain. This is usually difficult for new disciples, but Master Shiling said when he took me in, I almost made it up the mountain as fast as he did. He said I was like a little wild animal: agile, vibrant, and naive. I can't remember any of that, though. The earliest memory I have is practicing martial arts with fellow disciples.

Chixia always invites me to spar. She's really good with her guns, and I've learned so much from those fights. I admire her dedication and genuineness. It's great to have made a friend while honing my fighting skills.

Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. I told Master Shiling about it when I returned, and it turns out Mr. Yuanwu's ancestors used to practice martial arts at our sect. According to the rules, I guess I should call him my "martial senior". I heard that Mr. Yuanwu went through a lot when he was younger, but it seems he doesn't want me to talk too much about it, so let's just drop it there.

I've only celebrated birthdays for my masters and fellow disciples before, and we'd usually make peach buns of longevity for the birthday person. So... here, I've made some peach buns for you! Happy Birthday! I wish you good health and great happiness!
Oh?
Self-awareness leads to wisdom... hmm?
What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...
I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?
Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.
Enemies ahead? I'm ready.
What will I learn from this fight?
I'll do my best!
This is a different practice, but it feels similar to how I usually do seated cultivation as my master taught. Hmm... how do I put this? I'll tell you once I've come up with a better way to describe.
Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!

This is... the feeling of standing on top of a mountain, watching the billowing sea of clouds beneath my feet. The spirit within me resonates with every life in this universe... Yes, that's it! That's how it feels! I've finally figured out how to put this feeling into words!

Now my body and mind have gained a newfound clarity, and even my senses are keener than before. The Chi that surrounds me seems more... Oh no! Sorry! Are you alright? Phew... I should have paid more attention to keep it in check. I'll focus on improving my control of this power from now on. Thank you, Rover! I'm now another step closer to my goal!

Is this real? I can't believe... Thank you, for everything you've done for me. No one, apart from my masters, has shown me more kindness in this life than you have. I can never repay in full what I owe to you, but I want to try anyway. There is something I've wanted to tell you for a while now: beyond seeking martial excellence, I've found another goal in life—to do everything I can for you, until my very last breath.
Come forth.
Serenity.
Clarity.
Chi lasts evermore!
Universe in my psyche!
Embrace the Oneness!
Tranquility!
Caution.
Stay alert.
A decent challenge.
Worthy opponent!
Life renews itself...
Death is not the end...
My time has come...
Hah!
Hmm. Like this?
Evils begone!
Incoming. Beware!
Speedier this way!
Oh, what is that?
A contented mind is a perpetual feast.
Hmm. What's it gonna be this time?
A well-deserved reward.

Sanhua.
Yes, Madam Magistrate.
I will be going on a temporary leave. During my absence, please help me handle my responsibilities in Jinzhou.
Understood. Should I continue protecting that Rover?
No need. Both Changli and I will be away, and there'll be more than enough paperwork for you to handle.
Is Lady Changli leaving for the capital?
Please pardon my intrusion, but {Male=he;Female=she} just faced an ambush in the Central Plains. What if...
Regarding that incident... We tried to warn {Male=him;Female=her} about the Fractsidus, but they were more cunning than we thought.
If {Male=he;Female=she} runs into another powerful enemy like Scar, {Male=he;Female=she}'ll eventually have to confront them on {Male=his;Female=her} own.
Sanhua, you can place more trust in Rover and me.
Understood. I will.
My lady... No matter what happens, my sword is always yours.
Both the interrogation and my appointed meeting with Rover have already finished.
Scar only needed the two of you as his audience. We already knew what he wanted, and we let him have as much.
{Male=He;Female=She} decrypted every message we intended to convey. It's only proper you meet {Male=him;Female=her} in person, as the one who crafted those puzzles.
Such intricate puzzles... I guess only Rover has the patience to solve them all.
No detail is too small. I'm sure {Male=he;Female=she} understands. Besides... Not seeing the opponent heightens the thrill of the game.
If everything goes according to the prophecies of Jué, I will meet {Male=him;Female=her} in person eventually.
So... What did our captive from the Fractsidus tell you about Jué?
...That Jué had predicted I will have to fight it one day. A fight that will shape Jinzhou's future.
Well, that is... unexpected. But you don't seem all that surprised, do you?
Can't say I am. I had suspected as much from our previous conversations, and the message it left me... His words only confirmed it.
Where was it when you last sensed its presence?
It was... In Mt. Firmament. Unlike Jinzhou city, that mountain is still resting in "stillness."
The place where the first people of Jinzhou lived, and where Jué first manifested before us humans... I see.
I'll find Jué and bring it back as soon as possible.
Our enemies could have planned it as a trap. We have a bigger goal to focus on, remember?
I understand. I will not let anything or anyone disrupt the peace in Jinzhou.
Would you let what you heard from Scar sway your determination?
No, he cannot ever turn me against Jué. If anything, his words only confirmed my theory.
I am the Magistrate of Jinzhou, appointed by the Sentinel itself.
The prophecy speaks of a decisive incident for Jinzhou's future, where I will be a key player. The fight between me and Jué is only a precursor.
My job remains unchanged. I will fulfill my duty as Jinzhou's Magistrate with my own judgment.
And that's your final answer?
A single strand's neglect births mountainous upheaval. You taught me that, remember?
The safest option is for me to go in person.
...Very well.
Since we are already mid-game, I will let you decide our next move.
This time, I shall be a pawn in your hand.
Remember I will always stand by your side, in this crisis or any other.
...Am I a player or a mere pawn? I suppose there is no difference at this point.
No matter what, I will do what I must.
Rover! Are you all right?
I see... The Black Shores must have a deep connection to your past.
Since you are likely being closely monitored by the Fractsidus now...
I suggest keeping an eye out for the Black Shore members. They could prove to be your valuable allies.
I'll do my best to find Jué, and tell you everything I learned from it once I return.
This is my promise.
Yes. Please leave it to me.
I saw something... I was wearing the Blake Bloom...
I'm counting on you.
...Sorry, Rover. What he mentioned about our Sentinel is... highly sensitive. I cannot disclose it yet, not before verifying it myself.
Is it a ploy to create distrust among us, or... I must first find our Sentinel to uncover the truth.
Jué is the Guardian Sentinel of Jinzhou. It is responsible for assisting Jinzhou's Magistrate in administrative affairs.
While I am final decision maker... Without the assistance of Jué, I cannot guarantee I'm always making the best choices for my people.
T-Thank you. I am glad you think so.
Jué can predict the future, and up to this point, every one of its prophecies have been proven true.
Jué can predict the future, and up to this point, every one of its prophecies have been proven true.
While justice may not be universally agreed upon, its decisions have consistently served the best interests of Huanglong.
For that... I suppose we will have to talk to it in person to find out.
In addition, Rover, Jué once told me to deliver a message to you.
"To the Awakened One: When raindrops fall upstream, please head to the Norfall Barrens, and seek General Jiyan of the Midnight Rangers."
I suppose so. General Jiyan is currently battling another TD Outbreak in the Norfall Barrens, which will also serve as our frontline against the Threnodian.
But the ongoing war has made it a very dangerous place to go.
Since you won't need to go there right now, not until when the "raindrops fall upstream"...
I know you're here for clues about your true identity, and I don't want you to leave the city empty-handed.
Have you heard about the Black Shores, Rover?
It's an organization shrouded in mystery, with a secretive membership process and members who usually keep their identities hidden.
Upon your awakening, one of their members discreetly contacted me to gather information about you.
But please don't worry. The Black Shores developed a special Lament prediction system, and has established partnerships with countries worldwide.
While operating in secrecy, they are not an extremist group like the Fractsidus.
They have been monitoring the situation in Jinzhou to provide assistance when needed.
Thanks to their extra help, my meeting with you went smoothly.
This Blake Bloom is their symbol. The Black Shores members usually wear it on their person.
The Black Shores once provided us significant insights into the relationship between the moon and Threnodians.
This time, they've come to inform us a Threnodian is about to resurrect near Jinzhou.
Apart from that, I am not sure what else they may be hoping to achieve.
Rover, after the recent series of events, I trust you have gained a general idea of who you might have been.
Before you fell into that deep slumber, you likely played a significant role in important historical events, shaping the course of history in some way.
Ultimately... I suppose it is up to you to discover the final definitive answer for yourself.
Yes, I suppose it does make them stand out. On the other hand, they presumably possess extraordinary abilities to stay anonymous.
This photo is yours to keep. I will return with Jué shortly, and the Black Shores may be worth your try during this time.
What did Scar tell you?
How important is Jué to Jinzhou?
You seem to be doing well enough on your own.
Why are you so sure Jué is always right?
Perhaps it left to set Jinzhou's future right.
Perhaps it intended to let you make your own decisions.
So I'll need to find this General Jiyan?
So I'll need to go to the Norfall Barrens?
What do they want to achieve in Jinzhou?
There sure are a lot of people keeping an eye on me.
Wouldn't that make them easy to spot?
Scar, you are now under arrest for committing multiple felonies in Huanglong. Do you have anything to say?
What do I want to say, huh? While I'd love to tell you another story... I guess that's not what you want to hear.
Let's cut to the chase, “Madam Magistrate.” I'm getting bored already.
Very well. You will answer only our questions from now on.
Sure, why not. What do you want to know?
A <ano=Oracle Engine>Sentinel</ano> such as Jué can predict and "correct" future events. It gets in our way of achieving our sublime vision.
We merely wanted to topple the set future built on lies, and take control of our own destiny.
The Threnodians... They hold the key to our ideal.
Together they will bring us the promised "true Lament," and we will embrace the new world that is bound to come.
What is the Lament? Disaster? Curse? Some kind of punishment? Ha! People only see the surface...
The Lament brings death, destruction, and countless Reverberations.
Reverberations that will be reflected, overlapped, and interwoven during the Lament... They will be our salvation, the only path to a new lifeform and a new civilization.
Our goal has always been the same... We want you. Want you to join us.
Forces battle over you, causing all this strife, and yet you remain unaware of your own worth... Are you really that naive, or are you just dense?
Whatever. Our interest in you is not affected by such trivial matters.
Too bad. We will then be forced to kill you, by any means necessary...
But I'm sure you'll willingly come to us... When the time arrives.
You kidnapped Jué and revived the Threnodian, accelerating the next Lament... This is proof enough that you are the enemy of Jinzhou, and all humanity.
Stop dreaming you can force Rover to join you. {Male=He;Female=She} is our honored guest, and I will not allow any harm to come {Male=his;Female=her} way.
Ha! How confident you sound. As the Threnodian's resurrection approaches, Jinzhou is barely holding on. How much longer do you think you can keep up this facade?
Thank you for your concern. We have crushed your schemes once, and we can do it again.
I have one last question for you. Abducting "Jué," stalking Rover, and setting up an ambush in Qichi Village... You couldn't have accomplished that all on your own.
Unless...
Unless I'm not the only Overseer in Jinzhou, right? Hahaha...
I have answered all your questions with full honesty. I don't mind you knowing, because it won't make any difference.
You can try to stop us with all you have... But it's too late to change the course of history.
Now, I have one question for you...
You seem convinced we caused the disappearance of Jué... What if I told you there was more to it? Would you be curious?
About Jué... What else do you know?
Come closer and I'll tell you, Madam Magistrate... It's a secret for your ears only...
How dare you! Madam Magistrate, I...
No, it can't be...
Shocked, aren't you? But there's more...
What if I told you... Your Sentinel had made this prophecy a long, long time ago?
Your all-seeing Sentinel abandons you now of all times. Need I say more?
We're merely adding a touch of extra fuel to the fire that will soon consume all.
Rover, care for a wager? I know you've been searching for answers about your past, and I've got news for you—
Watch out!
You are one of us, the "black lambs," and you have been chosen to join us ushering in the new world...
Once you discover what you really are, you will come to us with no hesitation.
The Fractsidus awaits your arrival with open arms.
And I look forward to that day in sincere anticipation...
Hehehehehe.... AHAHAHAHAHA!
After the interrogation, Scar is put in jail...
Why did you kidnap Jué?
Why are you obsessed with reviving the Threnodian?
What on earth is the Lament?
Why were you following me?
I'm done with him.
Why me?
And if I say no?

Resonators gain <color=#ffd12f>Concerto Energy</color> when dealing damage or performing Dodges in combat.

Ongoing
What happened?

The recent adventure story was about the Icebreakers, who ventured into places far and between, like the distant polar oceans, the revived volcanoes, and the Great Rift Valley after the Lament occurred.
They reported about nature's warning signs that they spot around the world and became the first witnesses of countless powerful Tacet Discord.
After hearing these stories, Zhuyi suddenly became restless and applied to the Association to join the next expedition to the unchartered danger zones.
I'm worried that he's moving too fast and might make the mistakes I made before.
Later, in one of the missions, I rushed forward without properly surveying the terrain and accidentally fell into a cave.
As a result, I injured my thigh, and since then had to gradually retire from the field. Now I'm starting to think about transferring to support.
What if he makes my mistake again?
Rover, if you have a solution, you must tell me.
The shot is great.
We can see the former glory of the skyscrapers from the remnants, and what used to be a lustrous sea of flowers from the withered petals.
Just like magic. Takes everyone back to the past.
But there are also members of the Icebreakers who discovered their Resonance in times of crisis. Perhaps it's the same for me.
You'll never know if you never try.
Oh, and we're now accepting pre-orders for our new merchandise. What do you say, wanna snag one for yourself?
Bye! See you again!
We record and share the progress of human civilization's revival and reconstruction.
Our skilled photographers are always out capturing the world's latest marvels!
Bye! See you again.
A symbol of triumph and hope, never to falter or fall.
Qingloong
Purify the mystical mirror to align with heaven's will.
Mirrors of Clarity
I am wondering if Taoqi's "slow response" is deliberate.
This way, there is more time to see what is happening around you. Should I also try to learn it?
But if I leave a deliberate opening in the setup to guide the enemy's attack in another direction, you'd be more targeted and prepared in your defense.
Hehe, my idea is not bad, right? This theory is not only limited to Jinzhou. It can also be extended to other places.
But I've sensed I didn't come up with the idea myself. I got the inspiration elsewhere. Perhaps, in the textbook, or in one of Taoqi's sharing sessions?
Well, let's try this direction first.
Instead of strategizing on paper out of pure imagination.
It's normal for ordinary people to be curious about the unknown Tacetite weapon, but if you're serious about studying it–
–you should master the basics of Tacetite before you get ahead of yourself.
Like this, asking me every day, the work in my hands is almost too busy.
Not far away, you can vaguely see a few small dark clouds drifting. What we have to do is to clear the clouds and let the sun shines through.
After hearing this, it's like I was awakened from a daze and suddenly I found a path forward.
Isn't it the reason why I set foot on this path to see the views behind those dark clouds? At the very least, I need to try to keep up.
So that I can reach the highest point of the Tacetite building with everyone.
Hey, I gradually grew attached while repairing these old gadgets. After all, we're all a bit nostalgic.
He also fixed those things. So, I let him do his things from then on. Later, he became increasingly more sophisticated with it.
Maybe one day he can become a great inventor. And I'll be known as the father of a great inventor.
Like "If it's him, he can definitely do it...", but I can't be as perfect as my father.
Later, I left the Ministry of Development and opened this shop. Now I'm content with this life of fixing things for the folks of Jinzhou.
But the talent of Wenmo was as high as his grandfather's, and he may be able to accomplish what I have not done in the future.
I really hope to see that day.
Because the Moon-chasing Festival is coming soon, I like the colorful lanterns hanging on the street and the lively lantern riddle activities.
But sometimes the weather would be difficult during Moon-chasing Festivals, and the lanterns hanging on the street would be easily blown away because they were too light.
So I was thinking if I could mimic the devices invented by the Ministry of Development and create a special shield for the lanterns
So that we don't need to worry about the weather during the Moon-chasing Festival. But this is a secret between you and me. Don't tell others.
I want to give everyone a surprise.
Oh no, gotta head back, or my dad's gonna get mad at me, Let's play some other time.

Has increased RES to Fusion DMG while in human form. When enraged, transform into a grim goat reaper with increased RES to Spectro DMG and Havoc DMG. One of the Fractsidus Overseers. A rebel who revels in Overclocking, disregarding the ideas of beauty and order. He enjoys destruction and chaos, delighting in the suffering of others. He disregards rules and fame, using any means to reach his goals. With an introspective sobriety driving him, he seeks you out to witness the birth of a new world, still in its infancy. "New life blooms from scorched earth, rising through the ashes."
That's it for today's work. Time for some fun! Hmm? Oh, it's you—what's up?
Hehe, that's because I’m all about "energy conservation." I don't waste time on unnecessary things and finish what needs to be done with the least effort.
I get a lot of flack for this, but isn't it perfectly normal to clock out as soon as your work is done?
The key to conserving energy is learning to adapt. And by that, I mean not adapting to the work’s pace, but making the work adapt to yours.
So, ready to say goodbye to that energy-draining work life with me?
For example, you could check out the residential block. You might not be able to bring all of Jinzhou to a mining site, but you can recreate parts of it.
Like enjoying local dishes at the food stalls, sharing tea with friends around a table, or playing a few rounds of chess with the retired miners...
Over time, this little corner has become a miniature Jinzhou to us miners.
Words don't do it justice. Check it out yourself if you can.
I think it's still business hours, right?
Oh, the Moon-Chasing Festival is coming up, and last year was too swamped to get the chance to see the lanterns with my Xiaobao.
This year is my chance to make up for it. I wonder what kind of gift would be good for the child?
Toys? I don't really understand the likes of children. I have to ask that kid, Chixia, for help.
She often helps me babysit my Xiaobao, who treats her like a real sister and tells her everything.
Food? I work down in the mine all year round. To be honest, my knowledge of food in Jinzhou is as good as yours. So I should ask you for recommendations.
Quality time with Xiaobao... Yes, I haven't been able to spend time with the child because of work.
Last year the child had a huge tantrum because he didn't see the lanterns with me, and it took a long time to calm him down.
Moon-chasing Festival, the festival that children are always talking about... I'm actually quite looking forward to it. To be honest, I was once one of the Exiles.
In the past, even on the day of the Moon-chasing Festival, we had to worry about the supplies needed for survival.
It was only after we were accepted by Jinzhou that we started to enjoy the Moon-chasing Festival like everyone else.
Thank you for your suggestion. I will think about it after work...
Fun toys.
Delicious food.
Spend quality time with him.
You... don't seem to work here. Is there anything I can help you with?
You want to know about the past and present of the mine, right? I've only been stationed here not for long.
But occasionally I can hear the miners talking about it. It is said that the Tiger's Maw Mine was built on the ruins of a city.
Affected by the Lament, Jinzhou underwent some drastic tectonic changes, in which the ore mines buried deep were turned out and exposed to the surface.
So the Tiger's Maw Mine became an indispensable source of energy supply in the founding of Jinzhou.
After the mineshafts were built, the mine gradually started to form its own ecosystem as the production and research facilities, and living quarters, as well as other amenities, were set up.
As for the ore... Although I'm not an expert, I picked up a few things over time as I spent enough time around here.
About the Tiger's Maw Mine.
About the ore.
Apart from the Tacetite, which is the largest in demand, the Tiger's Maw Mine also produces Lampylumen.
I heard from the researchers that it's a special kind of ore where the veins of minerals distribute evenly along the same direction.
And the veins are composed of a variety of minerals, which can be processed into raw materials that can be used in advance technologies like terminals and cores of intelligent devices.
However, the Academy and the Ministry of Development didn't stop their research from there. So, maybe one day they'd discover a field of application.
How to resolve the disputes?
You looked troubled.
Yes, the dispute about the deployment of the new technology has been escalating recently, and I'm worried that the workplace party next week will turn into a chaos.

If you have questions about Tacet Discords, feel free to come to me.
Despite resembling organisms, Tacet Discords are essentially an energy construct made up of Reverberations.
Tacet Discords doesn't follow ordinary biological evolution or hereditary rules.
They may take the form of real-world objects, but it's mere camouflage.
Although Tacet Discords lack biological connections between themselves...
For the sake of observation and understanding, we still categorize all the discovered Tacet Discords we come across.
The five defined types include Whisperin, Howler, Tranquilite, Clamorling, and Staticoid.
While Tacet Discords may vary, they all pose a threat to us humans.
Naturally, we devised a threat level classification system.
We determine the threat by assessing the strength of the Tacet Discord's characteristic frequency. Folks tend to think the higher the frequency, the stronger the Tacet Discord.
The ranking goes from lowest to highest: Common, Elite, Overlord, and Calamity.
Because Tacet Discords are essentially aggregates of Reverberation energy, they turn back into disordered frequencies upon elimination.
That being said, there's a small chance these frequencies might recombine into new, specific substances.
These substances exhibit unique appearances and compositions, and have special medicinal properties used in making medicine.

You're back, {PlayerName}. Everything well?
You tell Xiaoyu what happened back at the Mine.
Sounds like a lot of twists and turns at the Mine. So we'll have to collect the samples on another day.
An argument over whether to coexist with TD or not. It seems to me that they take you as a member of the Ministry.
And let you know their secret inadvertently.
There was a crisis of TD years ago at the Mine... Wait, I have a message.
Sigh, some follow-up work to do about the meeting just now. Was trying to chat with you a little more.
Maybe next time. Take this, it's the reward from the Ministry. I'll see you.
What secret?
Bye, Uncle Hong. Take care when you go back, eh?
Okay, okay. Tastes just like the old days, but I just can't help feeling empty.
What was I going to do?
Look, {PlayerName}. That's Grandpa Hong.
We finally found you, Grandpa Hong. Everyone's been looking for you.
You are... Huaxi. Why look for me?
Great. Grandpa Hong remembers me.
What are you talking about? I think you lost me.
Huaxi and you tell the boss what happened in a low voice.
Ah, that's why. I thought Uncle Hong came here after the maintenance work of the Refinery Tower, as usual.
I'm telling you, my culinary skills are passed down from my fathers.
Uncle Hong would always come here and have a good meal of Jinzhou Stew each time he finishes work.
My father would always say food shortens the distance from home, and the distance between souls.
That's why Jinzhou Stew is not only a simple dish, it's an association of feelings.
What's more, Jinzhou Stew is particularly important to Uncle Hong, because the people sitting beside him here change all the time.
And now it's only him.
It feels lonely to have meals on one's own. No wonder Grandpa Hong looks dull.
Uncle Hong took the journal. Despite the initial resistance, he read faster and faster as his hand turned the pages.
Journal. That's it. I feel much settled now.
Grandpa Hong...
Right. Grandpa Hong, we found your lost journal, and fixed the reboot issue of the Refinery Tower.
Besides, the guest from Ministry of Development is here to deliver the samples as agreed. That's this {Male=big brother;Female=big sister} beside me.
Yes... I do. Everything feels familiar again with the presence of this journal. I'm sorry for the fuss.
Grandpa Hong still looks a bit strange. Let's take him to my brother.
It's kind of late now, {PlayerName}. Like Uncle Modee said, the samples can't be tested as of now. Why don't you come here another day?
Let's return the journal first.
Maybe we shouldn't ask too much now.
Do you have any recollection of that?
The fights with Lei'li is making me sleepless. I always enjoy looking at the sky with my back lying on the grass when I can't sleep.
Look at the stars. When will we touch them?
Now, if we can push science to progress forward, one small step at a time, generation after generation, maybe one day...
You're here. {PlayerName}, this is the map you asked for.
It took you some time to mark the places mentioned in the journal on the map correctly.
A large area indeed. The places Grandpa Hong goes to are centered at three different regions of the Mine.
I get your point. It's similar to triangulation.
Draw three circles with the three regions as centers, and the overlapping area is the area where Uncle Hong is most likely to show up.
This greatly reduces the area we have to search. Nice idea!
Though I don't know what you're talking about, it sounds amazing. Well done, {PlayerName}!
The overlapping area is a corner in the upper living quarter. Let's go there and have a look, {PlayerName}.
Oh, by the way, you can hand me the samples now, {PlayerName}. When the reboot is finished, we will start the procedures.
However, it can't be done today, as the reboot can take some time.
Mark the places in the journal on the map.
Draw a circle with each of these regions as the center.
That's right.
Another of the Rover's tricks.
Just a lift of finger. When the pararmeter reset is successful, the system will adjust the Refinery Tower and the reboot will be done.
Now the reboot can take some time. All we need is wait. Thank you for your effort.
We don't have any information about Grandpa Hong's whereabouts, though.
Hm... I did find a pattern in the previous entries. Though the events are various...
... They all happen at a few limited places.
For example, Grandpa Hong often visits my brother's clinic: “Went to the clinic today and had a routine examination as per Doctor Huayu's instructions.”
“Went to the clinic today. The medication is getting so bitter. Lucky Doctor Huayu didn't find out I hid candy in my palm.”
Furthermore. Grandpa Hong always remind the lorry drivers at the transport quarter of the purchase of day-to-day items the Mine needs.
Their conversations are also kept here.
It feels like the routes are set, and what Uncle Hong does is to walk them time after time.
Then, if Uncle Hong's memory goes wrong, will he go to these places in the journal as he is used to going there?
However, these places are distributed throughout the Mine. If we were to look for him at these places, it would take a lot of people.
Have you come up with something, {PlayerName}?
I have one at the Mine's institute. Just a few moments. Meet me at the gate in a while.
Why don't we read more of the journal now?
Possible indeed.
Give me a map of the Mine.

Oh, you're back, {PlayerName}. Thank you for lifting us through this crisis.
Keep on calling me Uncle Hong.
Yes, with the help of this plate, which I found when I left the cave.
Chengwen told me in my dream that this kind of plate is made of a special mineral, and that words inscibed on it won't be worn away after years.
Look, {PlayerName}. He didn't lie. His name is inscribed on it in a perfect condition.
It was all in my dream, but now it's here before our eyes.
I only understand now that the dreams were real things.
I don't know why, but it feels like I losing the ability to feel as I forget things. No matter it is sadness or regret.
What is left was only scenarios. They keep overwhelming me until I lose breath.
{PlayerName}, will you listen to the other half of my boring dream?
After Lampylumen Myriad was awakened, Chengwen and I walked the same path as we do today.
We broke Ice Chrysalises, removed the block at the entrance, and managed to suppress Lampylumen Myriad.
However, the Refinery Tower wasn't built in the dream. Suppressing Lampylumen Myriad could only buy time for the rescue from Jinzhou to arrive.
Chengwen was heavily injured in the combat, and he didn't make it on the way back to Jinzhou for healing.
Later, when the Ministry started to investigate the reason of the crisis at the Mine, I was ready for being held accountable.
But what met me was actually applause and medals, which I only found strange.
It was Chengwen, who took all the responsibilities himself on the way back to the Ministry.
It was only out of his simple belief that I could rebuild the Mine, and that the Mine couldn't afford to lose two heads.
Was it guilt?
After that I started to study the documents Chengwen left. I picked up the piles of research materials that I myself pushed to the ground.
And I found that we were both wrong. The coexistence wasn't a job to do at the two ends of a line, but one to do on the middle point.
I found the initial ideas of the Refinery Tower from his notes, and it became what it is now after iterations.
We managed the balance by suppressing Lampylumen Myriad's chill with the Refinery Tower's heat, so as to prevent it from awakening.
It was with this report that Ministry of Development agreed on the proposal that the Mine coexists with the TD.
This was the way of survival that he and I joined efforts to find, but his name was forever wiped from the Mine's documents, and marked as a sinner.
And now, even I am losing his memories. I want to write something down, but my brain is just blank.
I often go to the places he spent time at, but his traces are only disappearing, because the Mine is changing so fast.
Lucky I have some fragments that I can put down on the journal. These stories and arguments, and Jinzhou Stew that we both love.
Yes. What if one day I stop distinguishing the current from the past and forget myself?
What if I get swallowed in a woven world, just like today?
Walked out... Maybe. I don't want to be a coward anymore.
Faced everything... Maybe. I don't want to be a coward anymore.
And I don't want the kids to walk down my path again.
Maybe this crisis is a chance for growth for them. It will correct their overdependence on the experience of previous generations.
The balance of our coexistence with TD is forever changing, and the Refinery Tower is only one part of it.
Interestingly, this is the first time I've seen Lei'li and Modee work together.
Thank you, {PlayerName}, for listening to this boring dream until the end.
You should be tired after all this, right? I already informed the food stall.
You must come and have a taste of the special Jinzhou Stew of the Mine.
Uncle Hong?
You remembered?
You are calmer than I think.
Only too glad.
So the journal is a recollection of the past.
The past is irrelevant. You walked out of it.
The past is irrelevant. You faced everything.
The communication returns normal, and the temperature is rising too. {PlayerName}, looks like you succeeded.
Uncle Hong is safely back too. The Mine is rebooting the Refinery Tower. Thank you for your efforts!
(Listen close. The chilling wind is mingled with slight sounds...)
(Wind, murmur, crushing ice... all mingled together, and closing in)
Everything was similar just now, but it feels so different from here.
It was only a dream...
I was a coward in the dreams. Wasn't man enough to stand on this frost ground.
No, actually I hate that me in the dreams. I was running from everything like a coward.
I rushed into this plan to eliminate Lampylumen Myriad in the dream, but it only made things even worse.
After I made the disaster happen, I wasn't held accountable in any form, but became the hero of the Mine.
Everyone I met said “well done”, “thank you”, “you're a hero” and so forth.
But it feels reassuring to be standing here. I don't, and won't run.
I won't be able to help further from here, so I'll wish you luck.
Lampylumen Myriad is closely associated with Ice Chrysalises. You have to take care doing this alone. Then I'm counting on you.
What were things like in dreams?
You kind of cling to the dreams.
I'll take care of this.
Please trust me.
The Ice Chrysalises is clear.
The entrance is open now. Let's go, Rover.
You picked up a metal meal box, which seemed to be used to keep the food warm.
This makes me nostalgic. The Mine in my dreams were so simple.
After work, Chengwen and I were sitting right at that corner, and the box was filled with hot and steaming Jinzhou Stew.
I didn't know that meals only taste better when they are shared.
Sorry for the blabbering. Let's move on.
This Ice Chrysalises looks different from the last one.
Maybe due to the chill. It feels even colder here than just now.
You picked up a clay statue from the broken Ice Chrysalises. It looked like a huge fish.
Maybe the miners left it here. They did learn a lot of crafts during their off time.
Huge fish... Haha, it reminds me of that whale in my dream.
Due to Lampylumen Myriad, Chengwen and I had an argument. We sat in one corner of the square table.
He pushed piles of research materials in front of me in an effort to persuade me, and all I did was hitting the surface of the table and yelled with a voice louder than the noise of the table.
After that, he visited me again with my favorite food, and he suddenly brought up this story about human's relationship with whales.
And he stopped in the middle, said the other half wasn't written yet.
He asked for my view on the half of the story, but I was able to find where he was really getting at.
The first encounter with whale was kind of similar to the then situation of the Mine. He wasn't asking for my opinion about the story, but my attitude towards the events.
Looks like a huge fish.
The entrance is blocked by ice.
Yes, maybe due to the Ice Chrysalises. It is a product of the awakening of Lampylumen Myriad.
Defeat it to remove the block of the entrance.
The temperature went down so fast.
How's it going, {PlayerName}. Can you hold on?
By the way, this feels the same as what I saw in the dream. Only in that dream, I was Uncle Hong.
Let's go. We have to find the entrance to the bottom of the cave first.
When Modee tried to continue, you saw Huayu, together with Uncle Hong, rushed here and made a gesture that urged you to join him.
Judging from the trend of the diffusion of the chill, the time it reaches the upper level will be only earlier. Before that, we will have to...
Oh? {PlayerName}, you're here. I heard it when Doctor Huayu asked you for help. Do you need any assistance?
So he told you all that. Then he must have told you the secret about the TD under the ground.
I have always had a different view with him about the coexistence with it.
It's only that the event this time ignite our dissension.
The reason why I insist on coexistence is simple. Do you know the TD's name, {PlayerName}?
That's right. This common name implies the reason of my insistence.
It's Lampylumen Myriad. This name implies the reason of my insistence.
Lampylumen is a fairly rare mineral. The conditions of its formation is so critical that even manual interference can hardly control them.
However, it can naturally crystalize and deposit and solidify as raw ore in the Tiger's Maw Mine.

It was until the discovery of Lampylumen Myriad, which lies dormant underground and creates a chilling atmosphere, that we understand the source of the unique underground cave here, a product of the chill and the geography here.
The cave is the optimal environment for the mineral to grow. That's why we should find a way to coexist with it.
You can say that again. I just wonder why Lei'li can't see this.
Yeah, I know, but we just can't give up on all this and restrain ourselves from even trying for this probability.
This is the answer I work out after careful evaluation. I don't move.
Uncle Hong should be a supporter of mine, but something strange happened at the fight just now...
Between you and Lei'li...
Lampylumen Myriad.
lumpylumy something...
That makes sense.
But TD isn't stable.
Maybe we should reevaluate the pros and cons.
What is Uncle Hong's take on this?
Is everyone evacuated from the bottom? I want no one trapped down there.
But the chill can't be stopped now. Not before long the upper parts of the Mine will be affected.
Oh, {PlayerName}, why are you here?
Oh? So the help that Doctor Huayu mentioned is you. We just had a fight.
You're well-informed, aren't you? Doctor Huayu told you, right? He talked about a help when we were fighting just not. So it's you.
In the meantime, as an outsider, you are the perfect judge for the two of us.
As you can see, the reboot wasn't successful, and there is even a strange chill invading from the bottom.
Now that Doctor Huayu has called for your help, I won't hide anything from you.
Responsible to this all is the Tacet Discord under the ground of the Mine, Lampylumen Myriad.
But it's not geographical location that made the Tiger's Maw Mine a deposit of so many unique, special minerals...
...but this special ecological relationship between the Mine and the TD.
Though both the Ministry and the Mine claim that this TD is in a stable dormancy, and that we should look for a balanced way of coexistence...
...we only feel dread and terror, as its most immediate neighbor.
This talk about balance and development.
Since their birth, TDs are representatives of catastrophe. This kind of unknow, dangerous things should be exterminated.
I was telling what the miners and me really think just now...
...when Modee suddenly got mad and started to argue with me.
Tell me, {PlayerName}, is what I said wrong? Aren't the facts clear enough?
Isn't this TD to blame for everything that has happened to the Mine?
You can say that again. I just wonder why Modee can't see this.
But it is a ticking bomb. I must restate this.
I don't know about these abstract things. All I know is seeing is believing. My view stays the same.
...Hmm. I would say Uncle Hong is in favor of Modee, because I gather he was the one that put forward the idea of coexistence.
And when we were fighting just now, he... Forget it, {PlayerName}. I'll keep on counting heads.
Doctor Huayu called me.
I heard the Mine is faced with a trouble.
What happened to the Mine?
The TD is indeed a danger.
Coexistence did bring benefits, didn't it?
Maybe we should reevaluate the pros and cons.
What is Uncle Hong's take on this?
Hey, I was almost frozen to death. I told you that thing underground is a ticking bomb.
Sigh, the detectors are not responding from the bottom of the Mine. The data they recorded is probably lost. All those efforts in vain.
Have you heard about it? The shutdown of the Mine wasn't a simple accident. It's because...
What are they talking about? Are they Lei'li and Modee?
I should go and ask them what happened to the Mine.
Is it {PlayerName}? Now, it might be a sudden call, but the Mine is in a crisis now, and I don't think the signals are stable.
I don't have time, but we do need your help, please...
Seems like the Communication is cut off.
He sounded urgent. Maybe the Mine is facing some problem again.
Let's go take a look. Maybe we'll find more about the Mine's secret from the witnesses.
You're here, {PlayerName}. It's a pity we didn't finish the story about the Mine's crisis.
I didn't know the truth of it all before some time since I joined the Ministry.
There is a colossal Tacet Discord under the ground surface of the Tiger's Maw Mine. A serious conflict was incurred among the Mine staff when it was discovered.
Then, one of the heads of the Mine, Chengwen acted on impulse and speeded up the aggravation of the TD, which finally led to a grave crisis over the whole Mine.
It was Uncle Hong who rebuilt the Mine piece by piece, and put it back to order the way it had been.
Though Chengwen died protecting the Mine in the crisis, his name was still linked to wrongdoing...
...and deliberately omitted in all the documents related to the Mine.
Similar discussions were provoked for times within the Ministry on the handling of this TD.
It was Uncle Hong who insisted that coexistence was in the interest of the Mine. And the crisis finally quieted down.
It is said that Uncle Hong was able to produce a reasonable plan and persuade people, but I don't have the details.
{PlayerName}, I think your Terminal has been ringing for a while now.
Tell me.
I'm curious.
Is coexistence really possible?
Rover, do you have time to continue our unfinished conversation from last time?
If you do, I'll be waiting for you at the Ministry of Development.

The way this thing's designed... It looks familiar...
Encore wanna try too!

Watching this really gets my creative juices flowing. O magnificant rain, you are a gift of the heavens...

The gaps between each "mist figure" are shrinking... Over there, at the end of that alley!
The "mist figure" of Aalto. It's posed in a weird way, as if he's making a heart with his hands.
...Did he leave it here to mock you? You're not quite sure.
In front of the "mist figure", there is a floating line of handwriting, also made out of fog: "Patience please, the answer is right around the corner!"
What's this? Magic trick?

...Did he leave it here to mock you? You're not quite sure.

Woah! Oh my!
Would it disappear if I touched it?
Oh! Now I've got new ideas for a party dance!
The "mist figure" of Aalto. It's posed in a weird way, as if he's an eagle spreading his wings.
...Did he leave it here to mock you? You're not quite sure.
In front of the "mist figure", there is a floating line of handwriting, also made out of fog: "We value integrity and quality above all else! New customers enjoy 20% off!"
Wow! What is this?
Hehe, I can do this move too!
No, don't do that, it's not for kids to try!
Oh my, what a beautiful lady!
Can I take a selfie with you, please?
T-thank you for saying that...

Are you for real right now? My reputation as the Jinzhou Speedster is...

So, are you two heading back to help Auntie Panhua with this Essence Medley Soup? If so, count me in on learning that recipe too!
Just let Auntie Panhua know. It should be cool for you to join in!
But there's still one last piece of the puzzle to crack: the golden-handled spoon. If we whip up the soup without figuring out what that is about, the flavor might not hit the mark, right?
Wait, isn’t the golden handle spoon that big pyrite spoon from Uncle Wei’s shop? I thought you both knew.
Seriously? No way! Who’d have guessed that!
Oops, looks like I gotta step down from my role as the Jinzhou encyclopedia. I’ve never even heard of that pyrite spoon!
Haha, no worries. I spotted that spoon the last time I dropped off medicine at Uncle Wei’s and asked out of curiosity.
Why does the best weapon maker in Jinzhou have a big pyrite spoon tucked away? Well, I’m counting on you to solve that mystery, along with the last step of the recipe.
Trust me. I won’t.
The answer was right in front of us all along.
That makes sense... After all, pyrite is called fool’s gold.

Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will. If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, the Threnodians embody our fears and struggles. They manifest as destructive Tacet Discord disasters spreading across the planet.

The Waveworn Phenomena is believed to alter matter, information, and energy by converting them into vibrating "frequencies" referred to as "Reverberations." This process has been observed through experimental evidence in the academic community.

In their studies of Waveworn Phenomena, scientists discovered "Tacetite" — a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. The Tacetite can be made into potent weapons for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords. Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.

Ah, this needs to be addressed without delay.
Sir, perhaps we can handle this another day...
This just isn't right...
Sir, what seems to be the problem?
Why give up just because Sanhua turned you down?
Is there something I can do for you?
You don't understand, this is important. I need to speak directly with the Jinzhou Magistrate.
But now everyone is talking about an important guest coming to Jinzhou, and even City Hall can't keep up...
Maybe... maybe I should come back another day?
You didn't catch the Magistrate?
I did see Sanhua though! Just a fleeting glance, but it was her!
Please, let's keep it down a bit, everyone.
The crowd's growing. Where's this important guest everyone's talking about?
Hmm... Sanhua...
Father...
Father...
Having trouble finding your father?
Why are you here all by yourself?
I'm waiting for Father to finish work.
He usually finishes around this time...
But he's told me he has to finish all his work before leaving.
He also told me that a very, very important guest is arriving in Jinzhou.
So... I'm a little curious.
So, that's why I'm here...
Just you? Isn't that a bit dangerous?
Nope! Not at all.
There are no monsters in Jinzhou that come out to eat kids at night.
Plus, with Uncle Yingda and the others around, City Hall is safe!
Hello, are you also here to meet with the Magistrate?
Make sure your papers are ready...
Yes.
Ever since the Magistrate announced an important guest was visiting, the number of visitors to City Hall is growing by the hour.
It's really exhausting.
Times like these, we can't let our guard down. Everything needs to be done by the book.
The crowd keeps growing. Where is this important guest anyway?
I'm not sure.
Could it be me?
Seems like a lot of folks think they are the important guest the Magistrate spoke about.
But it doesn't matter, because the Magistrate and Lady Sanhua are the final judge of that. That's why so many are turned away at the door.
Maybe Lady Sanhua knows, but it's like casting a wide net hoping the big fish takes the bait...
Ah, if your paperwork is ready, better hurry and request a meeting with Lady Sanhua.
(Now I have retrieved the Magistrate's message for me from the puzzle box.)

(With this glowing light, a shadow is cast on two other symbols.)
(The Black Tortoise of the North... North to the City Hall.)
(And the time reads... The <ano=Time Period>Shichen</ano> of Chou, in the Wei hours of the morning.)
