As the Express through the Rain I
The door swings open with a creaking. I turn around, portraying the raindrops with my eyes. Shall they end up in the sea upon the skies? I don't know, nor the destination of this express. Now and then I remember the past, when you and me crouch in one silhouette on those rainy nights. Will we return, back to days of blooming petals and neon lights?

As the Express through the Rain II
I remember, I do. Wet neon, frantic traffic, they all dance like Tetras. We don't care about umbrellas. As we shuffle through shallow depressions on the ground, our swirling skirts willingly embrace the splash. We dance to the tune of rain, dreaming without concerning the days. I wish I could dance with you till we catch the sun; I wish the rain never ends; I wish we never part ways.
That's when we see the flashing light. Bathing in those glowing drops, we chuckle out in the pouring rain. As the car chimes hard, I hear your voice: Can we continue the dance, continue without a finale? I say yes, no finale. We'll stop for no one.
Unsullied by doubt, you nod. In your full skirt, the rain is returning to the skies.
The express, descending from the air, carries you away with strong whistles.
Then, silent neon lights are smashed to the ground and feed me the splashes.
Then, the rain is gently consumed by the flames.
Then, I get swallowed by that rainy night.

As the Express through the Rain III
All our dreams disappear in the heavy rain, as they evaporate in the aching land.
The spreading fire burns every vein and valve, so as the rain drops about to meet the ground.
I see crawling petals come out of the soil, tearing down the foundation with their bodies. I can only escape, stumbling through the night and howling rains as I cling to the past shadow of you.
The scorching land permits the failure of our dreams. I lose you.
But the rain revisits here, along with the same old train.
In playbacks I see the express, welcoming me with open doors. Everything is still the same.
So I take a step forward. The door closes with a simultaneous broadcast. Am I seeing phantoms, mimicry of dizzy passengers in every cabin?
But that doesn't matter. As I find you, I ask you for permission to sit by your side. Same as you inviting me over a never-ending dance.
The answer is yes. Nothing will stop the express, not the rain nor the broken rails, until it greets the next desperate passenger.
As the Express through the Rain

Jinzhou Folklore Journal I
Jinzhou is the newest city of Huanglong. It rests on the frontier where perilous monsters lurk. Devoting all its strength, Jinzhou thrives against continuous threats and moves steadfastly on a buoyant path.
Adjacent to other cities, the Gorges of Spirits marks the throat and the inevitable gate on every route. Through Jinzhou, visitors can find their way to the entire Huanglong. Embracing such geographical pre-eminence, Jinzhou continues to enlighten poets and merchants, bringing forth inspiration and fortune.
The culture and spirit of Jinzhou all included in this book, begins with the battle in the Gorges of Spirits.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal II
In the distant past, Gorges of Spirits was known as the crawling nest of Tacet Discords. In dying will, soldiers of Huanglong safeguarded their homeland against the approaching storm of destruction. Shed blood converged into a solid dome that intercepted their enemies before they cast the final dice.
Suddenly, a long cry came from under the Gorges, shaking the ground with Loong's mighty existence. Cutting a chasm in the sky, this creature set the stage amidst an overwhelming light. As the bell clanged, a fighter with golden eyes descended, piercing a sharp blade through the Crownless. Like blares of horns support arrived from all sides, filling the battlefield with cheers and fighting wills.
After this battle, the Gorges of Spirits was appointed as the defending border, protecting Jinzhou and the people of Huanglong.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal III
The statue of Sentinel is located at the exit of the Gorges, a dominant figure and a permitted talisman standing between all chaos. The Sentinel of Jinzhou "Jué" represents one star of Qingloong, carrying a message to cleanse evil and bathe Jinzhou in its pure blessings.
Whenever a Magistrate is chosen, or every decision is about to be made, Jué will be present as a guiding hand.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal IV
The common rendezvous for the festivities of Jinzhou starts from Knell Square to the Statue of Sentinel. People pray for blessings in front of the silent statue, no matter if it's for yield or peace.
During the Spring Loong Festival, the streets of Jinzhou will be bustling with activity, filled with bouquets and drums of Liondance. Normally, people welcome it with cleaning while merchants release new products to celebrate the arrival of a brand new year.
The Midnight Rangers too follow these etiquettes. As they stand tirelessly to ward off Tacet Discords in those prevailing nights, citizens of Jinzhou could gather in joyous reunion.
Jinzhou Folklore Journal

"Here comes a beast, akin to a lion. It exudes might and intellect, embraces a human's act..."
Long ago, a recluse beast "Suan'ni" inhabited the distant jungle of Huanglong.
Legend had it these great fighters abhorred evils as deadly foes, endowing humans with generous courage. Its figure frequently led the fight troops, overwhelming enemies with great strength. One against a hundred, it disrupted the offensive Tacet Discords, hence honored as an auspicious beast and a loyal friend by its human companions.
To commemorate such success and pass down its blessings, human created the Liondance that adopted their moves into dancing footwork. To this day, the Liondance still embraces many successors among Huanglong.
This precious friendship lasted for hundreds of years hereafter.
Unfortunately, the Waveworn Phenomenon began to flourish, devouring living beings and the vibrant jungles where the connection between humans and Suan'ni moored.
Later on, rumors ruled upon the civil tongues that Suan'ni had adopted a vicious nature.
It was said that they encroached upon human territories and repelled all living creatures within their reach... And they were the harbinger of Tacet Field.
Some objected, saying Suan'ni was an early warning that protected humans from the approaching Tacet Field danger.
Difficult to tell their nature, people raised a big question mark on the existence of Suan'ni... In mere speculations, I tend to mark those evil ones as a narrow slice of Suan'ni.
As for the reason... perhaps it has possible connections to the loss of territories, struggles of power induced by depleted resources... Or the Waveworn Phenomenon should have contributed largely to their raging mutation.
As researchers achieved further discovery, it's acknowledged by most that Resonance Ability can be an acquired strength that stems exactly from one's heart. Without proper treatment, it begets destruction. In later research, it was confirmed that Suan'ni possesses a special power similar to the Resonance Ability. Even a powerful Suan'ni can "Overclock" like Resonators.
Many scientists believe Suan'ni accepted eventual extinction as they failed in the war against inner brutality.
However, I believe the survivors of Suan'ni will recall the past friendship with the human race.
Out of a natural curiosity toward legends of beasts, I decided to venture into the realm once Suan'ni resided. If anyone finds this interesting through my article, my efforts will not yield fruitless.
Next stop, the Violet Banyan.
Study on Mythical Beasts in Huanglong

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part One
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Being a courier, the most comforting sound is the early whistle of vessels arriving at the port. Every day, Port Gunchao witnesses the busiest waterways in Huanglong, transporting both cargo and stories from afar—I know all of these from Miss Lumi!
According to Miss Lumi, Port Gunchao constitutes the largest freight transportation port in Huanglong! Every cargo to Jinzhou must travel through this port! As ships rest upon the morning bank, a long whistle utters in the air, announcing the arrival of new freight and the start of a busy day.
Couriers like me must fulfill every order without mistakes as they bear anticipation from every inch of SOL3 through mountains and seas. Recently, frequent delivery requests from Tiger's Maw Mine appeared on my list. The thought excites me that I could help to convey these precious vehicles of love and voice to Shuzhou, Shaozhou, and places on the distant corners of Huanglong. 
And senior couriers in my branch told me about a fabled island located in the most faraway place on the planet. Only the brightest ones could access the mystic portal to it! If my mail could finally reach its shores, perhaps I'd earn myself the title of a valuable courier! I'm sure that I'll find the chance! Hehe!
Because our topic here is: Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today! Hmm, I nearly forgot... Address... What's the address for our next order...

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part Two
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Now that I've mentioned sounds, maybe the friction when the breeze gently laps on our uniform deserves to be on the list! I could hear the roaring gales as I ride the express car to deliver my orders. It serves as a reminder during my journey, urging me to hurry my pace with louder chants.
But please note that safety is the first on the road! Because you may bump into dangerous Tacet Discords that look pretty alike to traffic lights. Just follow the rules: red for stop and green for go, keep this in mind every time! Or you'll catch the attention of vicious monsters! No one can predict the situation around the port, since Tacet Discords are haunting us with their looming existence... It even gets worse when we have to commute between here and the obsolete port... 
Oh, that used to be a place of glamour like Port Gunchao, according to Miss Lumi. But the transportation was ruined by the sudden appearance of the fault zone. To make things worse, Tacet Discords started to pop up from nowhere... Later, the port could only bid farewell to its busy days and sink into dust. Such a waste. I think many packages are held up in the port to this day... Well, that's not what you expect of an express. I wonder if these packages could finally meet the right ends...
Maybe our new supply station will do the trick? Okay, my next workplace is settled then! Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part Three
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Continuing our topic on the sound... I don't think I can skip the strange murmurs from Whining Aix's Mire. No, those are totally INSANE!
Let me explain in detail: I've made a transfer request to the new supply station. But some Exiles lurking in the neighbors just raided our camp and robbed us blind. I can't believe this... I know these aren't just common packages, they're potent representations of feelings. Miss Lumi agrees with me. On our first encounter, I already knew her as an impressive navigator. Though young, she deals with every order with delicacy, and that allows her to locate the fastest route despite all the obstacles and rubble along the way. When she delivers a package, intact as it is, to her customers, she ends her service with a radiant smile. How sweet...
By the way, Exiles are just one subtle part of our difficulties. Take the dense fog in Whining Aix's Mire for example. It usually signifies an accompanying thunderstorm and shrill screams that bring up a ripple of sadness and... a sense of longing. That's where the navigation tends to fail as the fog gradually consumes you.
Devastating events. I can't quite picture myself overwhelmed by such dense fog and Siren sounds... Eek! I can't dwell on this. Time to get back to work and be a proud courier today!
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics!

Untitled Family Letters I
Dear Daddy, Mommy asked me to write a letter to you, but I don't know what to write because you aren't going home for a long, long time! A few days ago, Ms. Yuyi asked us to write about our own dads, but I can't pick a topic. Normal dads would take their kids out to play, treat them to lots of snacks, and tell them lots of stories, while I can't write anything because I'm forgetting your face... I can only write in my essay that my dad follows General Jiyan to fight monsters in Desorock Highland! Those monsters must be taller than the Balloon Monsters in Fiamma! But my dad can knock them out in just one blow because he is a big hero! But my classmates said I was bragging because the Balloon Monsters in Fiamma are so powerful that even Fiamma could have a hard time! But I don't know, I've never seen it... When are you coming back, Daddy? Can you take me to see the Hero Play when you're back? Just let me tag along! Mommy says I am a great helper now! I made scrambled egg rice the other day, and Mommy said she loved the taste! Come back and you can try it out! Oh and Verina gave a flower to me. She said it would last a long time. I attached it to this letter so you can see! Mommy said it's very pretty and you should take a look!

Untitled Family Letters II
I found this letter after Xiaobao went to bed.
Don't worry... Everything is fine now. Xiaobao helped me a lot. Though strange things happened under the mine, that's no sweat at all to my job. We take care of ourselves, and you should too.
You reminded me of my father, a soldier who seldom came home. I missed him so much and kept asking my mother the same question: When would he come back? But the war was escalating and those Tacet Discords were approaching our doorsteps. I remember a courier delivered a mail on a rainy day. I could tell right away that it was from my father. I came out of my room with a happy smile, when the courier paused for a conversation with my mother. Turning around, she cried over my shoulder, shedding tears upon that letter I dared not to read it myself.
I know they sacrifice a lot to drive those Tacet Discords out of Desorock Highland... and you're now suffering in bitterness at the front line. That gentle knock on the gate still chants a scary echo for me to linger upon the slightest thought that you would die like my father. So I told the couriers to leave those letters on my doorstep.
Enough of the past. Are you doing fine on the front line? Don't worry about us, you just need to do your job. We love you, as always.

Untitled Family Letters III
Worry not, dear. I'm doing fine these days. We managed to defeat a small group of Tacet Discords, while the Ministry of Development is working on some large-scale defense projects. They really know how to use their wit. We will triumph in this battle, believe me. And I miss you too, with all my body and soul.

Untitled Family Letters IV
...I don't know how to start this letter. General Jiyan, I want to say thank you. Thanks to you, his message finally reached us like this.
I recall days with him from time to time. He said someone should be the protector, even if this means sacrifices. In those distant portrayals of the battlefield, you stood unwaveringly against the enemies, supporting him and other soldiers with your might. He said you saved his life countless times. You are his icon, the best soldier who possesses a fighter's heart and a giver's will. He wants to be the same. Although he'd sacrificed his life to cover his teammates, I don't think he'd ever regretted it.
That's what you told me, that he always protects other soldiers even when facing the greatest threats, that he deserves to be a hero.
That night, I met him in a heart-breaking rainy dream that ominously resembled the day when the death of my father arrived. He opened the door, greeting me with his comeback. The early reunion obliged me to ask him: Why did you come back? I thought the war was still raging.
He replied: I just want to check if you're safe. Xiaobao is asleep, right? I'll be leaving now if everything is okay.
And then he added: Everyone on the battlefield just can't mellow out one bit when the war is drawing to an end. They're prepared to go for the killing blow.
I nodded: Just do your job and don't worry about us. Be a fearless fighter and beat those monsters. His steps paused upon a hesitant yes. I urged him to go back, and in anxiety, I met his open arms. He asked me: What if I die in the battle? What about you and Lil. Bao?
Questioned by such a dilemma, I asked in return: Do you ever regret joining the army?
He said no, not if he can protect our homeland.
"So am I." I said.
When I woke from that dream, I was visited by a sudden idea to see the Hero Play with Xiaobao. In the Theater, the heroine in Fiamma wielded a sword bravely against the Fluffernox while the stage bathed in flames. Attacked by the monster, she fell to the ground again and again. As she gathered herself from continued sufferings, tears coursed through my face. I told Lil. Bao that his father is a hero who can rival the Fiamma.
Xiaobao answered this in excitement: I want to be a hero just like him!
I promised to share all these stories with him and all living souls.
General, I would remember this till the end of life, and carve those names upon an eternal stone.
Untitled Family Letters

I received a message the other day.
Nothing special, just a message from the train station to the delayed passengers. It reads: "The Future Express apologizes to you with utmost sincerity. We'll keep our service full and complete until you reach the destination." I finished reading and deleted it, thinking "This must be a mistake by the station. I haven't traveled by train for a long time."
But this was just the beginning. I kept receiving strange messages about this Future Express now and then. I transferred them to the spam at first. I live in the moment. Those sorts of long travel and future seem out of my realm. I'm busy running errands around the mine, listening to frequent complaints from those researchers. Even a small miner like me gets a little bit nervous as the year draws to its close.
But these constant messages are killing me. Once I snatched a moment from my job to check them up and one particular piece had captured my attention (probably from a kid): "Daddy. The steward tells me to sit tight because the train is about to leave. We'll be in the future in no time! She would cast a spell that keeps us safe until the train arrives at the future. But I don't know about the future..." These words reminded me of my daughter, the same ever-curiosity when she was young. I haven't seen her in a while, though. I didn't want to disappoint this young sender with all the delay and wait. So I replied: I know the future. Future is where you get to eat Star Flakes and realize all of your dreams.
Several days later, this message thing struck my terminal again with a delay notice: "We're sincerely sorry for the delay. The Future Express will seek for soon departure while ensuring you a safe and happy journey with our best." It even ends with something like "The Future Express will meet you in the future." Another text comes right in: "When do we get to leave? Lil. You keeps asking me about this. I can only respond with empty promises, telling her that 'Soon we will be leaving for the future.' The lobby is full of anxious passengers, each clutching to an urgent desire to leave. And myself included. I received some food from a good Samaritan and that relaxed my nerves a bit. *sigh* When do we get to leave..." This looks like a message for the train station to me but somehow it reached my terminal. Glad that I had a soft time those days. Urged by a passing thought to cheer the sender, I replied: The train will leave soon. Be patient.
It never really cuts off the messages. I still receive them now and then. During a meal with my colleagues, I brought up the topic and all those intricate and haywire messages in my terminal. I sometimes felt compelled to comfort those frustrated passengers.
They said in utter doubt, that there was no such thing as the Future Express.
So I showed those messages to them and met their confused stares. The elder one of my colleagues chimed in, recalling some sort of rail station around the place in the past. It was used as an escape route during a horrible disaster. People named this train "The Future Express", carrying a message that you could ride with it until the bitter end and arrive at the future. Ages had veiled the rest of the story when they only came along the tongues of the past generations. Even he didn't know what happened later. I can't help but think, if the Future Express truly belongs to a forgotten past, then why would I receive these messages...

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: I
We conducted a comprehensive survey and inspection of the Dim Forest and have come to the decision to revive the old research site of the Forest Nature Reserve. A rearrangement and categorization of the legacy data stored inside was conducted. During this process, we even discovered seeds and specimens of some plant species that have long since been deemed extinct. These precious seeds and specimens can help us gain a better understanding of the ecological changes the Dim Forest has experienced and the impact the Lament has placed on this area. 
Next, we will perform a comprehensive survey of various resources of the Forest, such as soil, water, etc., and focus on studying the local TD population of Hoochiefs. Based on previous reports, there have been several assault cases involving these Hoochiefs. Explorers who have encountered these TDs claimed that they frequently appear in groups. With this information in mind, we require all investigators entering the Dark Forest to travel in teams and take precautionary measures when necessary. 
(Cangmin: This is information regarding the establishment of the Dim Forest’s Department of Ecology. Long after the ending of the Lament, the situation in the Forest gradually stabilized, inviting researchers to conduct studies.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: II
10:00 A.M.
Several Hoochiefs were found near the research institute. Through observation, it was found that these Hoochiefs possess group consciousness to a certain degree and perform physical gestures to communicate with each other. All personnel in the institute have been notified to maintain a safe distance with the Hoochiefs.
1:00 P.M.
Appearance of a second Hoochief.
2:45 P.M.
Appearance of a second Hoochief group. A small-scale conflict occurred between the two groups. One of the groups seemed to be covered in some kind of spores. The Hoochiefs without spores were defeated and fled the scene.
6:00 P.M.
The Hoochiefs attacked the research institute and one was captured. The institute will shelter the Hoochief.
The behavioral characteristics of these Hoochiefs will be recorded and the engineering team are requested to install bionic cameras for our research. In the mean time, the Waveband of the Hoochief will be thoroughly analyzed.
(Cangmin: Study currently at preliminary stage)
(Qiaomu: The spores were later confirmed to be poisonous.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: III
We deployed several bionic cameras to observe the Hoochief groups. The following cameras were deployed. Three in the form of bushes, two in boulders, and one in Hoochief form. The Hoochief camera was able to imitate their movements to a certain extent, but were relatively robotic and failed to perform complex actions. In this round of filming, two bush cameras were destroyed, with the boulder cameras being used by the Hoochiefs as throwing weapons, resulting in critical damage to their lenses.
The Hoochief camera continued to follow the Hoochiefs and filmed their leader. The Hoochiefs did not show any aggression towards it, but the camera was immobilized due to a malfunction in its motion systems. The Hoochiefs later performed a "burial" for it around the banyan tree.
We will sweep the area around the banyan tree and recover the cameras.
(Qiaomu: The bionic cameras really came in clutch. Real MVPs!)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: IV
The sheltered Hoochief is covered in spores emitting a red glow. Researchers who came into close contact with the Hoochief for an extended period of time exhibited signs of coughing and difficulty breathing. As a result, researchers have been restricted from making close contact. 
Days later, the Hoochief began to show signs of crazed tendencies. It continues to devastate its surroundings while scratching its own body and coughing constantly. 
Further observation of the Hoochief is required. 
Additionally, we have observed an increase in the appearances of Hoochiefs near the research institute, likely influenced by the sheltered Hoochief's frequency. This requires special attention. 
An investigation into the Hoochief leader is to be carried out as soon as possible.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: V
Feilian Beringal, Howler, Overlord Class Tacet Discord. 
Based on our studies, the Feilian Beringal resides around the Giant Banyan and is the leader of the Hoochief group. The creature maintains highly aggressive territorial behavior and will show strong hostility towards intruders. Several of our survey teams received major setbacks during their investigation of the Beringal.
The Feilian Beringal, along with the Hoochiefs under its command, are mimetic creatures capable of imitating the behavior of the apes that once existed in the Dim Forest, bearing a certain level of intelligence. they copy humans to wield simplistic tools and weapons, and will also comfort and protect their companions.
In the meantime, further spread of spore infection was observed. Hoochiefs covered in spores tend to be more aggressive. Caution is advised.
Research studies of this phenomenon are currently underway.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VI
With the assistance of the Midnight Rangers, we carried out a special operation on the Feilian Beringal. Through great efforts, we managed to put a tracking bracelet on the Beringal, which will help us monitor its movements in the forest and avoid any direct confrontations.
During this operation, we discovered that the number of Hoochiefs infected with the spores was much higher than we had initially estimated, and the rate of the spore's spread was faster than the prediction models had shown. The spores can significantly affect the qualities of surrounding soil, water resources, and other environmental substances, and cause near-irreversible damage to the human body. Given that the Hoochiefs are the source of transmission of the spores, their expulsion from the area will be put in place. However, some researchers believe that the Hoochiefs are not the source of the infection itself, and have submitted a secondary proposal to begin research on spore antibodies.
(Senming: My mentor was the one who initiated the antibody research. She placed hopes to resolve the Forest's complications through this way.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VII
Progress on the research of antibodies has been considerable. We believe a result is soon within reach.
Haste expulsion of the Hoochiefs failed to yield meaningful effects, and in turn, triggered more frequent Hoochief attacks. To minimize and avoid escalation of this situation, we've changed our approach and instead focused on sheltering the apes by helping to remove the spores from their bodies and alleviate their emotions.
We hope that this will help us to better carry out our work.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VIII
A series of complications, in forms such as Hoochief disturbances, led to the loss of the majority of our research data.
However, while scavenging for data, we were still able to witness the valiant efforts made by our predecessors on the Dim Forest.
<ano=Ecoacoustics>Ecological</ano> research is a complicated study. Topics such as finding critical entry points and how to begin our research are all topics we need to be mindful of.
Fortunately, we now have more time to ponder.

They said that if the most important person in your life is willing to fulfill this legend, your relationship will be blessed by the heavens until death do you part. Even though it may be too late for me, I hope this notice can reach young people who still have a chance to hold onto their loved ones. So please, kind lady at the Pioneer Association, share this unknown legend and perhaps someone can finally solve its mystery. ...The Weiqi pieces were scattered, but the guru remained calm. "It's getting late," he said gently to the woodcutter. "Shouldn't you be heading down the mountain?"

As he glanced at the sky, the woodcutter was shocked to see how much time had passed. "It couldn't have been more than two hours," he thought in disbelief. Feeling apologetic, he prepared to leave, worried that the guru would be annoyed with him.

But when the woodcutter turned around, he nearly jumped out of his skin. The hermit guru, who had been playing Weiqi and drinking wine, was now gone. In his place lay a shattered Weiqi board and a heap of decaying bones.
The woodcutter was so scared that he dropped his bamboo basket and ran down the mountain without even looking back.

As he reached the mountain's base, he was hit with a stark realization. The quaint village he remembered had bloomed into a bustling town, with sturdy brick houses replacing the humble thatched cottages. And where his home once stood, only an empty wasteland remained.
He noticed a date on the calendar that he had never seen before. In shock, he grabbed a passerby and urgently asked, "Excuse me, can you tell me the current date and time?"
As he heard the answer, his legs went weak. Everything had changed—time had passed and his loved ones were gone. No one remembered him anymore.
So the woodcutter left Mt. Firmament, but how was he still alive and kicking? With a hundred year's worth of time inside him, shouldn't he...
Your story... It's a bit far-fetched, don't you think? I mean, if I wasn't from Hongzhen, I might have fallen for it.
...Well! That's the whole point. The truth is stranger than fiction, my friend. Every detail in that story is based on real events.
Let me share with you the other legend of Mt. Firmament, for deep within its sacred peaks lies a powerful secret... the "Secret of Immortality"!

We all know that Mt. Firmament is the abode of the Sentinel, gathering spiritual energies from both heaven and earth for countless eons. Over time, even the mountain itself has taken on the form of our majestic Sentinel!
Living in the mountains for long stretches of time, surrounded by fresh air and drinking from nature's own bounty, can add years to one's life span!
It all starts with that game of Weiqi, one that the woodcutter stumbled upon. Too bad those secrets have been long forgotten...
Gather around now, people. You're in for the story of a lifetime...

Strange. It’s unusual for Linghan to not be outside soaking up the sun at this hour. Could she be indoors?
No response...
Something's not right. Linghan typically avoids venturing out too far as her memory isn't as sharp as it once was...
Yeah, I’ve got a weird vibe too. Let’s ask around the neighborhood.
Count on me! I practically know this area like the back of my hand. I’ll go ask everyone I can find to see if they’ve spotted Grandma Linghan.
Did she go out?
Hmm, not bad. You’ve stirred up memories of my past glory.
Linghan should be delighted to see this, don’t you think?
Let’s hurry back to show her!
Nailed it! {PlayerName}, you’re really mastering this!
We did find some Tuners! I gotta admit, I was kinda wondering why you seemed so at ease out in the wild.
But now that I know you used to be a Midnight Ranger, it totally clicks!
My captain taught me a lot... from uncovering Tacet Fields to identifying various Tacet Discords, even the places to find Tuners...
However, memories tend to play tricks as you age, so I must see it with my own eyes to be certain.
Even in the wild, I find myself relying on you young ones to help me reach my objectives.
But enough dwelling on the melancholy. As long as the Echo gets stronger, I’m content.
Ah, finally arrived. It’s just around the corner.
Sorry, but I must take a brief rest. I’m relying on you, young ones!
Hey! You’re all here!
When I heard Grandpa Jingzhu needed a hand, I zipped over here using my amazing overdashing skill!
No need to hurry. Take a moment to catch your breath, young one.
No worries, I’m bursting with energy! So, Grandpa Jingzhu, what’s the plan?
Alright. I must say, {PlayerName}’s suggestion seems quite practical. Find a subject that piques her interest and proceed gradually...
So, I’ve devised a plan to enhance the Echo. Once we make the Scythes stronger, I’ll be ready to present it to her.
Yeah, what else can we do? The Scythes is already pretty impressive. Can we kick it up a notch?
Let me share a little secret with you. There’s another valuable asset in Tacet Fields... known as Tuners!
Tuners?
Yes, Tuners have the ability to fine-tune the frequencies of Echoes, eliminating any unwanted noise and bolstering their strength!
Oh, right! It’s that round or square thing, isn’t it? How could I forget?
Our goal for today is to acquire some Tuners from Tacet Fields.
Great! For stronger Echoes! Let’s get moving!
What plan?
Hey there, it’s Jingzhu! I’m reaching out once again to ask for the help of you young folks.
As usual, I’m doing just fine!
A valiant Midnight Ranger like myself won’t be deterred by a few setbacks!
Since we last met, I’ve been pondering a more practical approach...
And I’ve finally devised one! Eager to put it into action!
Hehe, yes. I’ve thought it over and I do need the help of you young folks.
You don’t sound very enthusiastic, but it doesn’t matter. Once you arrive, you’ll be immediately convinced that my plan will work this time!
I’ll be waiting for you at the Jinzhou Theater, and that red-haired Patroller will be joining us as well.
And don’t you worry, I’ve already prepared your payment. I won’t let you work for free.
Alright then, see you later!
Alright then, see you later!
How are you?
What can I do for you?
You need help?
I see...
Sure.
Okay, fine...
At that moment, there comes the ringing of the bell.
(Linghan stretches out her hand tremblingly and accepts the Noctemint.)
Is that the Beacon? Why are there so many people?
They don't look like soldiers...

Apologies for my delay.
Thank you for accepting my invitation.
Oh? And what makes you think so?
Sorry, {PlayerName}. Jinzhou faced multiple threats back then, and we had to be cautious. We did not intend to inconvenience you. I regret our lack of hospitality.
This time... *chuckle* I just wanted to see you. The brilliant mind that always understood my unspoken words.
...I am very grateful you decided to come.
Apologies for giving you that impression, Rover. That’s not how we treat our saviors.
I merely have a few questions, and I was wondering if you may have the answers.
Does this game of <ano=Go>Weiqi</ano> look familiar to you, Rover?
...I see.
There is a local tale about the "Secret of Immortality" being hidden on Mt. Firmament. Have you heard about it?
Yes. I have a slightly different version of this tale to share.
Centuries ago, a Taoist cultivator met an enigmatic visitor on Mt. Firmament. Despite their age difference, they soon became friends and often played Weiqi together.

One day, a woodcutter stumbled upon them, having lost his way home. Their game mesmerized him so much that he didn't notice the red tie on his basket rotting away… Panicked, he bumped into the Weiqi board.

Despite the interruption, the visitor remained unfazed. They offered the woodcutter some tea, then guided him down the mountain, shielding him from dangerous Temporal Disruptions. After that, the visitor disappeared.
Many years later, the Taoist cultivator became a legendary hermit guru. Upon returning to Mt. Firmament in his final years, he reunited with that elusive visitor.
But that's how old tales go, slowly losing their truth as they're passed down.
Precisely.
The legend may be shrouded in myth, but that game of Weiqi was real. Embedded within its records lies a cryptic message: "This game record can solve the crisis of time."

From what I know, only the Sentinel in its prime has the power to manipulate time through its possession of a complete Temporal Mandate. For us mere mortals, controlling time is indeed similar to gaining immortality.
As the records state, it only reveals itself when Mt. Firmament emerges. But how it ties to the Temporal Mandate remains an enigma... at least for now.
Yes. We may find a way to heal them.
If that is the case, we’ll be able to heal the Sentinel's wounds.
But... our chances are looking slim. That game record could just hold my teacher's memories, not any real value.
So I am presenting this as merely a personal request.
I am planning to go find that record. Could you please join me?
Thank you for lending me a hand. I promise it will be worth your while.
As we have been to Mt. Firmament before, I imagined it would pique your interest, as the tale concerns our Sentinel.
And, moreover... You are special to me, and… to Mt. Firmament. I hope I have provided enough reasons to clear your doubts.
In addition… I promise to aid you in any way I can after we return with the record. How does that sound?
Very well. Let's meet on the gallery road outside Hongzhen.
I still have some preparations to do. Please go ahead, I'll join you later.
It's fine. I just got here too.
Something tells me you've been here for a while.
I see you really love your riddles.
Those tokens from Jinhsi... It was your idea, was it not?
It's okay. Jinhsi had explained your reasons.
I'm more or less used to it by now...
It's a thing of the past.
What's the deal this time? Another Tacet Discord to beat?
Let's cut to the chase. What do you want from me?
No.
...I'm not sure.
The one I heard in Hongzhen?
You mean this game in front of us?
You mean the other folklores may hold some truth too.
The Sentinel's wounds...
There might be an undamaged sample of Temporal Mandate.
Sure.
Why me?
I’ll consider it, but what's in it for me?
(A ring, she wrote... Should be this ring-shaped ancient structure, I guess?)
Wow, it’s really huge now that we look at it.
Next, hanging eaves... If we look from here... Is it that pavilion?
Hey. Why are the people here so divided about Changli?
Hmm... You humans make everything so complicated.
Well, at least now we know what she wanted to say.
Now that’s much easier to understand. Why did she have to make it a whole riddle? *yawn*... I’m getting sleepy again.
Rover?
Nice to see you again. How are you liking Hongzhen so far?

The crisis at Mt. Firmament has been resolved, and the waterway between Jinzhou and Hongzhen is open once again. As a result, there has been an increase in visitors from Jinzhou, making the town more lively than before.
With the chaos subsiding, our town and city are now reconnected, allowing residents to live and work in peace.
We owe you a debt of gratitude, Rover, for your efforts in clearing the remaining effects of Temporal Disruptions in Mt. Firmament over the past few days.
*chuckle* Of course.
We're all indebted to you, Hongzhen and its people alike. If there's anything you need, don't hesitate to ask.
I couldn't help but notice you've been asking around. Is there something you need assistance with?
(Xinyi and Changli have a mutual trust as acquaintances. It should be fine to ask Xinyi instead...)
You tell Xinyi about your encounter with Changli and what the passersby said about her.
Hmm... I see. That sounds like something Changli would do.
Even though we're not that close, I know a bit about her personality. She wouldn't just hand over something that symbolizes her identity to anyone, especially when...
I think it would be better for her to tell you personally.
The Magistrate's Counselor is shrouded in mystery, and her motives are often hard to decipher...
When she wants something done, it's never as straightforward as it seems, and few can grasp the true meaning behind her plans.
The rumors and controversies surrounding her never cease, but she seems unfazed.
However... I believe one has to get involved personally to truly understand Changli's intentions, regardless of public opinion.
About the riddle... it seems you have already figured it out by yourself.
But remember, it's not just about the answer, but also what she wants you to understand.
If there's anything else you need here in Hongzhen, please do not hesitate to let me know.
She doesn't seem to have ill intents.
We'll have to figure it out ourselves.
"Let’s meet at the highest place in Hongzhen, in the early afternoon."
It's nice. The place is bustling with life.
It's much more lively than before.
Just doing my part.
Couldn't have done it without everyone.
That job was a beast. You better have my money ready.
Well...
Especially what?
My plans exactly.
I'm very curious about her plans.
Indeed.
Uhh... How did she disappear like that? Wait, are you that legendary Rover who saved Jinzhou?!
Well, you've come to the right person! I'm here to compile a new travel guide for Hongzhen!
"Next to a ring and hanging eaves"... Oh! I know where that is. You'll need to stand on the tallest building in Hongzhen to see what you're looking for.
It's on the northeast side of the town, can't miss it. You'll see it once you get there.
Say, that person earlier... that was Lady Changli, right?! I saw you talking to her!
Of course! Everyone in Jinzhou knows about Lady Changli, even though she rarely appears in public.

As Master Xuanmiao's disciple, she excels in the arts of politics and diplomacy. Her travels have taken her across the four seas, and as Secretary-General, she has commanded respect from all who cross her path!
Yeah! And she came all the way to Jinzhou to help out Magistrate Jinhsi for the sake of peace in Huanglong. She's been working tirelessly behind the scenes since then, fully dedicated to her task...
How could anyone not revere such a selfless act?
*sigh* I could've sworn I just saw her. Where did she go? I wish I could take one more look...
Ahaha...
(Ask about the riddle in Changli's note.)
Do you know her?
Really?
Are you sure you're just here for the travel guide?
What do you want? I've done nothing wrong!
Huh? Uh... You're just asking for directions...? Sorry, I'm not a local, can't help you there.
Wait, you... you were the one talking to Lady Changli earlier, weren't you?
The young man begins looking around warily, as if in fear of something terrible hidden in the shadows.
If I were you, I'd steer clear of her. She's a deceitful woman who enjoys toying with people's hearts. A cunning villain who will manipulate you without you even knowing it.
Haven't you heard? She left her government job to come here, to this small town. There's gotta be a reason behind it.
I heard she chose to quit her job, but I bet she messed up back in the capital and got demoted here as punishment.

Then I guess you've also been fooled by her looks. That woman will stop at nothing to get what she wants, while you remain oblivious to her true intentions. And by the time you catch on, you'll already be caught in her trap.
Wait a minute, has she actually achieved anything substantial during her time in Jinzhou? Or did Madam Magistrate just fall for her clever words and let her slack off?
Hmph... I say you're underestimating Changli's trickery.
I... I have my reasons to believe so!
I heard she tricked that VIP guest of Jinzhou into going to Mt. Firmament. Just think about how dangerous that place was!

She must have been afraid of {Male=him;Female=her} getting too close to Madam Magistrate and ruining her plans... What a sinister woman! Fortunately, that guest was a skilled fighter, and {Male=he;Female=she} managed to escape unharmed.
I hope you don't mind my frankness. Just giving some advice, 'cause you look pretty innocent and gullible... Not from Jinzhou judging by your outfit, right?
Oh shoot, I completely forgot about something I need to do. Sorry, gotta run...
(Ask about the riddle in Changli's note.)
How so?
...It's not nice to badmouth people like this.
Not everyone values power and fame.
You're underestimating Jinhsi.
What makes you so sure?
I am that VIP guest.
People call me Rover.
What can I help you with?
"When snow thaw into streams"? Ah, you’re not from around here, I bet? When we say that in Hongzhen, we mean the <ano=Time Period>Shichen</ano> of Wei. Early afternoon, the warmest hours of a day.

Legend tells of a visitor who ventured here some centuries ago. Back then, local villagers were struggling with no firewood due to heavy snow. This visitor opened up a path with their Forte and diverted a hot spring to provide warmth and aid.

People say it was once a stunning sight, with mist and ice flowing westward down the streams, as if many celestial beings were returning to the sea. Now the sight has unfortunately disappeared, but the saying sticks. We use it to describe time in local speech.
Well, it's what Grandpa Zou tells everyone. I haven't seen it with my own eyes, but when it comes to stories like this one... They're usually made-up.
Hmm... Not that I don't want to believe them, but... Oh, you were listening to one of his stories earlier too, right? What did you think?
Really? So you're into stories and anecdotes too?
Looks like we have that in common.
Haha... Maybe Grandpa Zou can learn a thing or two from you in terms of humor.

Grandpa Zou's great-grandfather was a descendant of the first inhabitants of Hongzhen. He grew up hearing stories about Mt. Firmament. Recently he heard Madam Magistrate had resolved the crisis, so he decided to visit and learn more about his roots.

People in town are curious about the outside world and how they are perceived. Grandpa Zou is happy to answer their questions and has unknowingly become popular among them. Before he knew it, everyone was coming to talk to him...
It's funny to hear outsiders describe my hometown, Hongzhen, as mysterious. We're just a normal place with our own quirks...

Especially lately, with so many people from Jinzhou coming on some kind of expedition. They're obsessed with us, like we're some kind of ancient relics. Can you believe they actually asked if our Pavo Plums have magical powers?
Time truly is a formidable force...
(Ask about the riddle in Changli’s note.)
I see.
You don't believe in those stories?
It sounded interesting.
It was a bit too exaggerated.
I wasn't mentioned in the story, so a thumbs down.
And it turned into a storytelling session...
He must be a fan of that storyteller in Jinzhou.
Signs of climbing... Someone may have been here before us.
We can see the whole of Hongzhen from here.
I never noticed how beautiful it looked during my previous visits.
It's the same place as always. I suppose it's my state of mind that has changed.
I don't know. Maybe it's because... Your presence makes me feel at ease.
Wait... I smell Tacet Discords in that cave!
No... There's more... Tacet Discords, humans, and...
Smells like a whole bunch of messed up frequencies... It's so... familiar...
C’mon, after all we've been through, you still don't trust my sniffer? Be grateful, I'm giving you a warning!
Rover? Did something happen?
It's in the same direction we’re going. Could it be...
How did it change?
(How could there be any Tacet Discords in Mt. Firmament?)
(Is Abby sleep talking again?)
Tacet Discords could be assaulting people over there.
Let's go take a look.
You seem curious about that ancient structure.
It looks familiar... Like the abandoned Court of Savantae facility I saw, but bigger in scale.
I heard it first appeared along with our Sentinel. Later, the Court of Savantae based their Chronosorters on its design.
Rover, you're here.
The notes only provided a vague idea of where the game record is. I've determined the most likely location on my last visit.
We’ll be heading there. See if we can find anything new.
But one can only do so much alone. This is why I need your help.
How reliable.
Then let's get going.
I trust you’ll guide me well, Miss Wayfinder.
You've been there before?
That’s surprisingly straightforward, especially coming from you.
Lucky for you, I'm very good at finding things.
Gotta throw myself a challenge from time to time.
I'm not planning to go back on my own words.

Time flies by, anything can change, yet the Sonance Caskets shall endure...
Hmm, I wonder what’s in that crevice... and why does my alloy glow...
I really can't seem to figure it out.
Huh? Excuse me if I'm disturbing you by talking to myself.
A crevice appeared in the mine underground lately.
From the looks of it, it seemed like an entrance to some unstable Sonoro Sphere.
It isn't, though...
Not really.
However, several miners who work with my ore shop told me that with this crevice, they are afraid and unwilling to go down the mine recently.
They can easily find other jobs, but without their supply, my shop would go bankrupt.
It's a small business. If I want to stay in this game, I have to fight a price war.
And if I lose these old suppliers who offer lower prices, I simply cannot compete with those monopolies like Huaipu Mining Firm...
Let me see... well, I appreciate your kindness, but you don't have enough to keep me stocked. So keep it for yourself.
At this point, we have to figure out what’s inside the crevice...
As long as we confirm that it is not dangerous, I can convince the miners to keep working with me.
I can't believe there is someone as friendly as you...
If you can confirm the situation inside the crevice and help me get my shop back up and running, I'll be sure to thank you with a large sum of money!
You're a good person, but a businessman's reputation is on the line. Since I made a promise, I have to give you the payment.
Of course, my word is my bond.
Before you go, please bring this "Sample Alloy" with you.
It's an alloy I smelted myself. The formula is still under review...
But my goal is very clear: I will make the best-performing alloy material in the world!
Back to the point... I found that my alloy glows when it gets close to the crevice.
I don't quite understand how it works, but I have a hunch it might help you.
Right. Go on, then. I’ll wait for your good news!
A crevice?
What's going on?
Is it dangerous?
Did anyone get hurt?
Can't you find someone else for your stock?
I have some ore with me.
I can help you.
I am familiar with Sonoro Spheres.
It's okay. I didn't come here for the money.
Please pay me a lot of money.
What's this?
Then I'll take it.
You're back!
How's it going in there?
I didn't know it was so dangerous there... Are you hurt?
That's good, that's good...
Did, did it really?! How did it help you?
My alloy strengthened the bearer in this Sonoro Sphere...
I, I'm really good at smelting!
Tell you what, I'll give you some more alloys, and you help me test them in the Sonoro Sphere!
That's not the point. Two days out of business won't kill me.
Even though I'm a businessman, I have a dream.
If I can make the most powerful alloy in the world, then all the mine companies will remember my name!
Compared to that, a temporary business setback is no big deal.
Please!
There were a lot of Tacet Discords inside.
I'm fine.
Your alloy helped me a lot.
It seemed to have strengthened me.
What happened to eliminating the threat of the crevice?
What about your business?
Though I've been tweaking the recipe for my alloy, the progress of its improvement has always been limited.
I really can't compare myself with the academics and engineers at the academy who specialize in weapons materials.
But this crevice in the mine seems to have a special connection to my alloy.
Only my alloy glows near this crevice...
I was excited and scared at once.
Excited, because I felt my efforts were recognized, and my alloy was special in this Sonoro Sphere.
But I'm also scared that if the crevice disappears, will my alloy become meaningless?
Every time I think about this, I stop worrying about my business, and I even hope the crevice lasts a little longer...

I remember he went on sabbatical months ago, and he left with Fuling...
Fuling?

Oh, Fuling asked us about his whereabouts not long ago. She seemed quite worried.
Speaking of... Is he really okay? Perhaps we should get him to a hospital first...
No, I'm not going... Fuling... She's waiting for me...
Don't worry. We'll help you find Fuling.
He was attacked by Tacet Discords.
He's still unconscious...
He's one of the Pioneer Association's explorers, but we don't see him around Jinzhou too often.
W-Wuli! I.. *cough*...
Breathe. Take it easy.
*cough*... Thank you. I'm okay now. Who are you? ... And Wuli, is he...
Yes, I am... Can you please tell me what happened?
Fuling...!
Wuli... You're hurt?! I've been looking for you... You didn't pick up my calls...
Great news, Fuling! ...I found it! Finally!

...Wuli!
You carry an exhausted and unconscious Wuli to a doctor to treat his injuries.
Thank you, {PlayerName}, Lady Changli. You saved his life...
May I please ask... what on earth happened? I've never seen Wuli like that...
So... He said he only spent half a day in the mountains?
Was that not the case?
No... I've been... I've been waiting for almost a week.

It's not unusual for Wuli to be out of touch for a few days when he goes on long trips. This time, however, seemed longer than usual. If it weren't for you two showing up, I would have asked the Midnight Rangers to help me search for him in the mountains.
Wuli, he... He did it for me.
I used to work as a landscape painter. Wuli and I met through work, and we traveled to many places together.

A few months ago, I got really sick. It affected my ability to walk, which got worse over time. We couldn't go on our adventures like we used to. Wuli stopped taking on work and traveled all over the world to find a cure for me.
Despite his efforts, we couldn't find any cures... Until two weeks ago, when he brought me to Hongzhen. Said he had a surprise for me.
I thought it was just going to be a relaxing trip, but he disappeared for seven days. Now he's back, rambling about having found a way to stop my condition from progressing...
Mt. Firmament's "Secret of Immortality", I presume?
Yes... Wuli told me that he's researched and found an untouched paradise on Mt. Firmament. A place where time stands still. He said if I lived there, my condition would never worsen...
...It cannot fully cure me, but at least we can spend eternity together.
At first, I thought it was just a myth... But then you brought up how he only spent half a day in the mountains...
Those were my thoughts as well, but Wuli seemed very certain.
Mt. Firmament used to have Temporal Disruptions caused by its tumultuous history. However, thanks to Magistrate Jinhsi and Rover, these disruptions have been dealt with. Or so we had hoped.
So there are still unaddressed Temporal Disruptions in the mountains. And unfortunately, Wuli has stumbled upon one, mistaking it for the legendary cure he was searching for.
But little did he know, it would only put him in more danger.
I see...
...So that's why there were rumors of Rangers being here to take care of the leftover Tacet Discords, and block off access to the mountain...
Then... if this Temporal Disruption you speak of is truly so dangerous...
{PlayerName}, Lady Changli, please help us get rid of it. For the sake of everyone here.
He truly thinks it's the only way to save you. He's willing to take a slim chance, just for you.
*cough* I... I'm okay. I haven't talked this much in a long time.
...I'm just a little tired. I'll be fine after some rest.
Once Wuli wakes up, I'll explain everything to him.
If you have any other ideas, just tell him.
But if you keep it all to yourself... No one, even those closest to you, will know how you really feel.
...Yes. I understand.
{PlayerName}, things are taking a turn. We should probably tell Lady Xinyi first.
You must be Fuling?
I'm glad he's okay.
Well...
... And then we found you.
What's his obsession with the mountains?
He was saying something about the "legend"...
He may have run into Temporal Disruptions.
Looks like there might still be some of them.
But your friend...
I'll go get a doctor for you.
You need to rest.

{PlayerName}, greetings.
We're almost done dealing with the aftermath of the previous incident. We're currently questioning the remaining Fractsidus members we caught at Mt. Firmament.

They wanted to get their hands on the Temporal Program from the legend of the Weiqi game, with the intention of unleashing chaos in Mt. Firmament once again. But thanks to you and Changli, their plans were foiled.
Changli recounted to us that a Fractsidus Overseer had entered the Sonoro Sphere and was injured by her fire. They were lucky to escape, but have not been seen since.
I've put together a thorough report for City Hall. We will strengthen our defenses to make sure this doesn't happen again.
We parted two days ago on the coast, and then she returned to Jinzhou.
Perhaps she's just taking some time to rest and recover... It must have taken a lot out of her to summon that much fire at once.
Changli knew you’d be worried, and she wanted me to relay this message to you...
Meet her at the pavilion on Mt. Firmament. She'll be waiting for you there.
She also said... No more riddles this time.
They just don't know when to quit...
What about Changli?
I haven't seen her these days.
How is she doing?
...She's being too hard on herself.
Thank you.
How are you feeling, {PlayerName}? Well-rested, I hope.
Aww. Can't you see I'm perfectly fine, sitting right in front of you?
Don't worry, {PlayerName}. We are only having a casual conversation today. Nothing taxing.
Besides, you only agreed to join me here for more questions, right?
Oh, is that so? I'm curious then.
Sure, ask away. I'm happy to answer them to the best of my ability.
It all started a century ago, when my mentor, Master Xuanmiao, had a brief encounter with a certain peculiar visitor.

During a TD Outbreak, my master was rescued by that individual. {Male=He;Female=She} exuded a unique energy and was always elusive. My master dug through ancient texts and unearthed {Male=his;Female=her} presence in long-forgotten history.
After searching for several years, he finally met that person on Mt. Firmament again. They played a game of Weiqi together, and that was how the legendary game record came into being.
At first, I thought my master meant the game record held actual information about the time crisis. But it was just a clue. The real key was finding you, the person behind it all.
And lastly, the Secret of Immortality... It's most likely just the woodcutter's own spin on the tale.

My master and the mysterious "visitor" had set a trap with the Sonoro Sphere, using the Weiqi game as a guise. They hid it with the Court of Savantae's Chronosorters, and it would only activate once the time flow on Mt. Firmament was restored to its normal state.
Pure coincidence or the calculated workings of the Fractsidus, the explorer stumbled upon the Weiqi board, setting off its defense mechanisms.
The Sentinel was already damaged when it arrived here. My master had foreseen the disasters that would befall Mt. Firmament, so he created this mechanism as a precautionary measure.
The Sonoro Sphere would devour all who attempted to enter, unless they knew the solution to that puzzle.
Precisely.
The only way to escape was by burning the Sonoro Sphere without hurting anyone inside. It required masterful control of Forte. Thinking back, it was probably his ultimate test for me.
That was his first goal with this Sonoro Sphere.
Before leaving, Master entrusted me with a mission: To find that individual... The one who played Weiqi with him. The one who left behind that game record.
After my master's passing, {Male=he;Female=she} would be the only one who could control the Sonoro Sphere. By now, you should know who {Male=he;Female=she} is.
Yes.
That's why you needed me as your Wayfinder.
My master often mentioned you before his passing.
And from the moment you arrived in Jinzhou, I had my suspicions about your true identity. Our journey to Mt. Firmament solidified my beliefs.
And finally, the Weiqi board in that Sonoro Sphere sealed the truth for me.
Indeed... Those memories... They were all real.
Yes... That's all in the past, just a little homeless girl with no name.
I never thought we could make new memories in the Sonoro Sphere, where only the past repeats itself.
A moment of companionship and protection meant everything to me.
I can sense your unspoken question. Did I sacrifice my life when I burned down the Sonoro Sphere, like when I was a child?
What I told you there was true. But I've grown and gained control over my powers. Using my Forte now won't harm me in any way. Of that you can rest assured.
Also... If you really are the legendary person who changed the course of history, then you are perhaps the closest to immortality aside from our Sentinel.
We mortals come and go, our lives are full of meetings and goodbyes. Our time on this earth is fleeting compared to yours. So don't let it bother you.
I see. Perhaps this is why... It's so hard to leave this beautiful world behind.
Then... Would you be willing to finish that game of Weiqi with me instead?
I'm feeling great, but...
I'm more concerned about you.
I'm still a little worried.
Is Mt. Firmament back to normal?
That's not my only reason...
Indeed.
About the game record and "Secret of Immortality"...
About the Sonoro Sphere...
About the little girl in that Sonoro Sphere...
The solution? You mean burning down everything?
It also thwarted the Fractsidus's plans.
Didn't know someone could plan so much ahead...
There is a second one?
Is it me?
I think it's me.
But I don't even remember that Sonoro Sphere.
I see that's why you seemed to know a lot about me.
I saw... a little girl in the Sonoro Sphere.
I assume that was a younger version of you?
But I wasn't really there for you. Not in the real past.
If there isn't a Secret to Immortality, what about you...
I live in the moment, just like you do.
...That is not the same.

After Jinhsi's battle with the Sentinel, she ordered Midnight Rangers to patrol Hongzhen and inspect Mt. Firmament for any lingering Temporal Disruptions before reopening it to the public.
{PlayerName}, you've been exploring the mountains lately, so I'm sure you have a good grasp on Mt. Firmament. But if there are any hidden disruptions we missed...
Precisely. Yet... Why did it reappear at this point?
Fuling's "legend" differs from the situation at Mt. Firmament we're familiar with. In that tale, mortals were spared the cost of losing years from their lives.
He was utterly convinced of his discovery, and he somehow managed to run into Temporal Disruptions in half a day’s time. Also… when I questioned him, he evaded my inquiries.
Lies that are most challenging to detect aren't usually outright falsehoods, rather they hide parts of the truth.
The explorer wanted to save his friend indeed, but he was also hiding something.
...I've become rather curious about the truth behind this "Temporal Disruption."
Did you notice something, {PlayerName}?
For someone with a terminal illness, they should hold onto any chance of survival—no matter how slim... Is that what you think?
Maybe she's come to terms with her destiny, or maybe... she never planned on continuing to live like that forever.
Changli...
...Well, please pardon my baseless speculations.

... As Changli mentioned, this anomaly may indeed have something to do with that legendary game record.
Exactly... If this were to be the case, then we are not the only ones searching for its whereabouts.

But his knowledge of Mt. Firmament far exceeds that of a first-time visitor.
You mean...
Got it. The Midnight Rangers will block all entrances to the mountain for now. And Changli, you still have the power to send in garrison troops as needed.
We left Mt. Firmament in a hurry. I need to go back up the mountain and investigate further... I have some theories that could use confirmation.
We're still unsure about the exact location and range of the Temporal Disruption. Regardless, its reappearance is a pressing issue that needs our attention.

Well then... Thank you, {PlayerName}.
Thank you again for your help. You were supposed to be here for a relaxing time... but it seems another crisis has popped up.
Do take extra caution.
There's been a bit of an incident.

He was hiding something.

Why did she want to get rid of the Temporal Disruption?
About the anomalies in that area...
The complete Temporal Program indicated in that game record...
Something bigger is behind all of this.
We need more information. Let's not act rashly.
I'm coming with you.
I haven't fulfilled my promise yet.
Then having another person onboard makes it less dangerous.
Now it has become quite clear what the two were thinking.
I had my speculation.

Fuling has come to terms with her impending death. She doesn't buy into the legends of "immortality." Instead, she simply wants to make the most of the time she has left and fulfill her and Wuli's dreams together.
If Wuli wants to reach that so-called "paradise," he'll be trapped inside forever. It also means he'll have to give up his entire future as an explorer.
That is not what she wants for him.
Her ultimate desire is for her lover to embrace her inevitable passing, and to realize the joint aspirations they hold in her place.
She hasn't given up, but rather clings to hope for their future, even if she won't be there to see it unfold.
Hmm...? Why the sudden question?
Is that how you see me? Hmm... Perhaps for some, death is just a destination. There are more significant things to focus on.
I'm just making an educated guess from what we've collected. And honestly, Fuling isn't exactly good at keeping things to herself.
Let's stay focused on the issue. While the diary is cryptic, it still exposes the true intentions of whoever misled Wuli.
It's no coincidence. All the clues point to a correlation between the Temporal Disruption and the legends of the Weiqi game. Or maybe... someone's trying to make us connect the dots.
Yes. Information on the actual powers of Jué... This isn't the kind of information an ordinary explorer can obtain.
I guess our "old friends" have still not given up.
They went to great lengths just to lead us here. It would be rather rude of us to not respond in some way.
According to the information in my master's notes, and Wuli's map...
...The place we're looking for should be just ahead.
So this is what she had on her mind...
Did you know about it all along?
Would you make the same choice... If it had happened to you?
It seems you don't care that much about your own death.
You seem to understand Fuling deeply.
Wuli's diary mentioned the Sentinel.
Traces of excavation on the ground... Looks like someone was trying to dig a hole with their bare hands. Could it be Wuli?
This is... a Weiqi board.
The abnormal time flow here is most likely caused by the Chronosorters. Perhaps there is a way to fix it.
Could it have anything to do with the game record?
Marvelous play, truly remarkable. Occupying both solid territory and influence. An extraordinary move.
Never have I imagined I'd experience such a great game of Weiqi on Mt. Firmament. You may look young, my friend, but there's so much more to you than meets the eye.
Please, no need to be so modest. I can tell the difference between our skill levels.
...This is my master's voice. The voice of the other person seems deliberately erased.
Who do you think the other person looks like?
Changli seems to be in deep thought and does not answer.
A mirage of the past...
Master Xuanmiao?
That person looks familiar.
That person looks like... me?
Is this why you brought me here?
It has been decades since we last met, but you, my friend, still look the same.
Turns out I had already met you all those years ago, my life saver… and you're older than me. I should have been more respectful back then.
So you remember our promise. I am overjoyed...
A new city is about to be established. Having accomplished so much, why do you choose to retire now?
...I may have spoken out of turn. If you're not in a rush to depart Jinzhou, how about another round of Weiqi with me?
*cough*... Well played. Even after twenty years, I still have no chance of winning against you.

My clan are a group of hermits. We view the world as a game of strategy, manipulating the ebb and flow behind the scenes...

When the time comes... the one who shall finish this game of Weiqi with you will not be me, but rather my apprentice.
Do my plans seem too risky to you?
No need for concern. With her intelligence and quick thinking, she'll surely be able to solve this puzzle.
The result of this game will decide the fate of Jinzhou, and even the entire world.
The road ahead is long and treacherous... Our final game, let's make it...
You've come this far and followed us here, yet you hesitate to reveal yourselves. Guess I'll have to take the lead and extend an invitation.
...Don't assume you'll always be in control, Changli.
Our friendly chat is over. It's time to say goodbye.
Enough talk.

Your unwitting trail has led us straight to our target.

I lost all contact with you during this whole time. Did you run into any trouble?
Temporal Disruption hidden inside a Sonoro Sphere... It makes sense now why it stayed hidden for so long.
I never thought the solution would be to burn down the entire Sonoro Sphere from the inside...
You went too far back there, Changli.

..You once predicted a destined battle between us... Is it true?
Correct.
...I was lost at first, struggling to grasp the prophecy's meaning. Only when I learned of your actions alongside the Court of Savantae did it all become clear—

By clashing two resonating powers, a Second Resonance Awakening can be induced. Through this, I am able to push my Resonance Ability beyond its limits and invoke the Temporal Mandate to restore the flow of time.
...Though I will be forced to raise my blade against you...
RIDICULOUS!
If you clash with my Resonance power, even the smallest mistake will result in Overclocking and leave you nothing but an empty husk.
You are well aware of its excruciating effects. The pain you feel now is but a faint scratch in comparison to its true torment.

Jinhsi, you are given one last opportunity. Let me freeze the time, and I can ensure your safety.
There must be another way.
What if I help her? I am here for a reason.
Is there really no chance for her to live?
You are only here to witness before the right time arrives.
But you are not compelled to remain idle. Should you intervene, we may augment Jinhsi's odds of survival by a fraction.
Command me to transfer my Temporal Mandate access to Jinhsi at the right moment.
—The moment of her Resonance Ability's depletion, when she is teetering on the brink of Overclocking and near death. Then, we may still save her life.
Miss that moment by even the slightest margin, and Jinhsi's fate will be sealed.
...It is this one's own doing, and one must put an end to it.
This entrance leads to one's Sonoro Sphere. Magistrate Jinhsi, one shall await you there.

...If I open it, Jinhsi is bound to face you in the ultimate battle.
Though... if I do nothing, you'll use your remaining power to freeze all of Jinzhou in time.
I will open the entrance once you're ready.
There will be no turning back...
I have been preparing for this moment.
I understand. I have made up my mind since before I stepped foot on Mt. Firmament.
Leaving Jinzhou behind fills me with regret, knowing I may never again bask in its glorious sunshine or witness the purity of its snowflakes.
Our city has a rich history, with generations witnessing endless sunrises and sunsets at the border. Our people have sacrificed their blood and tears to protect Huanglong's safety.
They deserve a bright future.
I want to protect Jinzhou in my own way, as Jinhsi, as a citizen of Jinzhou, and as Jinzhou's Magistrate.
{PlayerName}, let's begin.
Correct.
Now, please let us know your choice.

Every ounce of my existence, from life to death and even the passing on of power, is subject to your approval.

Jinhsi has fully assumed the mantle of leadership. From this day forth, one shall only offer aid when it is truly needed.

To accomplish her goal, Jinhsi must possess both strength and confidence. Revealing the truth to her earlier would only add to her troubles and not aid in improving her abilities.

For lack of a better solution, this is the best we can do.

Yes... It's me.
I've lived in Jinzhou my whole life and never ventured into Hongzhen, yet even I know of the legend.
To me, Jué is more than just our Sentinel or a revered divine being... It raised me and saved me from certain death.
I've been thinking about it on our way here.
If the Sentinel predicted our fight, why would it even bother saving me in the first place?
...In our Sentinel's prediction, the battle between us is supposed to happen in the distant future.
It had been waiting for an opportunity, a right moment to tell me the truth. That's why it didn't explain.
Now may not be the opportunity the Sentinel has been waiting for, but my body cannot hold up much longer...
I have to go and face it while I still can… to learn about the truth, or complete our destined battle.
As your friend, I don't want to see you suffer.
Give up... my duty? I never thought about it...
To be honest... I did doubt myself many times.
It was the endless kindness of you, Changli, Xinyi, and everyone in Jinzhou that gave me the courage to push on.
Even Jué's decision to bring me back to life... Whether out of pity or not, I am truly grateful. The thought of it warms my heart every time.
Jinzhou holds everything that's dear to me. Even without the title of Magistrate, I could never leave Jinzhou behind.
The pain I'm feeling is nothing compared to those trapped in the Temporal Disruptions.
I must find the Sentinel as soon as possible. We draw from the same source of power—saving it means saving myself.
Do you have to fight the Sentinel?
Then I will have to fight it. I refuse to back down.
But let me make one thing clear—I am not planning on dying yet. I am here to fight for a chance at survival, no matter how slim that chance may be.
I trust your decision.
The "deceased infant" here, is it...
Now I understand why. Because I am the Sentinel's Resonator. I may not have any extraordinary abilities, but I do possess the Temporal Program that it accidentally lost.
If Jinzhou ever faces a similar time crisis, I... I might be the only one who can set things right.
You can still give up.
But you're in pain...
I'm okay...
If there is truly no other option in the end...
I will fight. To protect the Sentinel, and to defend Jinzhou. One life may be lost, but many will be saved.
If it means keeping everyone safe, then I have no regrets giving my own life.

It's a fitting name, isn't it?

Monitoring Report on Abnormal Spectrum Performance of C-001

Title: Spectrum Anomaly Monitoring Report for Subject C-001

Entry: #H-C-6947

Abstract:

The data presented in this report were obtained from spectrum evaluations performed on Subject C-001, also known as "Jué," from June ████ to December ████.

During a preliminary experiment conducted on June 14th, ████ researchers observed a 15-second frequency loss in Subject C-001's spectrum. Five additional tests were later conducted through the following day, and all data obtained reflecting the frequency loss were highly consistent (Margin of error averaged below 0.02).

The recorded data of the Resonance Spectrum on the 3rd, 6th, 11th, 23rd, and 30th of the subsequent month indicated a gradual lengthening of Subject C-001's frequency loss. The data exhibited significant increases with varying patterns. It was postulated that this event occurred due to the presence of Subject C-002, also known as the "Mianloong Chamber." Subsequent thirty-two one-factor experiments confirmed a significant correlation between Subject C-002 and the duration of frequency loss in Subject C-001. Notably, Subject C-002 exhibited an inhibitory effect on the duration growth of Subject C-001.

Based on spectrum monitoring data of Subject C-001 from June ████ to December ████, the following preliminary conclusions can be drawn:

1. Subject C-001 bears defect/malfunction.
2. Subject C-002 can temporarily slow down the escalation of Subject C-001's defect, but cannot make up for Subject C-001's frequency loss.

Appendix-1 (Source: Research Memo #C349)

With the help of the "peculiar visitor", we were given the opportunity to converse with Subject C-001 directly. It was a meaningful and mutual conversation, though we didn't get as much information as I had hoped for.

But at the very least, the conversation proved one point: Our previous research was effective, and there was no defect in C-001. As per C-001's own declaration, "One of the Temporal Programs was lost," and during its prime, C-001 had the capability to manipulate time by decelerating or even halting it, rewinding it, and making corrections as needed. Nonetheless, the current condition of C-001 can be described as one of sickness, with irreversible disruptions to time rendering any attempts at correction or restoration ineffective. Consequently, Mt. Firmament has been transformed into an isolated entity amidst the vast oceans of time, despite the initial purpose being one of redemption.

Appendix-2 (Source: Research Memo #C382)

By running through time flow models, we came up with two hypotheses:

Hypothesis #1: C-001's "defect" is none congenital, and this "defect" may have taken place around the period of C-001's first arrival at Mt. Firmament (it has been confirmed that the "defect" cannot be reversed, see report #H-C-7426).

Hypothesis #2: The discrepancy in temporal progression between the interior and exterior of the "time bubble" has been progressively widening. Based on data comparisons, there exists a correlation between the deceleration rate of time flow in Mt. Firmament and the growth rate of the duration of C-001's frequency loss.

Expanding on the second hypothesis... If C-001 were to eventually cease to exist, the uncontrolled flow of time in Mt. Firmament would likely surpass its limitations and impact a broader range of regions… Such as, the entirety of Jinzhou.

…This might be why that "peculiar visitor" offered to work with us in the first place…

Appendix-3 (Source: Research Memo #C457)

Efforts are being made to advance the development of the artificial Resonance Object. Although we have not yet achieved success, we have decided to name it the "Chronosorter" in honor of our recent progress.

I know we have our "peculiar visitor" to thank for every progress we've made so far. If the "Chronosorter" project is successful, it's a win-win for everyone involved. As I had anticipated, they intend to restore and utilize C-001's complete power in order to rectify the temporal distortion, with the aid of a Resonance Object.

There is still a significant journey ahead of us. This is merely the starting point.
