Welcome... I wish I could extend a warmer greeting, but Patty has run into some technical difficulties and we cannot accept new wishes at Moontree Lodge until I resolve the issue.
I apologize for the inconvenience... I would be glad to take note of your wish and have it prioritized once everything is resolved.
There's so many I don't know what to pick...
I can't think of any on the top of my head...
My wish is for everyone's wishes to come true.
Take your time. We still have a little while before the Moon-Chasing Festival.
...Speaking from my own experience, of course. Feel free to do as you like.
How intriguing... In that case, I promise to do everything I can to make your wish a reality at the festival.
For now, I must concentrate on restoring the Moontree Lodge as quickly as possible.
In a nutshell, it appears Patty's malfunction is more than a straightforward data error.
At first, I suspected an overload of Patty's analysis module due to an accumulation of wishes over the years.

Additionally... although it was only for a brief moment, I detected abnormal frequency fluctuations after connecting Patty to my Terminal. In theory, a robot's data should not generate such fluctuations.
Did someone tamper with the wishes?
Then everyone's wishes...
It's too early to draw a conclusion just yet, but I can't leave the matter unresolved.
It'll only be a matter of time before all the wishes stored in the Moontree Lodge are devoured by this abnormal code.
Xiangli Yao pulls out a tablet showing you four indecipherable files.
Why is it all gibberish?
Are these... wishes?
I've isolated the four wishes with unreadable codes, pinpointing the source of the discrepancies.
I see... Why don't you take a tour around the Vale? Jinzhou is filled with festivities during this time, and losing yourself in the crowds could very well bring your wish into sharper focus.
What's wrong with the Moontree Lodge?
However, during my recent testing, I discovered unusual codes embedded within Patty's database. Like a virus, they spread drastically with the addition of each wish.
I plan to track down whoever made these wishes, try to fulfill them, and uncover the root cause of these anomalies.
But before that, I need to try to decode the wishes corrupted by these anomalies...
To minimize data loss, it would be best to complete this a week before the Moon-Chasing Festival. With careful planning...
Sounds like a difficult job.
It does have its challenges, but everyone's hopes and dreams for the festival are in these wishes. I don't intend to let them down.
(Yes, Yangyang and the rest... have set their hearts on this festival.)
Anything I can do to help?
I appreciate the gesture... but I wouldn't want to trouble you.
I don't want people losing their wishes.
I'm still counting on you to make my wish come true!
I see. Thank you, {PlayerName}. Well, then... The Moontree Lodge welcomes its newest member!
Seems we have a new friend now, Patty.
{PlayerName}, Xiangli Yao, and Patty. Wishes come true. Organize Moonlit Fair...
Organize the Moonlit Fair?

Yes. The Lodge opens to the public before the Moonlit Fair, but it still remains an important element of the festivities. The market vendors like to tailor their offerings according to everyone's wishes.
There will be many interesting activities on the day of the Fair, and preparations are well underway. Perhaps some of your friends will be among those attending?
If you're interested, you can go and take a look yourself.
Thanks for the info.
I'll check it out if I have the time.
Been tossing and turning all week. Can't switch off these thoughts at night... I can't take it any longer.
Been scrolling through the forums lately? There's this thing blowing up called "Nighttime Blues Syndrome" on the Huaxu Hive.
(Definition of noun: "Nighttime Blues Syndrome"—A popular term used to describe the state of today's youth that have lost their enthusiasm towards life due to excessive work and life stress.)
(Symptoms include avoiding social engagements, reluctance to work, insomnia, and signs of depression.)
(Further analysis reveals an 87% correlation between the syndrome's traits and the emotional state of "Xiaosheng," inferred from the wish made at the time.)

A few colleagues from other departments even used it as an excuse to ask for leave yesterday. They wrote, "The world is such a wonderful place, filled with different kinds of sadness to experience each day."
Eh...Lucky bastards. Taking time off whenever they want. And look at us, sweating bullets over research with no results in sight. How are we supposed to sleep?
Is that the latest thing? You know I don't usually visit those forums, but this term... Maybe it's because everyone's feeling the pressure lately.
Relax, take some time off. You can leave the rest of your work to me. Don't let it get into your head. Smile, and everything will be A-okay.
Hmph, you sure are optimistic at a time like this.
Anyway, I really need to pass out for a while. She's all yours.
With heavy steps, the researcher heads back inside the Academy.
Um. Hello... Were you listening to our conversation the whole time? Anything I can help you with?
There's something we'd like to ask.
Wait a second. It's you, isn't it...? The one who sucked in a Tacet Discord with your bare hands... {PlayerName}?!
In the flesh.
I didn't expect to meet you at a place like this... Are you here for something? Is it about the monsters? Or maybe Ech... No, never mind...
Do you know anyone going by "Xiaosheng"?
..."Xiaosheng"? A pretty average name, if you ask me. But I've never heard of anyone with that name at the Academy. Can you... provide any extra information?
Uh, maybe I can help you find him.
Searching "Nighttime Blues Syndrome" and "Xiaosheng" as keywords. There are 417 relevant results found.
Search results consist of forum posts made under the username "Xiaosheng." Example result: "Another crappy day today..."
Wait a minute, analyzing someone's online behavior without their consent is a violation of robotics protocols!
Searching protocol... Confirmed. Violation of protocol detected... Xiangli, I'm sorry. Initiating self-destruct sequence...
Now's not the time for jokes, Xiang-LEE.
Apologies.
Xiang-LEE does that sometimes. I hope you don't mind.
Sorry, Xiang-LEE was just trying to lighten up the mood...
Hahaha. Its creator gave it some good features. It's fine. But do you mind me asking... why are you looking for Xiaosheng in the first place?
This question involves the individual's privacy. We are unable to disclose any details to those not directly involved.
I understand... Speaking of which, this robot looks rather familiar. Could it be from the Moontree Lodge by any chance?
How did you figure that out?
I'm afraid that's confidential.
I see... I heard that making wishes at the Moontree Lodge tends to come true. I was thinking of trying it out myself at some point.
Ah, got it, got it.
Hmm... it's almost time to set up the centrifuge. I need to make my way back and check on the samples.
You notice Shifan appear a bit flustered for a moment, but he quickly returns to his easygoing and friendly demeanor, politely bidding you farewell.
No information was obtained regarding Xiaosheng's identity. Acquired new keyword.
"Nighttime Blues Syndrome" I guess?
Yes, we can always check the forums for any updates later.
Now then, let's try our luck somewhere else.
Well, it's obvious just by looking at the two of you. That robot you have there is from the Moontree Lodge, right? I may not look the part, but I am an actual researcher.
My name is Jiuli. Xiaosheng's my friend, and I know who he really is.
And as a matter of fact... you've already met him.
You mean Baizhe?
You mean Shifan?
No... it's Shifan.
Precisely. So you already guessed it.
He probably realized who you were as well. Explains why he made up an excuse and left in a hurry. Hmm... still running away from his problems, by the looks of it.
He seemed different from the Xiaosheng in the wish.
I was just as surprised as you were when I first found out that "Xiaosheng" was actually Shifan. The two of us grew up together, went to school together, and entered the Academy together.
He's always been the center of attention, easygoing, always fitting in effortlessly...
But at some point in time, he started writing these negative posts on the forums. It didn't take me long to figure out "Xiaosheng" was him. I know his writing style too well.
Every time I asked him, he'd always wriggle his way out of it. And... he started distancing himself from me and even transferred himself to another project team.
Jiuli pulls out his Terminal and shows you a picture of him and Shifan. You notice his hand trembling slightly.
Your hand...

Oh, that's from an accident during an experiment involving Echoes a while back. It wasn't too bad, but it did leave a few symptoms. I haven't been able to operate any precision instruments since then.
At first, I thought that maybe Shifan started distancing himself from me because I couldn't continue to work on his project anymore. But deep down I knew he was not that kind of person.
So... I have a request.
I want to know what kind of wish he made... And if possible, I want to help make it come true. I want to know what happened to him.

Comm's dead? Don't worry. It happens a lot around here.
The Black Shores sits atop a massive Tacetite, wreaking havoc on standard communications.
Once we reach the Greenhouse, you can patch them in near our beacon.
Only our beacons can cut through the Tacetite's interference.
Yes, we received word from Jinzhou's City Hall about their actions. We also alerted them to the Tethys System's likely warning of a potential Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
The data you brought back has been uploaded to the system, but as you know, Tethys has been unstable.
It could have been much worse if they hadn't risked their lives to transmit the coordinates back to Niya. And thank you for risking your life to retrieve the data.
What's the current situation?
Easy there. Let's get back to business.
The recent quake's stirred up Tacetite's interference. How's your underground connection holding?
Rock solid. As long as Tethys is up, we're wired tight.
That's comforting. Hey {PlayerName}, you can give the abnormal frequency to KU-Money. They'll handle the upload.
You hand over the card Youhu gave you to the peculiar robot.
This a new rookie? You've got skills if you snagged that abnormal frequency from Port City of Guixu. Better not underestimate you.
How's the upload? Already sent the data back to Tethys?
Yeah, all done.
Since you're linked to the Tethys' data bank, can you check if there's a Bloom Bearer named Hoda registered?
She seems to be able to control gravity.
She referred to herself as a "we."
A Bloom Bearer whose Forte is controlling gravity… I've checked all records of both Resonators and Bloom Bearers, but I didn't find anyone matching your description.
Oh, almost forgot.
Here, take this!
KU-Money is right. Just in case, the Tethys System is very likely to send out a warning to Jinzhou about an imminent Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
KU-Money takes out a large sum of money…
Each Black Shores member is allocated a specific fund, and this is yours. Find me when you burn through it all.
That's not fair. You've never given me that much before!
I deducted the money you lost to me in games. It was all you had left!
Oh, by the way! Are you heading to the Greenhouse?
If a Bloom Bearer dies outside the Black Shores, we bring their body back and keep Monica in the loop.
As for the Tethys System, imagine it as a supercomputer. The Black Shores relies on its calculations to observe, forewarn, and solve anything Lament-related.
What's going on, Aalto? I never see you this serious.
The Tethys System has been shaky lately. You've noticed, right.
What's worse, along with the data, we received some terrible news. The Bloom Bearers we sent to the Port City of Guixu… We lost them all.
H-how did that happen!?
What happened in that city…
She might have something to do with the deaths of our people.
Oh, we need to send out a warning as usual. There's still a lot to do...
…{PlayerName}! Finally got through…
Hey, you scared us to death!!!
Sorry, the Tacetite's interference was too strong.
I'm in the Black Shores now.
Glad to know you're all right.
Chixia, is that you?
Yeah! Just so you know, we got the Black Shores' warning, so we cranked up the defenses in Jinzhou.
As for the Bloom Bearers who have passed, we'll bring their bodies back to the Black Shores.
I know the Black Shores hold many answers for you—your memories, your past…
Though the road ahead is uncertain, I hope you find the truth you seek.
And please remember, you never have to bear the weight alone... I... We are here with you. Always.
The Midnight Rangers are preparing to secure the Port City of Guixu, and…
Hey, what's on your mind?

Not bad, I guess?

You've come just at the right time, friend. I just got my hands on an antique.
It seems tied to a legend about Mt. Firmament, but the records have been lost over the years.
Now if you're interested, why don't you take a look at it for me?
Is this... a creation of the Court of Savantae?
Ha, you've got a keen eye! This is indeed a CSC creation. A key specifically, I think. As for what door it opens and how it works, that's beyond my knowledge.
Rover, you are the one who have solved countless puzzles left by the CSC. I wonder how this strikes you.
It looks like two parts that can fit together.
It does, and I've tried doing so, but it made no difference. Nothing special came out of it.
You can still try that yourself, though. Things might turn out differently.
Fit the two parts together.
As you fit the two parts together, the assembled antique lets out a "click," and projects a miniature image.
Oh? How fantastic. Looks like it's connected with you.
The projection seems to be a map. It points to... the Tianqu Tree, and has a note beside it, "Woodveil Hall."
Tianqu Tree... That giant, dying wood?
Precisely. I've also heard about this while I was in Hongzhen a few days ago trying to buy some good stuff.
In its prime, Tianqu Tree was luxuriant and worshipped as a protection of Hongzhen.
However, it started withering away in the late episode. The whole of Hongzhen pities.
Maybe Tianqu Tree's fate is sealed... Anyway, this key is yours, my friend.
Mine?
Really? For free?
I am a merchant, that's for sure, but I think I told you this when we first met...
...I'm not stingy when it comes to money. It's more about serendipity and belief.
This key looked so ordinary in my hands, but now, its connection to you is clearly revealed.
In that case, why should I lock it away in my cabinet and make everything it stands for remain a mystery?
I cannot betray my belief simply out of greed. So take it, friend.
Got it.
I will bring back the story behind it.
Ha. That sounds proper. Then I'll wait for your story.
Arrived at the target security node. No traces of TD found. Speculation: The node is yet to discover for TDs.
Now, we have to manually close up the energy circuit to power the security node.
Caleb, tell me what Woodveil Hall was built for.
...Sorry, I can't find the relevant data. Please consult a researcher with a higher access.
Searching for the researcher payroll... Sorry, no valid results found in the database.
Security node back online.
Well done, Rover.
Mutiple Tacet Discords detected... On your guard, Rover. They have spotted us.
We must buy the time for the node to reboot, or we are doing this in vain.
Suggestion: Freeze time with the Chronopin to hinder the enemy and help our mission.
Self-test complete.
We are ahead of schedule. Everything will be fixed soon if we keep the pace.
"Chrono Sign" detected. Confirming identity... Welcome, ████ Civilization ██... Data error found. Searching secondary databases... Hello, Rover.
You... know me? Who are you?
You fit the descriptions in the profile titled "Rover." Minor date discrepancies are ignored.
I am Caleb, a research assistant AI created by the CSC. You now have the supreme authority over Woodveil Hall Laboratory. Best of luck with your research.
Interesting. Security node here is still running... Accessing log.
TDs triggered the security node here. Prepare for combat, Rover.
Confirming node status...
Backup energy ready. Available for activation.
Great. All nodes are back online.
Planning route... This way, Rover. A shortcut back to the Prototype Chronosorter.
What a fantastic sight, Rover. I'm sure the frequency of this tree was... faint until just now.
Analyzing... It appears the Prototype Chronosorter has positively impacted the local ecology, besides rewinding the time for the equipment in Woodveil Hall.
It wasn't designed for this. It seems more like an accident, caused by unknown factors.
It didn't resurrect the dead or grant immortality to the living, but it did reverse what should be a natural cycle of life.
It's a pity my creators aren't here to witness this.
Did you remember who they were?
Yes, Rover. My memory data has been corrupted over a long course of time. I've even lost their names.
But since you restored Woodveil Hall, the data has... somehow come back to me.
I thank you on behalf of the Research Director Prof. Bram S., Junior Researcher Victor Christopher, and the other thirty-three faculty members.
I thank you for restoring the Lab, despite the failure of their research. You have given me the chance to continue their work and finish what they started.
Whether it takes a century or even a millennium... I will continue this work. It is my mission, and it is Victor's wish.
Actually, their research was successful.
Their efforts didn't go fruitless.
You tell Caleb the event at Mt. Firmament, and make clear the role Chronosorters played.
So you're saying, the Chronosorters did save Mt. Firmament. Is that true, Rover?
A tiny seed...
...Has grown into a majestic tree.
So it all paid off... Please forgive me Rover, what I'm feeling right now is beyond the capacity of my emotional module.
Some of the researchers... grew doubtful of their work, thinking it was mission impossible.
While those who stayed left this world with regret and unfulfilled wishes.
Now it becomes all clear... Their work wasn't in vain. They would feel relieved too, if they were to learn this.
Thank you Rover, for telling me all this.
You mission is complete, Caleb.
Maybe... With the supreme authority in hand, you are now in the place to determine my tasks going forward.
Suggestion: You may instruct me to continue the research here. Many mysteries around Mt. Firmament remain unsolved. I'm confident we'll uncover the truth one day.
Go on then, if that is your wish.
You may have your well-deserved rest.
Order received... Thank you.
I'd like to observe this tree for a bit longer, Rover. My work began the day it was just a seed.
And now... it has become the shelter of the whole Lab. How time flies...
How was your adventure, friend? I presume you have learned the secret of the key.
I'm uplifted.
I'm a bit upset.
Ah, I can tell by your look that you've met something extraordinary.
Yes, I did.
The story I heard was impressive.
Oh? Then why don't you share it with me, now that neither of us is in a hurry?
You tell Chenpi the event.
An AI left by the CSC? And it's been continuing the research its creator wanted, all these years since they passed away?
This isn't the weirdest story I've ever heard, friend, but it is... intriguing.
Don't overthink. Tragedy or comedy, it's always part of destiny.
Keep this key, friend, as a reminder.
Thank you.
That's nice of you.
Haha! Just bring me some more good stuff next time!
Apologies, Rover. Maintenance devices are severely damaged here. Deicing the slope is impossible.
Skiing is recommended.
Rover, as you might have noticed, some areas in Woodveil Hall are blocked with rocks for security reasons.
You can lift them by freezing the time around them with the Chronopin here.
Access to the Chronopins is granted to your Terminal. Feel free to check the tutorials anytime.
Well done, Rover. You have found the trick to this.
Please proceed carefully through the tunnel below, as I am unable to shut down the light-beam defense system due to a connection failure.
My creator, Victor, was thrilled with these rocks. They seemed to somehow... fulfill some of his childhood dreams.
Victor...?
...Sorry. I can't retrieve relevant information since my database is down. I'm not sure why I mentioned that name.
Some Tacets Discords have broken into the Woodveil Hall lately, disabling the security nodes around.
Worse still, even the energy core was damaged, and I can't fix it... Luckily, you are here now, Rover.
A Prototype Chronosorter is deployed at the heart of the lab. Once activated, it will restore the entire facility.
This is the Prototype Chronosorter. Despite its designation, it was actually a blueprint, which the CSC kept building upon.
As you can see, it is bonded to the energy core of Woodveil Hall.
The tree roots surrounding the energy core belong to the massive tree above Woodveil Hall. Some of the energy emitted from the core nourishes the tree.
However, the damage caused by the TDs to the energy core has led to excessive energy leakage, which is killing the organism... If this continues, the tree is estimated to perish in 10 days.
As you press the button on the Prototype Chronosorter, nothing happens.
Running system test... Bad news, Rover. The Chronosorter is locked due to potential security risks within the facility.
We must reboot and repair all the security nodes in the facility before the Chronosorter can be activated.

We've also detected the Shorekeeper's presence within these Matrices. She's been recovering the affected frequencies.
Once it's completed, the data overflow from the Tethys System will cease.
You place the Necrostar on the analyzer...
Stellar Matrix confirmed. Classification: Necrostar.
Would you like to start the remodulation?
Yes.
Loading backup data from the Necrostar. Simulating the Port City of Guixu...
It's the city destroyed by the Necrostar...
Backup data loaded. Please confirm.
That's the digital entrance of the Matrix! It worked!
So to complete the remodulation, just enter the Matrix and collect Tethys' redirected data.
Please wait.
The Tethys System now uses less of my computational power since the Necrostar was controlled.
I can assist you, {PlayerName}. Please, let me come with you.
...I must keep my promise.
Are you feeling okay now?
It's fine, I can link with more Sonoro Spheres to stay functional.
My duty must be fulfilled as long as I still physically exist.
I'll be fine. From now on, no one will ever be harmed.
Please, trust me.
She's been watching over us all along...
We'll bring her back, no matter how long it takes.
Ma'am, we've pinpointed the Shorekeeper's location in Tethys!
And not just her, we've identified the relative positions of everyone captured by the black hole beyond the event horizon!
To rescue them from the Necrostar, we'll have to redesign it using the principles of the new world.
In other words—
We must fight against the Tethys System.
But the Tethys System's programming is impeccable, almost otherworldly... Is it really possible to do that?
Besides, we still need a decoy with the highest-level access to divert its computational power so we can find the Shorekeeper.
I'll do it.
No, it's too risky!
We can't be sure if the rescue will suceed, and we can't afford to lose another member!
And there isn't anyone with higher access than the Shorekeeper.
Tethys, confirm my access.
Confiming access... {PlayerName}, Chief Steward. Welcome.
What? How do you have top security clearance?
The Shorekeeper transfered her access to me in our last moments.
She gave you her access? Are you somebody important that we should know about?
Wait, that ancient prophecy...
In times of great adversity, the Shorekeeper will reveal herself and support our true leader, who, at the destined moment, will rise to save and guide the Black Shores forward.
You... You are the—
It's not important.
Our focus now is the Tethys System.
Members of the Black Shores have followed Tethys' calculations and commands.
Even the Shorekeeper herself is used as a pawn.
But humans shouldn't be treated as mere tools. History teaches us this, and we should never forget it.
No system is flawless, just as no human is perfect. That's why we have the right to question Tethys' decisions.
In Jinzhou, I learned an old saying: "We can't change the past, but we can shape the future."
That's what we need to do now—learn from our mistakes and build a better future.
The Black Shores exist for one reason: to protect everyone on this planet, because people are the heart of civilization.
We can fix broken systems, but without people, civilization has no soul.
Sorry to jump in but... I couldn't help overhearing what you've been saying...
Consultant Aalto?
Do what you have to do. Leave the ground area to us.
I'll bring her back, mark my words!
You've heard what {Male=he;Female=she} said.
Attention all units! Readiness Level One enabled. Switch the Tethys System to full recursive search mode. Prepare to open the transmission passage!
Rover, we're counting on you to save the Shorekeeper and the Black Shores.
From the distant past to the far future, everything begins and ends here.
When you established the Black Shores to unite Solaris, the Tethys System already existed.
Later, you discovered it relied on emotions from the Lament to fuel its calculations. Without them, it cannot function.
Using the Lament against itself is like walking on a Möbius loop with no end in sight.
We have tried for millennia to break this cycle without success.
And then... you left the Black Shores to look for other solutions.
But deep down, you already knew the best solution. It was one you couldn't accept.
That solution is me—the tool always meant to become Tethys' core.
If I don't do this, you, as the Modulator of this system, will be chosen as the core. I must fulfill my duty to protect you.
But... I want to be by your side, to see the skies you've seen, to tread the paths you've walked. I want to understand... what happiness really means.
When I first discovered these emotions, I didn't know what to do...
So I lied to you, thinking it was the best choice for both of us...
I... I'm sorry...
Sorry for putting you in harm's way...
"Salvation is about building a world where people no longer need to be saved."
This is why we return to this shore.
No one should be treated as a mere tool.
We're back at the Black Shores now, back to our home.
Welcome home, my Shorekeeper.
Yes.
Thank you. My... star.
About that frequency dwelling within you...
You mean Abby?
Yes.
It seems to be "hungering" for something.
Have you ever felt anything unusual?
I don't feel anything...
Abby's been unusually quiet these days.
My Sonoro can sense even the most minor changes in frequencies.
So I can tell that there's something strange about that frequency.
I'll search for more information in the Tethys System and share what I find with you.
How is the Tethys System now?
After being fixed, it's executing the master command given at its creation.
The core computational unit has now been replaced by a special frequency that shares similar properties as the Lament.
But this one is... more harmonious and mild.
What about you? Are you still confined to this place?
Although I must stay here to watch over the Black Shores, I'm now able to bath in the sunshine and feel the sea breeze with you.
This is what freedom feels like.
It feels delightful.
I know you have your own journey to finish.
You can entrust the Black Shores to me, and I'll carry out my duty as always.
You have the full support of the Black Shores, no matter where you are or how far you go.
And... despite all the many names you bear, I see you for who you truly are.
Wherever your path leads, I hope to walk it with you.

I've always known I'm useless… and beyond redemption.  When that monstrosity wreaked havoc in the camp, I was the first to flee. Was I ashamed? No, who wouldn't run if they were in my shoes?
Overseers talk about grand plans all the time, like human evolution and a new era. I guess it works well for other Artificers, because that's what they all chase. But not me. I'm a coward afraid of any sacrifice, much less sacrifice for intangible ideals. But I do agree with one thing they say: the world is doomed, and only the powerful will survive.
I've heard of Exiles vanishing during Tacet Discord onslaughts, like candles in the wind. Survivors speak of the horrors they saw in Tacet Fields. I don't want to be like them. Struggling to live out there like rats, surviving on scraps, fearful of being killed at any moment. 
Luckily, there's good news from the boss. He said the experiment was a success. The experiment was a success. If we can control Tacet Discord, we'll be valued by the Overseers.Maybe even promoted! Maybe... finally some peace and stability.
I want power. I want to be strong. If it's the Tacet Discord's power, I'll take it. If it's an Echo's, I'll take it, no matter what. If getting dirty keeps me alive, I'll do it without hesitation.
I won't be the prey. I won't let this world swallow me whole. I won't.
With the Threnodian defeated, our Sentinel and the Jinzhou Magistrate have resumed their duties. Jinzhou will have peace and prosperity once more.
Don't forget our pinky promise! There are so many adventures, and so many stories just waiting for us!

I'm sorry. Though I do practice Taoism, geomancy and fortune-telling aren't my strong suit.
Moreover, this matter concerns chance, and you can't force it.

What happened?
Oh, hi, {PlayerName}. It's nothing big. Uncle Dong asked me to help him decipher a divination lot, but… I'm not skilled in that art.
It's a long story. Although I know a bit of divination, I'm self-taught. So, I decided to find something to lend some credibility to my efforts.
Something to lend your credibility?
Yeah. Long ago, a famous diviner visited Jinzhou, rumored to possess the gift of communicating with spirits and predicting destinies. People flocked to him for guidance.
His moon-reading skill was said to be exceptional. Uh, I guess you're not familiar with it, {PlayerName}.

You half fill a specially crafted porcelain bowl with pure water, recite an incantation, and observe the reflection of the full moon in the water to discern fortune and misfortune. That's the moon-reading divination.
When that diviner performed it, the water would emit a golden glow, adding a touch of mystery to the moon's reflection.
Unfortunately, no one knew where he went. It's said that when he left Jinzhou, he left a letter and a divination lot.
In the letter, he mentioned meeting a mysterious person in Jinzhou. After a deep conversation on divination, he felt his understanding was too shallow and lost interest in reading divination books.
Frustrated, he decided to give up his career, but he couldn't bear to part with the porcelain bowl that had accompanied him for years. So, he hid it somewhere in Jinzhou.
Then, he left a divination lot as a clue, hoping someone would find it one day.
Is that the divination lot you wanted Jianxin to decipher?
That's right. Since the bowl belongs to that famous master, it must be great for divinations. So I want to have it on my stall and enhance my credibility.
Though I haven't heard of this divination master, Uncle Dong does have a point. In this line of work, possessing powerful artifacts does lend credibility to one's abilities.
I bet that master would be happy to see his treasure recognized by people again.
What did the divination lot say?
Oh, haha, I almost forgot our main business. It says, "To seek your true self, observe the lake at a deck. Place your trust in innocent young souls."
This lot doesn't seem related to fortune-telling, so I'm a bit confused. Any thoughts, {PlayerName}?
It mentions a location.
A deck where people can appreciate the lake… Do we have a place like that in Jinzhou?
I've been to several places that match the description. Found nothing so far. Perhaps the time wasn't right.
Anyway, as long as we have a clue, there's a way to find it! Uncle Dong, we'll help you find that porcelain bowl!
Yeah, you can count on us.
Great! I'll be sure to pay you a hefty sum! Best of luck, Jianxin, {PlayerName}!
"Observe the lake at a deck"… Seems like this is the place the divination lot implies.
And the next line… " The pure heart of a child shouldn't be doubted." We may need to look for children nearby.
You're right. There might be clues around here.
Lalala…
Hello there, little girl.
Hi? How can I help you?
Seen anything strange about lately?
Something strange…? I come here a lot, but something strange...
Oh, yeah! The cats!
Cats…?
Yeah, that's right! There's a spot around here where cats love to stay.
Often saw them just sitting there, not moving at all. Mom said they're fishing in the lake but...
Cats… What's your take, {PlayerName}?
It's indeed worth our attention.
Let's go check it out.
A-are you Patrollers?
Sorry, we're not.
We're here for treasure hunting.
A-are you bad people, then...?
Haha, of course not. We're here for a long-lost treasure.
A treasure?! That sounds cool!
A treasure?! That sounds cool!
But Mommy probably won't let me join you. Never mind, I'll cheer you on from the sidelines!
Thank you, young miss. We'll definitely find the treasure!
Yeah!
Look! I found it! It's a wooden casket. Hmm? What is that smell?
It smells like medicine.
There must be some kind of medicine in here that lasts a long time and attracts cats.
It's interesting, but I just don't get it... Could someone actually predict a kid would solve this puzzle years later?
Maybe he trusted a child's curiosity.
Maybe there indeed was a way.
True. Kids have pure hearts, free from adult worries. They often have a keen eye for details that we miss.
My master was right; divination isn't just about lies and trickery… Sadly, I'm not gifted with the talent to fully master it.
Shall we open this casket? We may find the porcelain bowl inside.
You and Jianxin open the porcelain bowl. However, except for some herbs wrapped in silk pouches, there is only a yellowed piece of paper.

"I seek my true self, but the paths are unclear. Blurring my vision, fueling my fear. I hesitate, I question, and I wander. My cart dust-covered, yet no path feels right, I ponder." Seems quite similar to that divination lot.
Another clue.
I can't seem to figure out what is says. Any idea, {PlayerName}?
I may have an idea.
Great! Knew I can count on you!
"My cart dust-covered…" Oh, look, there's an old cart. Looks like it hasn't been maintained for years.
I'll go search around!
I found it, {PlayerName}!
Another wooden casket. But it feels way too light... Don't tell me there's another piece of paper inside…
Probably.
That master really thought he was being funny, I guess.
"Seeking my true self, I travel wide. In the stall where fortunes amass, emptiness resides." This must be the next clue.
"In the stall where fortunes amass…" That probably means the Main Street?
You're so clever, Jianxin!
You're getting good at reading divination lots!
Haha, just a guess. We still don't know if I got it right.
Let's go check it out.
Sure! We'll find out soon enough!
There are so many stores on the Main Street… I guess we have to search them one by one.
Hold on, Jianxin. Since it says "in the stall" we can probably cross out large stores from our list.
Good point. We should focus on the small vendor stalls, right?
{PlayerName}, you're right. The clue does point to a vendor stall.
This wooden casket is heavy. I think the porcelain bowl is inside. Shall we open it, {PlayerName}?
Sure.
The treasure left by that divination master is inside… The thought makes me a bit nervous.
You and Jianxin open the wooden casket. Inside there is an ordinary looking black porcelain bowl.
Is this the treasure we've been searching for? But it looks…
It looks like an ordinary porcelain bowl.
I see. Just as the saying goes, "Great music has the faintest notes; the Great Form is without shape." Maybe the more precious the treasure, the less eye-catching it is.
Perhaps it only shines when used in divination.
You may be right.
Is that so…?
Anyway, let's bring it back to Uncle Dong.
Oh, you're back! How's it going? Did you find the bowl?
Yes, we did, but…
It doesn't look like a treasure.
Thank you. It's okay. According to the record, we need to fill it with fresh water and recite the moon-reading incantation…
When the moon casts its reflection on the water, you'll witness its magic.
Wow, that sounds amazing! Hurry, let's try it out, Uncle Dong!
Uncle Dong fills the porcelain bowl halfway with water and recites the incantation, but nothing happens.
Wait, where's the golden glow…?
I just see moonlight.
You stole my word.
…Well, I'm certain the bowl you found is the one left by that master of divination.
But now, it seems to be an ordinary bowl used for divination, and that's all.
How can that be…
I'm actually not surprised the bowl didn't work. These kind of stories are usually just hearsay, and it looks like this one is no different.
That master might have been good at divination, but people exaggerated his skills.
I love operas and shows, but come on—heroes performing impossible feats and warriors moving mountains? It's all embellished for entertainment.
So you mean the bowl is useless?
No, far from it! While it may not have "magic," it's still a treasure worth cherishing. Remember, what defines a treasure is not its practicality, young one!
It's the story behind it that matters. A good story. A story rich in twists and turns.
Ah, I see now.
Anyway, thank you, {PlayerName}, Jianxin. Thank you for helping me find this bowl.
With the presence of this porcelain bowl, my reputation as a professional fortune-teller will surely flourish!
In preparation.
Watch out. Monsters!
How do we get across...?
It's open!
Great job, {PlayerName}! Let's go inside.
An airstream. We can use it to fly up!
A-Are you sure I can fly?
Of course, you can. Nothing's impossible in the Wooly Kingdom.
Looks like we've reached the end. That was fun... I have to tell Mom about it once I see her!
Okay. Time to find the exit.
It's another one of those puzzles... I know, let's look around for clues.
Monsters. I'm not scared, I have Mom's sword and shield with me...
Wow. You solved it in one go!
I should be able to break through this wall. Take a step back.
Sounds like an airstream appeared. Let's head back and check it out.
Are we flying again?
Yay! Fly-time!

More puzzles here...
Those markings in the other room must be clues. Shall we go take a look?
Hmm... How do we solve this one...?
Presto!
Feeling stuck? Why don't we search around for clues?

Head for the Beginning of the End
The Port City of Guixu... It once embodied the metropolitan dream.
Confidence and ambition fueled its growth, pushing the entire world forward.
People sailed every sea, explored every land. Everyone had food and shelter, living in peace.
Their spirits were high, optimism as tall as the skyscrapers. A bright future was surely inevitable, or so they thought.
See that brightly lit building? It was the tallest, reaching high enough to touch the heavens.
It sounds like a time of great hope...
It was an era of high aspirations and big dreams. Life had infinite possibility.
Humanity's aspirations soared beyond the stars, searching for the edge of the universe itself.
The universe itself?
Yes, because it was there, well within our reach...
Until...
...The Lament wiped everything out.
I've never been to this city myself, not even in the Sonoro.
You were the one who told me about its rise and fall.
You've always been a witness.
But perhaps you had already foreseen its end and the issues that threaten us today.
The city looks safe for now.
The Lament will strike here in one hour.
My computations only recreated the city as it was in its final hour before disaster.
Hard to imagine such a city turning to dust...
The more steps we take, the closer we draw to the inevitable destruction.
The moment the Lament starts is our chance to retrieve the data.
I'm sorry. We could never change history... or the "future" that already happened.
As one who has already walked this path, what did you experience? How did you... feel about it?
Does the Tethys System command you to ask about this?
No.
I ask... because "I" want to know.
...Would you like to share it with me?
I remember your smile when you described how prosperous it was.
We are about to see the beginning of the Lament...
In ten minutes' time.
Back then, the Black Shores issued a Lament warning to the city.
Unfortunately, the Lament swept through much faster than the Tethys System anticipated.
You dispatched all available personnel to assist Huanglong in evacuation.
But in the end... some lives couldn't be saved.
That Bloom Bearer named Hoda...
Yes. She was one of the many casualties.
As a Bloom Bearer, she was on the front lines of evacuation and rescue efforts.
Yet human strength... is a mere whisper against the Lament's roar.
No life should be lost in vain.
You've always believed in this.
The Black Shores uphold this belief, and so did Hoda.
Will she be replicated?
Yes, just up ahead.
But I'm not sure if seeing her is the right thing to do.
This is the highest point in Guixu Port City, where the Lament descended.
Gravity anomalies crushed this building into rubble.
Tacet Discords closer to the Lament's origin are more dangerous.
My Sonoro will shield you...
But please hurry.
Use your Grapple! Quickly!
You can use gravity here!
An object in free fall between two portals will keep accelerating.
You can send the target to the designated location this way.
Authorization granted! Give it a try!

Oh, Rover! Ya wanna give this a shot?
Which is...?
Well, you're lookin' at it. Moon Shooter. Been helping Qingxi test out the new targets.
Just beat my personal best, but.. I'm still nowhere near the all-time record.
I mean, that record holder hit multiple targets with one shot, can't top that. It's crazy how they pulled it off.
You're very good at it already.
These targets move really fast...
Ready for the real deal, Chixia? I've made some intense Moon Shooter challenges just for the pros.
But I ran out of space here at the Fair... So I moved them to a safe area nearby.
These aren't like the ones you tried at my stall—trust me, they'll be the craziest challenge of your life!
Jeepers! I gotta try that out!
Go ahead, knock yourself out. You can even help me get a feel for the difficulty while you're at it.
What are we waiting for, {PlayerName}? Let's go!
Over here, {PlayerName}!
Hehe... I hope Qingxi's not gonna disappoint.
You're probably just not warmed up yet. C'mon, another one!
...That's it? Welp, Qingxi was right about these being harder than the ones back at the stall. Just a teeny bit though.
I know, right?
It's already pretty difficult for the average folk.
Guess we'll have to look forward to Qinxi's ultimate challenge. She's definitely saving the best for last.
She must have tougher challenges for us. Instructor Yhan wouldn't have asked her to train the rookies otherwise.
Really?
And that's exactly what you want, right?
Alright. She's got me all fired up now!
Bring it on, Qinxi. I'm game for whatever you're gonna throw at me!
...There it is, Rover!
Time to give this ultimate challenge a spin!
Well, that was something... Humph. But it'll take more than that for me to call it quits! Oh, no, you don't!
I'm not done yet! Again!
Nice. Haven't broken so much sweat while target shooting in a long time. Ha. Not bad, Qingxi. Not bad at all...
That's way over the top for an amusement game.
That was so intense my hands were shaking.
That last challenge was really something, huh? But we made it through either way! Gimme five, Rover. Yeah!
Chixia raises her hand in excitement as she gives Rover a high five.
Haha. When we team up, we're unstoppable!
Yeah! We're unstoppable!
C'mon! Back to Qingxi's!
You're back. Looks like you managed to beat all the challenges.
Was there ever a doubt?
Well? How did it feel, Rover?
The difficulty was just right.
It was easy.
Way too hard!
Hmm... If you say so, then it's safe to say these extra challenges are ready for a broader audience.
Still a bit on the easier side, huh? Which means... I'll need to turn it up a notch.
Ha. Even Rover thinks they're too much of a challenge. I see, then I'll probably have to tone it down a bit...
Hey, Qingxi. You forgetting someone?
Pfft. Ya think? Oh, I know what you're thinkin', all right—
Easy as shooting fish in a barrel.
H-How'd you guess that?!
...Read you like a book.
Perseverance is a good trait.
Care to give me some pointers on pistol training, Chixia?
Who knows? Maybe we can promote your skills among the Rangers!
Tips? It's just hard work, hard work, and more hard work!
Just hard work? Hmm... That's not much advice.
Okay, then, lemme think... I'd say we also need the "heart of a hero."
Gotta be quick on the draw to protect the innocent, and shoot with absolute precision to stop evil. As a hero, I must strive for perfection!
That's Chixia all right.
That's right. Heroes are unstoppable!
True, having a strong will to protect is just as crucial.
Thank you. I'll be sure to tell the instructor what you said today.
Don't mention it, Qingxi!
Oh... By the way, {PlayerName}, you found any good stuff to eat?
The Moon Shooter game had me all wrapped up. Totally forgot I came here for some snacks.
Now with all that done and dusted, my stomach's starting to grumble...
There are plenty of food stalls.
You should give "Fish Balls with Spicy Gravy" a try!
Nice... Food Hunter Chixia is ready!
Fish Balls with Spicy Gravy... It's got me drooling just saying that name!
Wanna come with me, {PlayerName}?
Sure.
Maybe next time.
Yeah! All right. Snack time!
Okie dokie! Enjoy the Moonlit Fair, {PlayerName}!

//By Bram
I have seen my end. Before death arrives, I... must repent.
I am not a pure scholar.
I envy my colleagues... Victor, Alaia, Vasily, Chen Xuefeng... They all have ideals, and beliefs. They sincerely hope that their efforts will better humanity. They want to surmount the Lament and ward off crises.
I am different. I work for selfish reasons, masquerading my ambition as ideals like theirs. I joined the research on Retroact Rain in Whining Aix's Mire and then relocated to Mt. Firmament, all to prove that time is a river. We are merely carried along by it and someday we will also find a way to go against the current.
Like a drowning man, I grasped at any straw, seeking salvation where none exists... Isn't it ridiculous, Vivian?
I don't know why I have you in my mind at this moment... Or should I say... you never left. The miracles at Mt. Firmament once fueled my unrealistic fantasies. I sacrificed everything and exhausted all the knowledge I had acquired throughout my life, just to bring you back from the dark, hazy underworld, and hold you in my arms once again.
But I failed. My fingers started to tremble, my head grew dizzy, and I could no longer operate those delicate instruments. I see you now, standing by the river, separated from me only by a thin veil. I've been drifting down, and down, and down... But you, you stayed somewhere upstream, for eternity.
Fortunately, I won't have to worry about this much longer. I'm about to run aground, and I hope I have the chance to sail upstream and find you.

Date: [––]
Testing, testing… Ah, great! So the recording function still works.
I, Victor Christopher, the last Research Director, am leading this experiment in my own name—no precedent, no animal tests, no ethical reviews. Honestly, making the decision was torture to me—my science ethics is wearing thin. But none of those were possible. I'm running out of time. It's just me and Caleb, that assistant AI, now.
Still, I'm recording what I'm about to do. I'm not recording in proper formatting, 'cause this is but a desperate act by an unresigned old man. I hope this won't bother anyone who should find this memo.
I've set up a few Chronopins—to prevent energy breakdown, I'll overload each of them—which should, theoretically, create a lasting, irreversible time bubble, trapping me inside like an insect in amber. I hesitate to call it immortality—it's more like sentencing myself to life. The only comfort is that my consciousness will be kept still too, so I'll stay sane during this long slumber.
The reason I'm doing this instead of welcoming death with calm is… I have to wait for that one's return.
That one once helped us develop the technology of [data corrupted], helped us reconstruct what was a tiny chip of the Sentinel's supreme power. They showed us a glimpse of a god's world, even if just for an instant. And I just… want to meet that one again, even though they might not give us the answers we long for.
By then, what will that one say to this foolish, dying old man? Will they call me a complete idiot? Will that one compare our research to child's play, with that scorn theirs? Or will they appreciate our work... before our tombs?
I don't know. It's been too long. My memory of that one has blurred. The only part about them that's left in mind is that they were so caring, and so indifferent, at once.
Okay, it's about time. Gotta get in my amber. I'll see you in a million years, my friends, or in a few seconds… They're the same to me.

Private Journal V

Date: [---].
I am Victor. This is a routine voice journal.
Today is another beautiful day. Most of the researchers have left. They will leave Mt. Firmament. Mr. Bram and I advised them to calm down and at least wait until we resolve the issue of shortened lifespan before making a decision. But they didn't listen.
I didn't leave. Research requires perseverance, which was the first lesson Mr. Bram taught me. He always leads by example. Ha, to him, I'll always be that immature young boy.
Date: [---].
I took some time to create something new: a simple AI. I named it Caleb after the iron-headed thing who traveled with a man and dog in an old movie I watched as a kid. Not many people are left here, so someone has to take care of the minor work. An AI is always useful.
I also created some interesting rock puzzles, powered by the many unoccupied Chronosorters in this place. It reminds me of playing with building blocks in my childhood. Those were the days. However, Mr. Bram doesn't seem very happy. Maybe his age prevents him from accepting too many new things...? Or perhaps his worsening leg condition makes these rock puzzles a hassle for him to navigate.
I don't mind. Life isn't just about work and research, right?
Date: [---].
It is quite enjoyable to educate an AI from scratch. It's like painting on a blank canvas—I need to stay focused to avoid turning a meticulous artwork into a careless scribble.
I answer any questions it raises and write new database entries for it every few days. I teach it everything I know about the world, using the methods Mr. Bram taught me. This feeling... is wonderful. Its camera reflects the world as I see it, and it thinks with my logic, allowing me to examine myself again through its actions.
Date: [---].
Caleb learns quite quickly. Initially, I only intended for it to help with cooking and tidying up the facility. I never expected its potential to far exceed our imagination. It seems that it is time to change its title from "Life Assistant" to "Research Assistant".
Mr. Bram has been ill for several days, bedridden, and unable to go anywhere. I miss the energetic man who used to scold us apprentices one by one. But now I have become a middle-aged man myself, too. It's been days since I last shaved, but it seems trivial now.
Date: [---].
Mr. Bram… didn't make it through that long winter.
Caleb and I buried him on a hill nearby without a tombstone. It wouldn't help anyway, as no one will know who we are or what our names are. People might just laugh about how a bunch of lunatics indulge themselves in illusions when they see our negligible legacy.
Caleb was with Mr. Bram until his very last moment. And Mr. Bram… taught it everything he knew. I understand why.
I once read a story about a man who was determined to level a mountain, despite everyone thinking he was out of his mind. But he made it, with the help of his sons, his grandsons, his great-grandsons, and so on.
I hope Caleb will shoulder this responsibility. I've told it about this. Human life is too short, but Caleb is immortal. It might accomplish what is impossible for us.
I will not live to see that day, but I will do everything I can while I'm alive to press forward. I promise, in the name of Bram, my mentor.

You're back.
Yes, I am.
Why are you playing alone?
The Black Shores welcomes your return.
I am expressing myself through music... just like you taught me.
I asked you here to talk about Abby. Have you noticed an increase in its hunger or fatigue lately?
Yes, it's been more noticeable lately.
Then my suspicion was correct.
The unusual frequency I noticed is from Abby. The change is subtle, but it's getting stronger.
Its frequency... is weakening.
Abby was worried about how this might affect you and has been asking for my help.
...The one I'm trying to protect might be facing danger because of me. I can sense how anxious Abby is.
I've looked into the most viable solution for Abby's weakening frequency.
Before I explain, you should see a past record stored in Tethys. It's important for you to see it yourself.
It may answer some questions.
Please, hold my hand.
That should do it. It's good to meet you, my future...
"Me."
Now that you have this record, I trust that you've resolved the core issue with the Tethys System. And the Shorekeeper must be connected to it too.
As Chief Steward, you now have full access to the Black Shores data banks, which hold thousands of years' worth of records. However, you may have noticed that all information about you is missing.
That's because I erased most entries about myself, the "you" of the past.
Long after my memory is wiped, "I" will awaken for the first time and become "you."
Once again, "we" will rove Solaris-3 and walk among the people.
You've witnessed a taste of civilization's struggles, and you may have questions. But I'm afraid I can't answer them yet.
What you see before you is a memo, or rather, a beacon I've set for myself.
If that one has also awakened...
Seek out "Imperator." We made a pact long ago.
I found this when searching for information about Abby.
It remained hidden until the core leak in the Tethys System was finally resolved.
It's no coincidence you're finding it now.
(That message... I think I should trust it.)
Who is "Imperator"?
Imperator is Rinascita's Sentinel.
It is also the solution Tethys proposes. As Rinascita's Sentinel, Imperator should have the knowledge to fix Abby's weakening frequency.
Rinascita, also called the Land of Echoes, is renowned for its Echo technologies. It's home to many like Abby who have physical forms.
(Rinascita? I may finally learn who Abby really is...)
It just so happens that the best time to visit Rinascita is now.
Please take this with you.
To our esteemed business partner,

As the celebrated Carnevale returns to Rinascita, the Montelli family, proud organizers of this grand festival, extend an invitation for you to grace Ragunna with your esteemed presence and partake in the celebrations.
In the spirit of goodwill, we have arranged a modest sum for your use during your stay in Rinascita. These funds are available at your convenience at the Averardo Bank.

The Montelli family holds in high regard each of its many friendships. Should you choose to place the Blake Bloom upon the Golden Scale, we shall consider you our most honored guest and a lifelong friend of the family.
The Montelli family eagerly awaits your arrival.
The Montelli family?
The Montellis are one of the leading families in Ragunna, a city-state within Rinascita. Their trade connections with the Black Shores prompted this invitation.
It is Rinascita's grandest festival. During this time, Ragunna's port relaxes its regulations to welcome visitors.
"A majestic tribute to our Sentinel!"
Seems like a good time.
Yes. It's also an excellent travel destination.
However... Rinascita is particularly special to the Black Shores.
The Threnodian's revival in Jinzhou has triggered similar reactions in other countries, with Rinascita as the one exception. We've detected no frequency fluctuations related to Threnodians there.
While many of our Bloom Bearers have visited Rinascita city-states before, our presence is often met with a hint of skepticism.
Given the circumstances, the best approach would be to visit as a guest of a prominent family.
Good, let's set out then.
How can we get to Rinascita?
Are you leaving now?
Please wait... I'll open a portal for you.
Wait!
Ah...
Opening a portal will drain your computing power. I think it's better served for Black Shores operations.
You needn't worry about this small matter.
It would be better to keep a low profile.
...I see.
I'll have Aalto arrange your transportation to Rinascita then.
There you are! I've got your ship readied!
You'll have to sail to Rinascita, but the Threnodian ruckuses everywhere have left you with only the dinghies.
Don't worry, behold my private stash. Remarkably fit for keeping a low profile, if I may say so myself.
It must have hidden depths.
It's certainly small and discreet.
Is that really it?
Well, aren't you eagle-eyed!
Tiny but mighty. It's got all the essentials.
Ah, stuck on "bigger is better," are we? Haven't you heard "less is more"?
This is cutting-edge gear from the New Fed World Expo. Nearly lost my shirt haggling for it. Planning to stock up for the Black Shores.
Word is, Ragunnesi treat the Sentinel like a god—churches and all. Real holy rollers. When in Ragunna, do as the Ragunnesi do, ok?
Now, let me work my magic on the autopilot. Before you know it, you'll be cruising into Ragunna.
Just give me a holler when you're ready to go.
I'm ready.
I still need to pack up.
Then off we go. Our destination is—
Ragunna!

Zzz... Zzz...
Hello?

This chest? It's our first mate's personal haven.
All good, Roccia? Some new friends have joined us.
Hello.

This coin is one of her prized possessions. I'd wager it's her way of saying "Nice to meet you."
Uh huh...

Here we are! Ragunna's dock.
You'll find Echo boats ahead to ferry you straight into the heart of Ragunna.

And a quiet arrival? That's not our style. We'll sail into Ragunna with flair—complete with a dazzling show and the loudest of ovations.
Don't forget to stash some confetti in your pockets for the occasion!
Thanks for the trip.
Abby, you should say goodbye.
My pleasure! Speaking of which, where's that charming little companion of yours?
Abby? Wakey-wakey.
Is it asleep? The fog likely caused this. Don't worry. Echoes will recover when they're out of it.
Oh, and do yourself a favor, try our Nectarwine. They say one drop of the "Gocce di Divino" will let you rendezvous with the Sentinel in your dreams...
Ha! That might just be your shortcut to seeing the Sentinel.
May the winds be in your favor!
Hmm... Wha... Huh? We docked already? Where is Brant and the crew?
They are gone now.
I tried waking you up just now.
You did? I didn't hear a thing.
Whoa, this is Ragunna, huh? How do we get into town?
Let's take a look around first.
Go forth, dear pilgrims, on your sacred journey. May the Sentinel guide you as it has guided the returning ships.
Go forth, Andreas... "The Fool." The benevolent Primus has blessed you with this sacred pilgrimage. May you find the righteous path on your voyage.
If you're all so righteous, why don't you join the pilgrimage yourselves!
Our duty remains here, to shepherd the lost. I grieve for you, my brother... for you have strayed from the truth.
Ha... Haha... Truth... Don't make me laugh...
Your transgression is absolved before the sacred Pilgrim's Sail. Go now, and board with humility.
Wait a moment, traveler... While you may harbor doubts, I implore you not to disrupt their pilgrimage.
Perhaps staying silent now would better serve your interests.
Sorry, and you are?
Pardon my intrusion. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Cristoforo, a modest playwright visiting Ragunna in search of inspiration for my latest work.
I'm {PlayerName}.
A pleasure to make your acquaintance. I'm working on a play—tales of pilgrims striving to reach the Sentinel's promised land...
Word of a new Pilgrim's Sail about to depart brought me here. I came hoping to glean fresh ideas.
That ship over there?
Ah, new allies born from the perils of the high seas! What better way to begin an epic story?
Thanks for helping.
Merely my duty, dear friend. The mists thicken once more, shrouding this ever-tumultuous path. A maiden voyage for you, I presume?
These waters teem with colossal, mystical Tacet Discords. That behemoth you saw is called "Cetus the Tidebreaker."
It is a gentle giant that usually keeps to deep waters and exhibits no aggressive behavior...
It did look unusual.
I saw something odd on its hide. Could that be the cause of its madness?
That big fella smells of sadness and anger all over...
Well, well, who's this little beach ball? A talking Echo! Clever little thing! Got a name?
What? First off, I'm not little! And beach ball? Really? Also, spill your name before you go askin' mine!
Oh my, where are my manners? I do apologize.
Brant's the name, captain of this fine vessel. As you can tell, we are a troupe, a merry band of fools chasing freedom across the seas!
Please forgive the lack of propriety. Now, travelers from afar, may I know your names?
I'm {PlayerName}. This is Abby.
I'm Roller, this is Hover.
I'm the watcher of the realm, master of both light and darkness.
Humph, hear that?
Whoa, hold up! My name's Abby! This is {PlayerName}!
Aw, c'mon, enough with the fancy talk!... My name's Abby, and this is {PlayerName}.
Hehe, {PlayerName} and Abby! Splendid! "All who step aboard, guests of honor be! With names exchanged, friendship's born at sea!"
Ahoy, crew! Let's give our new mates a proper welcome!
Welcome to the one and only Troupe of Fools!
*Cheerful sounds*
Are those… Echoes? Incredible! Never seen 'em like this before. Hmph, they're almost as special as me… like, 60, no, 70% as special! *Hiccup*
Er...
Ha ha ha, your little companion is quite amusing. I presume you must be headed to Rinascita for the Carnevale?
Yes. We heard it's a big festival.

Indeed it is! The crown jewel of Rinascita's calendar. Ah, the endless masquerades, the sumptuous feasts, the wine flowing like rivers, and the music that never sleeps! For a few glorious nights, all your cares disappear!
And at the Carnevale's peak, our Sentinel Imperator will crown the festival's finest performer with the "Laurel."
Does the Laurel get you an audience with the Sentinel?
Ha! Of course not. No mortal's ever laid eyes on the divine Sentinel up in the heaven of heavens. But the Laureate may hear the Sentinel's voice.
We've got a real Laureate in our troupe. Shame he didn't sail with us today. Oh, the tales he would tell! You'd love to hear about his glory days.
Chatting with the Sentinel if you get the Laurel? That's somethin'!
Are you also attending the Carnevale?
Absolutely! It's been a decade since the last Carnevale. We're not about to miss this one.
Sentinel or Laurel, it matters not...
The Troupe of Fools shall forever breathe freedom and unbridled joy into that city.
...Huh?
It's the fog.
Fog? Ew, I don't like the smell coming from the sea now.
Beware, my friends. The fog can affect Echoes.
This isn't just bad weather. It's a Waveworn Phenomenon. Many Tacet Discords lurk in the fog, ready to obliterate any passing ship.
But fear not! Our vessel shall not perish here! Before you stands a seasoned captain!
Hark, brave crew! Secure the lines and unfurl the sails! The helm is mine to command!
The final curtain shall not fall here! Our saga must endure!
The mysterious and giant Echo bellows a deep, resonating greeting.
Hello there!
It's saying "hi" to us.
(Let out a presumably friendly sound)
Hello.

…It's stumped about why fries don't get some seagulls…
Quit with the wacky noises already!

It happily bobs its head, careful not to affect the ship's hull.
Seems like there's been a lot of mist lately, hm?
It's not a good sign. The Carnevale is fast approaching...
Andreas... That ship... No, no, I must stop that ship!
...Have you gone mad? You can't stop the Pilgrim's Sail. The Order will arrest you!
Hello there! Need a lift to the city? Hop on this Gondola right here.
This boat is... an Echo?
Yes, please. Thank you.
Correct! In Ragunna, we sail in Echoes. They are trusted and reliable helpers, gifts from divinity.
A third of a Ragunnesi's life is spent on a Gondola. Pretty amazing, right?
This little one will get you there safe and sound.
I didn't know all the ships in Ragunna are Echoes. That troupe isn't as special as I thought...
Now I can't even imagine what kind of Echoes we might see in the city.
Maybe we'll come across some that look like you, a whole pack of them.
You're kidding me... Even in the Land of Echoes, I, Abby, will always be the most special one!
Hic!
...Approved. Welcome to Rinascita.

Reserved Terminals should be declared upon entry. May I see your declaration form, please?

Forgive the inconvenience. By the Order's decree, all visitors must undergo customs clearance to ensure safety...

Someone invited me here.

The Sentinel is with you, me—all of us.
Their presence is eternal in our hearts, guiding us always...

Their presence is eternal in our hearts, guiding us always...

Acolyte Phoebe.

Happy Moon-Chasing Festival, {PlayerName}!
You too!

You flatter me.
I just did what needed to be done.

This shooting game should be easy for you. No battlefield pressure here, just fun.

The Fox?

Like our Sentinel "Jué," Hsin has its own state to protect.

So that's the story...
Well, sounds a bit exaggerated.
True or not, people love blessings. It doesn't matter if it makes sense, it's part of the local culture's charm.
You have to admit, spinning a lottery wheel is always a thrill.

My shoulders are so stiff... guess I don't have the same energy I once had.
