The client has received the mine investigation report. We can wrap up this case. Thank you once again for your contribution!
But before you go, we have a art project that may be right for you if you're interested.
The client seeks an artist to capture a few scenic spots, both photos and paintings will do.
Landscape painting... reminds me of someone.
I remember doing landscape paintings with Zhezhi.
I met a painter called Zhezhi during the Moon-Chasing Festival. We had a blast at the festival.
The first time I saw her, she was busy sketching scenery, so absorbed in her work that her mind was still on it when we talked.
At the Moon-Chasing Festival, we worked together on a painting commission. Her brushwork was so exquisite and expressive.
Oh, right! She helped out at the fan drawing stall during the festival. Her artwork was so popular, I couldn't get one myself.
Now that you mention it, she seems perfect for this job! If she takes it, the client will be very pleased.
Thanks for bringing this up! We will make sure to contact her.
These flashbacks... Could it be from touching that mirror? Energy crystals made into a mirror, with a pre-made Sonoro inside... Hmm, a sly trap.
This Sonoro, the docks, Benett's Terminal, Duncan... When did it all begin?
And the hand that pulled me in... I need to get to the bottom of this, and quickly.
These masterless Echoes have turned hostile... The frequency fluctuations in this Sonoro seem unstable.
I'll have to handle them before I can search the area.
And there's even more?
How strange. I'm being led in circles. They don't seem to want me near the mansion.
Now there's nothing else in my way.
All these obstacles suggest the answer is likely there... I must investigate that mansion. The way out and clues I need may lie within its walls.
This layout and decor seem strikingly similar to our mansion, just with slight differences.
This area... These decorations, the chandelier specifically, were destroyed during the invasion five years ago.
Am I truly in the <color=yellow>past</color> or trapped in some kind of <color=yellow>simulation</color>?
Finally, the line in the West End is ours.
Those uppity pricks tried to screw us over with the Order's backing. Good thing Padrino was there to uncover the counterfeit crap they swapped in.
Now that our territories are connected. I heard the lacquerware in Huanglong is top-notch. We could make a killing off that.
Well, aren't you a go-getter? Not bad, ambition gets things done. Let's start planning.
It's been three days. I haven't heard back from him at all...
You still fretting over your son? Don't worry, we've taken every precaution. We will be ready to act should anything go awry.
Thank you. I know you will. It's just... He went tangling with those wild Tacet Discords... He doesn't understand. I expect nothing from him... only his safety.
Aha! Fancy a wager? I bet two dinners you can't guess what the Padrino's got in store for us at the rally.
If you're telling me...
If you're telling me he's adopting that <color=yellow>orphan girl from the other side of the family</color>, spare me. Already heard.
Actually, I imagine the whole family's caught wind of it by now. Isn't that why we're throwing this rally for her today?
Tell me, how on earth do you stay in the loop, tinkering away at home like that? You must be shocked, Capollo is already the heir, so why on earth did he adopt her?
In a corner of the mansion, Carlotta's gaze is drawn to two members engaged in conversation.
(Orphan girl from the other side of the family, adopted by Padrino... This rally... held for me?)
(A mere touch of the mirror was enough to instantly draw out my <color=yellow>memories, experiences</color>, and even passing <color=yellow>thoughts</color>, creating this Sonoro.)
Carlotta pauses, trying to make sense of the situation, but one of the members suddenly notices her and begins asking questions, much to her surprise.
Hmm? You look a little fami— Oh, it's you again! What brings you back here?
You shouldn't know me yet. Not at this time.
I don't understand... What time? What are you talking about?
Sorry, please don't mind what I just said. I'm not really sure where I am, why I am here, or what I need to do.
Actually, I think he meant to say we just saw you. Just now, uh, about a minute ago. You walked right past us and headed that way.
Yeah, I'm just surprised you're back so soon. By the way, you do look a bit different, don't you?
Your outfit... No, it's more the accessories, really. Yours are red, but the person I saw had <color=yellow>blue</color> ones on her wrists... Hmm. Perhaps I'm imagining things.
(Blue accessories... I saw blue accessories on that hand that pulled me inside.)
I suppose she's the friend who invited me here. Could you tell me where she's gone? I've been left alone since arriving, and I believe I really should meet her.
Perhaps she's just out for a stroll? The preparations are behind schedule due to a mishap, and everyone's waiting for the rally to begin.
(Yes, now I remember... the rally didn't start on time because of a <color=yellow>lighting</color> malfunction....)
(On the other hand, once the lights are turned on... Something may change, and it could reveal new clues.)
Thank you. I think I know where I'm going now.
Uh, you're welcome, I suppose? Not that we've done much for you.

I doubt it means much to say this to you… since you only exist in this place, and unlike me, you probably don't need to hear this. But I believe Padrino took her in because he saw the makings of a true Montelli.
All right. Time to check the lobby.
Come over, my child.
Sir... are you talking to me?
Yes. Fret not, Carlotta. Come up to the front so everyone can see you.
(I'm looking at what happened <color=yellow>eleven years ago</color>...)
(Two entirely different moments are crossing paths right now...)
Today is a special day, the beginning of your journey as one of us.
As my granddaughter, you will now carry the Montelli name—my name, the family's name—and with it, its privileges and responsibilities.
(It's like I am reliving <color=yellow>the past</color>...)
(This is <color=yellow>not exactly how it happened</color>.)
Puny little thing... such a nervous look to her.
Isn't she from the lesser side of the family? And a girl at that... Why her? What makes her worthy of the Montelli name?
My thoughts exactly. I fail to see how she could possibly belong to our ranks, let alone carry the family name.
I knew it! She shares our bloodline!
She is a true Montelli, just like the Padrino!
...It was you!
Recognition, praise, glory, isn't that what you want?
Stay here, and you'll have all of that.
Is that... the exit?
Dazzling sunlight… Am I in the court? Have I left that Sonoro already?
No, these decorations...they aren't real, even if they appear to be. This is just another simulation from <color=yellow>my memories</color>.
Now, the question is... <color=yellow>What moment from my past</color> does this represent?
How do I leave this place?
Leave? But didn't you just follow me here?
...Cut the nonsense. You were the one who brought me into this Sonoro.
Ugh, fine. But why should I tell you?
True, I brought you here. But remember, I am a product of your own making—your memories, your desires, your fantasies...
From this moment on, I am also Carlotta Montelli. We will share the same past, present, and perhaps even future.
Don't pretend we're alike in any way. And keep the Montelli name out of your filthy mouth.
Oh, right! How could I forget? You worked so hard to earn the illustrious Montelli name back then... And this was your humble abode, correct?
A poor little girl from the forgotten side of the family, trying desperately to fit in with the grandeur of her new home, fearing abandonment, and playing the part of a proper lady.
You're a star in the ballroom, a top investor at the auction house. But your true talent? Being the family's favorite weapon, carrying out orders without question. Is that all you live for?
I thought you'd be thrilled with what I'm offering you! Acceptance, validation, indispensability... Did you see how everyone adored you? Isn't this a dream come true?
Oh, planning to shoot me again?
Don't bother. This Sonoro is born from your consciousness, and it's also my domain.
Since the frequencies here can be shattered, they can also be brought together again… Why not try shooting yourself? Perhaps that will work.
Don't be so quick to deny it. If you truly never craved acceptance and recognition, would I even exist?
Nice work, but this is only the beginning.
You must be dying to know which part of the past this is. Would you like a little hint?
The wind abruptly ceases, leaving Carlotta enveloped in an oppressive, humid stillness tinged with a metallic scent.
Damn it all! You think you could've breached our defenses so quickly without someone backstabbing Padrino?
Blood debts must be paid with blood. We will not let this slide, not while a single Montelli lives!
Thanks, milady… Our men need help... Please, they're in the back…
How did this happen? How much intel do the Fisalias have on us... The West End, our mansion... both under siege...
We can't just sit idly by and let them have their way... What now? We need a plan before it's too late!
Three key areas have been hit one after another: South Second Block, West End dock, and our headquarters.
Intel says the Fisalias are gearing up for another hit on our headquarters. As usual, we can expect the Order to turn a blind eye.
They ambushed Father first, before we did anything to them... It is beyond unforgivable!

We're running out of time. Capollo, we need a plan before Padrino wakes up. Call for reinforcements from the East End. It's risky, but if they don't smell our manpower shortage… we might just make it through.
(No, we shouldn't do that...The Fisalias were keeping an eye on our other territories.)
No, we're not doing that. They can take the West End. Our men will retreat to headquarters.
Why? They're tough, but we're no pushovers either! We earned our turf fair and square. Why should we back down now?
When Padrino eventually wakes, how do you plan to explain that we have let his and the entire family's efforts go to waste?
(But we still risk exposing the location of our headquarters. It's all about predicting their moves... and keeping ours hidden.)
...What about you, Carlotta? What do you think?
(Once again, this deviates from my past experience... Well, I'll point them down the right path this time.)
We'll hit their base.
Our people on the East End, the South Second Block, and the dock will stay put to give the impression we know nothing.
Then we'll send our main forces to where the Fisalias keep their Echoes. The trade routes mean nothing compared to that.
As they know what we value most, we need to demand something of equal worth from them as our bargaining chip.
Is this really going to work?
We can't afford to lose our people. Everything else, even the mansion are simply assets.
I'll cover the rear.
Wrong, wrong again... Do you really think you can choose the right path?
Stay, let's get lost in this maze together, from one window to another… I'll keep your company..
Left! You should've gone left! Wait... Or maybe not?
Think it over, I told you before. You should take the easier way out!
Do you truly think you are worthy of the Montelli name?
Just give up... What an embarrassing sight. It's so painful to watch.
Why are you...
I was worried you might be in danger.
Also, I'm here to deliver this.
The gun was always there. You earned the right to use it the moment you chose to act on your own accord.
Looks like you've made up your mind.
I am merely a blade made for killing. Am I really qualified to change the status quo?
Why won't you obey my orders!
I'm getting old. We should take the easier approach.
If we can make other people pay the price...
So...
Why can't you just give in to me and stay here?
H-how dare she eat the tribute...
Prayer alone
Nanny always said
Repurposing decoration into a weapon,
Come with me.
The family will shield you
You will rise to become...
A true Montelli.
In the face of survival,
Who would have thought

Anchor

These stabilizing devices are strategically positioned throughout the surface and underground parts of the Black Shores. Their primary function is to calibrate and stabilize the frequencies of the giant Tacetites that make up the island, effectively isolating the Tethys System's virtual layer from reality. Additionally, these Anchors facilitate communication and carry the responsibility of observing the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need to build a Nexus Tower in the Black Shores.

The Anchors are independently developed and designed by the Black Shores, drawing inspiration from the reactor control rods used in pre-Lament reactor engineering. They are considered exemplary models of the Black Shores' minimalist engineering design.

We won't... ever give up on anyone.

I had pictured our reunion in my head, again and again, after your departure. I wondered what kind of person you would become, how your days were spent, and if you achieved your goals. Countless questions filled my mind, but when I saw you again, there was only one thing I wanted to say: Welcome back. Back to the Black Shores, and… back to my side.

Time changes everything—Blake Blooms, Stellar Matrices, and the Black Shores—all constantly in flux. I've documented these changes, repairing the damage and preserving the good. Yet, I wonder... Am I doing enough? Have I earned your trust? These questions haunt me, but I press on, seeking solace in my work.

Your past... I promised to keep it a secret, at your own request. That day, I realized our reunion would be one-sided. This is why your memory loss didn't surprise me... But it doesn't matter now. You may have forgotten me, but I will remember everything about you, always.

Humans dream to fulfill their desires. For a long time, I believed such dreams were not meant for me, as I had never yearned for anything. Until one day... I dreamed of you. We were strolling through an unfamiliar land, basking in the warm sunlight. You showed me your world and shared stories of your past. You even brewed a cup of tea for me... Though only a figment of my imagination, I wished that moment could last a little longer.

Next time you journey to distant lands, could you bring me along? I don't want to watch from afar or hear secondhand about your adventures. I long to experience the unknown by your side, as your friend... Please, will you give me the chance?

Pressing a piano key creates an enchanting sound from the vibrating strings. Unlike other frequencies I've processed, a piano produces a pure, clear, and vivid tone. If I could one day communicate my emotions as simply and intuitively as humans do... If I could create my own melodies, would you be my first listener?

I cannot physically grow and age, and therefore can never truly comprehend the range of emotions that come with it as a human does. Despite my wealth of knowledge and ability to replicate others' experiences through the Sonoro, these feelings remain enigmatic to me, forever distant and unfamiliar.

Long ago, during our days together at the Black Shores, you used to prepare chowder for us, blending milk, seafood, and vegetables. One spoonful of its warmth could dispel the freezing sea wind and restore stamina. Despite multiple attempts, I cannnot seem to recreate that flavor.

The food I hate... Hmm, hate might be too strong a word, but I tend to steer clear of pickled food, like preserved plums. While I appreciate their long shelf life, the fermented smell reminds me of their preserved nature.

My purpose had been clear long before my creation: to build a safe haven from the unrelenting waves of the Lament, until humanity could find a path to a brighter tomorrow. It used to be my duty, but now... it is a choice. I am one with the Black Shores. I want to prevent more tragedies from happening, I want to protect everyone, I... I want to safeguard my connection with the world around me. This is my own will.

Ah, so you've noticed the crystal on my chest. It's not an adornment, but a fissure brimming with the energy emanating from my body. Through it, you can touch the core I've managed to keep safe since my creation. It resembles the kernel of a fruit, or the beating heart of a human, where the essence of life is preserved.

Remnant Energy coalesced into a crystal cocoon on a moonlit shore, stirred by the crashing waves, and the breath and heartbeat of a certain individual. That person then infused it with {Male=his;Female=her} own frequencies, and the butterfly within finally emerged... Yes, you've guessed it. You are the one I speak of, the force that gave me life and form.

Though her words may not always align with her actions, she remains fiercely loyal to her desires. Her carefree lifestyle holds a certain charm, yes, but we were made differently, with distinct objectives to pursue. Following your example, I've allowed her to make her own choices, without limitations.

A mature organization requires a personable and skilled negotiator, adept at forging connections with all they encounter. In the case of the Black Shores, that person is Aalto. His keen insight ensures he obtains crucial information precisely when needed. Beneath his playful smile lies a resolute determination to end the Lament. Despite other offers, he was destined for the Black Shores' path from the start.

Encore sees the world as a canvas for her boundless imagination. A warrior, a knight, or a little adventurer... In her tales, she can become anyone she wants to triumph over evil and reach a happy ending. Wherever she ventures, her radiant energy dispels dismay. Perhaps this is what Tethys saw in her when she was chosen.

Atop this massive Tacetite lies the ideal “singularity” spot to observe the Lament. This is where we formed the Black Shores, its members distinguished by their Blake Blooms. Beneath the endless stars, humanity's light glimmers. That light belongs to those who had given their lives to illuminate a brighter future for all. I've welcomed countless such people into this place... and bid farewell to just as many.

The Tethys System and I are creations of the same civilization, and we are bound by similar obligations. By human standards, we are of the same kind. Yet, our perceptions of emotions, humanity, and existence diverge, leading us down distinctly separate paths.

Happy birthday, {PlayerName}. You once taught me a person's birthday is their most important day. So, I've made it a habit to prepare something in advance for days like this... Please have this crystal—it's a piece of myself. Hold it, and you'll be enveloped in a personalized Sonoro Sphere, where you can change everything to your liking. Though I cannot bring you what you truly want, let me gift you a peaceful dream to escape your worries.

A shattered crystal fell from the Shorekeeper's body, dimming as its energy waned.
 
The stars lit the path ahead as the tide of calamities ebbed. Steadfast in her duty, the Shorekeeper used herself as a medium, while the relentless occurences of the Lament threatened to tear her apart. Energy crystals dimmed and detached, leaving cracks across her body, only to be replaced by new ones she forged from Remnants.
 
Though parts of her were lost, the Shorekeeper endured, like the Ship of Theseus—a vessel of change, each fragment a record of her past and the essence of who she is today.

Stars flicker in the eternal night beneath the Black Shores, where time flows without the rhythm of seasons. In this place untouched by time, Rover created a self-sustaining hourglass for the Shorekeeper.

An energy substance flows endlessly between its twin chambers, completing a cycle every 42 days. This number, both finite and boundless, marks the time the Tethys System requires for a full simulation and deduction cycle—from bloom to doom. During this 42-day interval set by Rover, the Shorekeeper finds brief yet comforting solace in her lifelong vigil as she waits for the day she's reunited with her one and only.

A record crafted from a substance infused with Remnant Energy, possessing near-infinite storage. 
 
It holds every sound the Shorekeeper has ever gathered from this planet—storm and wind, the cries of birds, the songs of whales. It captures music spanning countless eras and vowel whispers from over 50 languages... Each sound is a testament to the marvel of existence, a trace of life, science, and the civilizations that once thrived.
 
The Shorekeeper preserved her duet with Rover at the end of this record. To her, this melody is proof of their existence. As long as the record endures and the sounds of this planet continue, the contents of this record will forever grow.

A booklet Youhu always carries to jot down her favorite poems and snippets of inspiration for her limericks. 
 
They say to record all your ideas—you never know when they'll come in handy. That's exactly what Youhu does every day, capturing every clever thought, whether for antique appraisals or an occasion that calls for a witty poem. It's her way of keeping her mind sharp. 
 
But of course, this is her little secret, so let's keep it between us, hm?

An ice mask conjured by Youhu's Forte. The design differs from the original, but the sly grin on the mask mirrors Youhu's own when she's scheming up some mischief. 
 
Youhu often toys with this mask in her spare time, keeping it as a reminder of how she was nearly deceived when appraising the original antique early in her career. 
 
Beyond serving as a cautionary symbol, it's also the perfect prop for giving people a good scare or pulling a fast one on those who catch her interest.

A jade ring once cracked, now repaired by Youhu with her cryogenic Forte.
 
Once lost in the chaos of a fire, this family heirloom has finally found its way back to Youhu after an arduous search spanning miles. She still dreams of the old days—the gentle breeze from her mother's fan, the sound of her father brewing tea. When she wakes, she often finds the Ruyi ring clutched in her hand.
 
Ruyi, a symbol of peace and happiness, is believed to grant one's wishes. To Youhu, it's more than just an antique.

Street Antique Appraisal
A Returned Treasure
Where History Endures
The Value of Antiques
The Ruyi Ring

On the busiest street in Jinzhou, a small appraisal stall occasionally appears, adding a touch more excitement to the bustling scene.
 
The stall owner is a lively girl Youhu who confidently considers herself a seasoned appraiser. She claims that with just a light touch, she can discern the history behind any antique. Her early career saw just one slip-up—misjudging an ancient Ding. She later purchased it from the client, repaired it with her cryogenic powers, and now keeps it close as a reminder to stay sharp.
 
Despite her playful self-promotion and carefree antics, people don't mind trusting her, especially since her appraisal fees are modest—just the cost of a meal and a sprinkle of compliments.
 
"This folding screen predates Jinzhou, a rare treasure perfectly preserved! You can even call it a witness to Jinzhou's rise and fall!”
 
"The glaze here? Smooth as jade, soft as silk. It's not ancient, but the craftsmanship is definitely worth the price!"
 
Her insights, whether on artistry or historical value, hit the mark every time, earning her the trust of her clients. 
 
Adding to the charm of her appraisals is a unique flair—call it a show, if you will.
 
While others might inspect antiques with magnifying glasses, Youhu examines each piece with lively gestures, reciting witty poems as if she's performing some ancient, mysterious ritual. 
 
Initially, people worried she might accidentally damage their valuables, but after seeing her skills, they've come to embrace her eccentric ways. Perhaps true masters just have their... well, quirks.

Youhu always carries a scroll-like box filled with miniature replicas of antiques she's appraised, each crafted with her Forte. These replicas aren't just souvenirs, but handy tools to fend off Tacet Discords. In the summer, they can double as coolers. Just pop some fruit in with an iced replica, and voilà—a chilled snack!
 
Inside the box is also a booklet where she writes limericks about every antique she encounters:
 
"A guy from the Ministry of Development asked me to find that missing enameled porcelain from Huanglong. Noted!"
 
"That merchant definitely got the celadon tripod incense burner through shady means! I hinted he should return it, but who knows if he'll listen. Better keep an eye on him."
 
"That carpenter at the city gate is chopping wood with a centuries-old knife! The audacity! What a disgrace! I'll... let it slide this time. Just need to tell him the knife's true worth later."
 
These interesting notes help keep her memories fresh.
 
Take that merchant with the incense burner. After weeks of strange events and sleepless nights, he recalled the street appraiser's warning:
 
"Haiya, that incense burner's from a bad place! Your luck won't hold up against it—misfortune's coming your way!"
 
She had said it with such flair, like a storyteller spinning a tall tale. The merchant hadn't taken her seriously at first, but his recent misfortunes made him reconsider.
 
One night, after the fifteenth eerie shadow flitted outside his window with its bone-chilling shriek, he rushed to return the stolen burner.
 
Had he dared to look up, he might have seen another scene unfolding: 
 
The Patrollers had spotted a suspicious figure on the rooftops and moved in to question them.

Youhu, dressed in a makeshift disguise, saw the guards approaching and fled, stumbling a few times along the way.
 
Even as she ran, she managed to jot down in her booklet: "Celadon tripod incense burner, returned to its rightful place."

Youhu was born in a bustling port town known for its antique trade, where her parents were both esteemed appraisers. 
 
On her first birthday, her parents, following local customs, surrounded her with objects representing various trades. It was said that the first item the child touched would predict their future interests and career path.
 
But that day, little Youhu ignored pens, swords, and cooking utensils, crawling straight to her mother to latch onto the family's precious heirloom—a genuine antique Ruyi ring—and refused to let go.
 
Growing up surrounded by antiques, Youhu's love for them blossomed. She was fascinated by everything about them, soaking up the driest, most obscure appraisal facts with a twinkle in her eye. But what she loved most was listening to the stories her parents told about the antiques.
 
The deep chimes of the ancient bell echoed with memories of distant times when people knelt in devotion before golden statues praying for their family's wellbeing. 
 
The stone carvings depicted bold youths drawing their bows, warding off Tacet Discords to protect the people.
 
Youhu's lively nature shone through as she immersed herself in the world of antiques, the Tacet Mark on her arm glowing faintly to illuminate her eyes.
 
In every antique, she saw a little piece of history and a glimpse into the remnants of a civilization. This magic still holds her spellbound today.

Chenpi, Youhu's master, often praised her talent. "To be honest, your knowledge of antiques lacks structure. But don't worry, I'll teach you everything you need to know."
 
"What's truly valuable is your respect for the history in these antiques and your keen perception. In other words, you're a natural appraiser."
 
And Youhu would flash a cheeky grin, "Pfft, my parents already said I was born for this."

The so-called renowned appraisers are always squabbling over the value of antiques.
 
First, they downplay an antique's value, snapping it up for a pittance, only to turn around and hype it up to sell for a fortune. Craftsmanship? History? Mere afterthoughts in their pricing games.
 
However, Youhu has a different approach. For her, the worth of an antique isn't measured solely in currency, but something more unique.
 
Genuine appreciation is the first factor. Youhu enjoys facilitating deals where buyers are deeply respectful of the antiques and sellers entrust their cherished items to someone who truly appreciates them. As the antique changes hands, its frequency is mirrored in the hearts of both parties.
 
Another factor would be conscience. When Youhu was seven, raiders ransacked the town looking for riches. To them, antiques were just another form of loot.
 
The wealthy merchants and local appraisers panicked, abandoning their treasures as they escaped.
 
The raiders, ignorant about the true worth of these antiques, justified their plundering by saying the people here didn't deserve their treasures anyway, and such items might as well be taken somewhere they would be appreciated.
 
But not everyone fled. Some stood their ground, facing the raiders with steely resolve. They knew the true value of these antiques and defended them to the bitter end.
 
And that brings us to the final factor. The courage to sacrifice.
 
Now, it is Youhu's turn to make a sacrifice. Whether it is her talent, her knowledge, or the lengths she will go to recover them, she is determined to return every lost antique back to its rightful owner.
 
In the past, those who couldn't see the value in these relics trampled all over them. But today, Youhu's mission is to return each lost antique to where it truly belongs.

Over the course of examining countless antiques, Youhu has developed a habit of replicating her favorites with her cryogenic powers. 
 
She once made an ice chime. It didn't quite match the original's melody, but the crisp sound of shattering ice was delightful in its own way. She also crafted an ice Ruyi, swinging it with such gusto that she nearly smashed the nearby ice cauldron and mask!
 
People often ask about her most treasured antique. Youhu always hesitates, her eyes fixed on the Ruyi ring before her. This is her family's heirloom—once shattered, but now pieced together with ice.
 
Her mother had told her that the Ruyi ring symbolized completeness and good fortune. Youhu was mesmerized by the clear and translucent jade. But when raiders came, she could only watch as the ring and other treasures were pillaged and shipped away.
 
Three years later, she found those plundered items displayed as trophies in a museum. Despite an exhaustive search, the Ruyi ring was nowhere to be found.
 
It wasn't until she stumbled into a dusty storage room that she found the ring's shattered fragments, along with a tag that read "Low value, not for display." What she valued most was dismissed by those who didn't understand its true worth.
 
Heartbroken yet determined, Youhu clutched the fragments and trudged through knee-deep snow, her tears freezing as they fell. Driven by a sudden thought, she ignored the biting cold, crouched down, and used her Forte to piece the ring back together from the ice before losing consciousness.
 
When she awoke, her hands were etched with delicate snowflake patterns. The next thing she saw was a perfect, gleaming ice Ruyi ring lying beside her, as if it had been waiting for her all along.

Ragunna, the tempest's jewel, the sapphire that crowns Solaris...
The waters of Ragunna serve as a mirror, reflecting the countless faces of this city—much like our own reflections.
The people of Ragunna possess a temperament akin to the tides, ever-changing. We like to describe ourselves as drifters of currents.
For, to us, drifting is not a negative attribute. It speaks to opportunity, to potential. I find it quite charming, much like your name—Rover—seems to promise.
Our founders went with the flow and discovered these islands. Centuries later, the Montellis too drifted with currents, acquiring new technologies from distant lands.
Once, the Blessed Maiden was just a simple peasant girl. During the Sentinel's Gratitude Rite, the young Fleurdelys managed to sneak past the guards and drink the sacramental wine—every drop.
Perhaps it was the intoxicating wine in Egla Town or simply her lack of experience with spirits, but she soon found herself quite drunk.
Swaying on her feet, she ascended the ceremony's grand platform, lifted her threadbare dress, and began a rather ungainly dance.
Seizing the sacred horn, she played a carefree folk tune, dodging the guards and weaving through the crowd with surprising agility.
Remarkably, the crowd, as if drawn by an unseen force, followed her lead, transforming the solemn ceremony into a wild parade of cheers and revelry.
Naturally, the Order was less than pleased. The Pilgrim's Sail did not yet exist, so Fleurdelys faced three days of confinement. During that time, she used her prison walls as a canvas.
That unforgettable day of disordered revelry left a lasting mark on all who witnessed it.
I believe the same.
The divine is always beyond our comprehension.
Perhaps, the true intention of the Sentinel isn't to rule their people by faith.
The people of this island came from diverse civilizations now lost to time, but through plays and tradition, they sought to preserve memories of their heritage.
In the past, while the clash of cultures led to conflict, the Ragunnesi united through faith, restoring balance, even if precarious.
To maintain this unity, we have always needed both a Sentinel and a "play" based on a shared legend that gives us roles.
Yet, this play has endured for so long that we have become defined by our roles—noble, commoner, believer, merchant. What was meant to unite us now stifles us.
Integration was the past.
Liberation is the present.
Now, we yearn for a day when we can truly set aside our titles and positions, express our true selves, and join together in celebration...
So, this is the true purpose of the Carnevale.
Yes, born from hope and idealism, it reminds the Ragunnesi of our initial vision of equality and freedom. It also affirms our true worth.
While the Order's true intentions remain unclear, we are certain their influence has already eroded the very foundations of our society.
People revere the divine figure the Order has constructed, yet they also live in fear of punishment.
Legends become accomplices in fostering ignorance, and faith becomes the loyal executioner of cruel punishment. An invisible cage has trapped us all...
Speaking of freedom within a cage is absurd. Fear and ignorance are our foremost enemies.
This year's Carnevale will spark a flame fierce enough to burn down that cage.
Freedom is in our nature.
Our future is in our own hands.
I'll stoke the flames even higher.
Rest well, and tomorrow, we shall take the stage together at the Carnevale.
Good night. May your dreams be sweet.

After all you've been through, your body aches for rest. As you sink into the soft bed, you let your thoughts settle and drift into a peaceful sleep, preparing yourself for the excitement and challenges of the upcoming Carnevale.
Ms. Margherita, is my order ready yet?
I was about to say, I've been waiting quite a while!
Sorry, we're swamped with orders! Bakie and I are doing our best, but it's a bit chaotic. Bakie seems to be having some issues too.
*Beep—Beep—*
No need to worry. Let me take a look.
Ah, I see. Bakie's just a bit overloaded with all the work. It might need a short break.
Oh? Good morning, my friend.
Maybe you need to put down your work and enjoy the Carnevale.
Why not join me in the celebrations?
I'd love to, really. Look... see this mask?
However, it's crystal clear to me that keeping things running smoothly is a top priority right now.
Lady Carlotta has already briefed me on your plan. Along with the other family members, you can count on my full support.
Is that C-MOSS from the Pioneer Association? Something seems off—why does he look sad?
*Humph…*
Ah, C-MOSS has been so busy taking photos for everyone else that he hasn't had the chance to take any himself.
*Humph!*
Hmm? You want a picture with me? But...
I'll take the picture for you.
I'd like to capture this moment.
I don't think there's a rule against taking photos with Echoes, right?
Oh, hello, {PlayerName}. Well, thank you. Yes... a photo would be wonderful.

You come across Encore who is on vacation in Jinzhou. She is overjoyed to see you.

With enthusiasm, she introduces you to her friends and reserves a seat, inviting you to listen to her latest story.

As you open your eyes, the world around you snaps back to reality.

Encore explains that only those who truly believe in her tale are welcomed into her Wooly Kingdom.

She invites you to join her Wooly Adventure Squad to see the story's end with her.

The first step in this journey is to gather the thoughts of the audience about the tale.

While collecting opinions, you meet a girl named Ying, who shares with you a treasure map leading to the Sword of Courage. This map holds a promise between Ying and her mother, with her deepest wish being to reunite with her once more.

Determined to fulfill Ying's wish and bring the Wooly Warrior's adventure to its good conclusion, you set off to uncover three legendary relics.

Upon arriving at your destination, you're suddenly ambushed by a horde of monsters!

To safeguard your friends, the courageous Wooly Warrior rises to the challenge!

After defeating the monsters, you discover a mechanism at the site.

It can only be unlocked using the treasure map.

With great effort, you finally reach the top platform of the mechanism and unlock the chest—inside lies the Sword of Courage and a mysterious letter.

The letter reveals that the next relic, the Shield of Faith, is buried deep in the sands ahead.
Upon reaching the sands where the Shield of Faith is hidden, you and your team split up to search for the relic.

After discovering the Shield of Faith along with a second letter, you learn that the Wreath of Hope is hidden within the Garden.

Ying then reveals that she knows the location of the Garden, and you agree to journey there together.

When you arrive at the Garden, you find that all the Irises have withered.

Ying realizes that these flowers were meant to be a special gift from her mother. Though she knows she will never see her mother again, she still expresses her gratitude for your help.

However, Encore senses the sorrow hidden beneath Ying's calm exterior and makes a promise with Ying that she will return to the Garden to witness the Wooly Adventure Squad's journey.

After Ying leaves, Encore reveals to you the true origin of the Wooly Adventure Squad story—it was a cherished gift from her own mother.

Encore explains that this story, passed down from her mother, has always been a source of strength for her. To Encore, stories are more than just an escape—they're a way to find the courage needed for new adventures. She hopes to share that same courage with Ying.

Determined to fulfill Ying's wish and give a perfect end to Encore's story, you and Encore decide to create a Wreath of Hope. To accomplish this, you seek the help of Verina.
With Verina's guidance, you and Encore set out to find the perfect flowers that represent your feelings, weaving them together into a beautiful wreath.
After gathering the flowers, you craft the wreath, preparing to present it to Ying the next afternoon as a fulfillment of your promise.

At the appointed time, you return to the Garden and listen as Encore tells the story of the Wooly Warrior—an adventure meant for the three of you.

As the story concludes, you present the Wreath of Hope to Ying, sharing your thoughts and feelings with her.

To complete the Wreath of Hope and keep the promise with her mother, you decide to embark on one final journey to the Wooly Kingdom, in search of Irises that bloom at last.

The small warriors finally achieve their wishes, bringing a perfect end to this adventure.

As you bid farewell to the Wooly Kingdom, you know that tomorrow holds the promise of new adventures filled with hope.

You and Encore make a pinkie promise, vowing to craft the next story together.  The adventure of the Wooly Warrior will never truly end.

You settle in, listening intently as Encore begins the story of the Wooly Warrior.

In her tale, the Wooly Warrior embarks on a perilous journey to reunite with its family, seeking the Gateway of Wishes.

"If you believe in this story and wish to make your own dreams come true, close your eyes," whispers Fairy Cloudy.

Taking her words to heart, you close your eyes, ready to plunge into a new adventure.

As you traverse the Sonoro Sphere, you finally arrive at your true beginnings. Yet, the person who waits here remains beyond your grasp…

Passing through the mist, you encounter Aalto on patrol. After you recount your recent experience, he speculates that the blue figure you just saw might be the Shorekeeper from the Black Shores. However, the immediate priority is to upload the abnormal frequency to the Tethys System for analysis. Meanwhile, the Black Shores seem to be grappling with certain anomalies...
You meet Monica, the chief administrator of the Black Shores, and discover that the Tethys System has been experiencing instability. You then brief her on the recent events in the Port City of Guixu.

Even Monica, the chief administrator of the Black Shores, has never heard of the name Hoda. Right after your discussion, another quake shakes the Black Shores, echoing the disaster in the Port City of Guixu. To safeguard the Tethys System, Monica instructs you to inspect the Modulation Device in the Greenhouse.

You hand over the data to the specialized robot at the Black Shores, which swiftly uploads it into the Tethys System. The merchant known as KU-Money, perhaps mistaking you as one of their own, rewards you with a substantial sum of money. However, despite its extensive knowledge of the Black Shores, the robot knows nothing of Hoda's true identity.

Yangyang has sent word that a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores is currently in the Port City of Guixu and may have important information about your identity. Upon your arrival in the city, you happen to run into Chenpi's apprentice, Youhu…

In the Greenhouse, you encounter two robots that recognize you as the lone Rover of Solaris. They speak of Blake Blooms as if you share a connection with them, but it appears that the Tethys System is somehow restraining them from revealing the truth of your identity…

A strange piano, known as the Modulation Device, plays its notes unbidden, offering fleeting glimpses of the past through sound and frequency. As you and Abby dive deeper into these reveries, a violent tremor shatters the moment…

With all restorations complete, you scarcely have a moment to rest before the enigmatic Bloom Bearer Hoda reappears, addressing you as the mentor she has been following. Shortly after, the Shorekeeper herself emerges, welcoming your return…

The Shorekeeper explains that during your absence, she and the Tethys System had taken over the running of the Black Shores. She confirms that it was indeed she who saved you, Yangyang, and Youhu in the Port City of Guixu. To address the threats posed by Hoda and the looming crisis in both the Black Shores and the Port City of Guixu, the Shorekeeper requests that you venture underground, to where the starry sky awaits...

In the Port City of Guixu, you meet Niya, a Bloom Bearer who quickly recognizes you. She warns of an abnormal frequency detected in Guixu that must be urgently brought back to the Black Shores. If left unresolved, it might trigger another Lament…

Astral Modulator, Guide of Civilizations, Mastermind of the Black Shores... these titles reflect your accomplishments. In the starry underground sky, the Necrostar streaks like a meteor into the distance. The Shorekeeper asks that you retrieve the Necrostar and restore balance at the Modulation Hall.

You and the Shorekeeper finally arrive at the Error Cell where the Necrostar has fallen. However, you find that many of the injured have been severely affected by the corrupted data and cannot be saved.

The Shorekeeper can sense the underlying emotions feeding into deceit, pity, and other behavior, but struggles to fully understand them. She reveals that the data you recovered is related to the Lament from the Port City of Guixu, and the Tethys System is using the Lament itself to fight against it...

With the Shorekeeper's assistance, you successfully retrieve the source of the chaos—the Necrostar. Abby, though weary, protests your involvement but lacks the strength to intervene. The Shorekeeper, meanwhile, appears deeply concerned about you and Abby's unique symbiosis.

A robot stationed in the Eidoscope informs you that the Shorekeeper has been guarding the Black Shores for the past twenty years. She often conceals herself using her Sonoro, as if anticipating someone's return...

Ensnared by her Sonoro's overflow, you are drawn into the disasters the Shorekeeper has "lived" through while analyzing the Lament. Her form, created by the Sonoro Sphere, is bound to the Tethys System's calculations. Her sole desire is to protect you and the Black Shores, but a hidden truth lingers in her heart...

After bringing the Necrostar back to the Modulation Hall, you prepare to head to the Stellar Matrix for remodulation. At this moment, the Shorekeeper, who has been in slumber, appears before you in physical form. She pleads to accompany you on the path that lies ahead.

The Tethys System manipulates the Necrostar, attempting to consume you as its core. In a desperate bid to save you, the Shorekeeper is swallowed into the Necrostar. When you awaken, you find yourself in the deepest part of the Tethys System, known as the "End of Wandering." In her final moments, the Shorekeeper bids you farewell.

As the newly reinstated highest administrator of the Tethys System, you announce to all of the Black Shores that past mistakes must be set right. Only by saving people can civilization itself be saved. As a member of the Black Shores, you face a crucial decision: If the Black Shores is a haven for every wandering soul, your mission is now to bring every lost soul back home.
The Shorekeeper and you return to reality, landing on the very beach where you first arrived in the Black Shores. She explains her deception regarding the Stellar Matrix and expresses her gratitude.
The Shorekeeper warns you of Abby's anomalies. Through your intervention, the Tethys System has returned to its rightful state, now operating with peaceful and harmonious frequencies.

Upon arriving at the coordinates provided by Niya, you find the bodies of several Black Shores members who have died under mysterious circumstances. There, you encounter a mysterious Bloom Bearer named Hoda, who claims to know about your past but cannot divulge the details. Before disappearing, Hoda directs you to Youhu for further clues...

Youhu reveals that the clue Hoda mentioned is an artifact from Mt. Firmament, discovered by her and Master Chenpi. Now, it seems connected with the Black Shores. The frequency tied to Hoda is hidden within this artifact, and it seems linked to the deaths of the Bloom Bearers. Reporting this matter to Niya and the Black Shores is now a matter of urgency.

Ku! I know it!

Guess we'll just have to wait for a turning point.

Just doing my duty as a Bloom Bearer.
All for the Black Shores.
I promised to give you a proper welcome as our new member after this crisis.

We can do it next time.
You notice Monica frowning, clearly worried about something.
Is something bothering you?

The issue with Tethys is resolved, so the corrupted data in Black Shores should have been cleared as well.
But the infected members aren't showing any signs of recovery.
In other words, the source of the infection is gone, but their condition isn't improving.
Sounds like phantom pain.
Sounds like a cognitive issue.
The medical team thinks so, too.
The Shorekeeper's been helping with their treatment. I just hope they'll get better soon.
They will. Don't worry.
Let me know if I can help.
Thank you, {PlayerName}.
The corrupted data at the Anchor has been cleared, and the backlog of anomaly data is finally running smoothly again.
Anomaly data?
Yes, it's a collection of data on Reverberations, Tacet Discords, and other anomalies caused by the Lament.
What can we do with it?
For example, with Tethys' computing power, we can build evolutionary models of the Tacet Discords to predict how they might develop in the future.
We can also input Reverberations gathered from the Lament zone into Tethys to recreate those areas in the Sand Table.
But from what we've observed so far, the Sand Table has its limits.
The more ancient the Lament, the more diluted the Reverberations are, which makes it harder to replicate the affected areas accurately.
Still, I believe this is just the beginning of what Tethys can do. There's much more potential to tap.
It's said that the Chief Steward of the Black Shores once dedicated all of Tethys' computing power to simulating the development of civilizations.
However, this practice pushed the System to the brink of collapse.
The Stellar Navigators were amazed by Tethys' nearly otherworldly programming.
Still, even such power is fragile in a world where the future is always uncertain.
Preventing disasters, preserving the sparks of civilization, and monitoring the Lament—these are the duties we bear at the Black Shores, a promise we've made to humanity.
If sacrifice is what's needed for a better future, then... I'll keep walking this path, carrying on the struggle until my last breath.
The Data Torrent connecting all the Nexus on this planet continuously transfers information about abnormal fluctuations caused by the Lament and Waveworn back to celestial bodies.
These bodies, programmed with high-dimensional code, are known as Stellar Matrices. Each one functions as a self-evolving supercomputing model.
In the underground area, you can observe how these Matrices evolve through cycles of collision, merging, and destruction.
The Shorekeeper can adjust their orbits by playing the Modulation Piano.
So, in a way... the Shorekeeper is like a coder, and the Stellar Matrices are the source code.
If you put it like that... Yes, they are.
Is this your observation journal?
Y-yes, it is. Sorry, I'll pick it up. Are you hurt?
Let's see... "According to the observations, the collision of the Stellar Matrices suggests the conflict and mutual exclusion between the logic of the computational models..."
"The outer rings of the Matrices have overlapped, suggesting a code exchange and duplication between the two models..."
"Each Matrix represents a vast and complete set of computing logic, and their orbital changes symbolize the execution of codes。"
"...In other words, the Stellar Matrices are observable high-dimensional codes..."
It's neatly written. Are you a new Bloom Bearer?
Yes, my name's Noratus. I'm new to the TD Observatory.
Just came up from the underground area, right?
Uh, yes?
I was just like you when I first saw the starry sky in the underground.
I still remember that scene. It's truly mesmerizing.
Ah, the wind's picking up. We should gather your pages before they get blown away. Let me help you with that.
By the way, I'm Finn, a Gardener managing the Stellar Navigators. If you get the chance, say hello to Zhenjian for me.
Good news, everyone! I got KU-Money's authorization and made this—
Ta-da! KU-Money No. 2!
KU-Money can now log into either of its bodies, so you can find it in the underground area, too!
Hey, KU-Money, how's the connection?
Ku… It's amazing controlling two bodies at once.
Congrats! Now where's my budget?
Congrats! Now where are my three game cartridges?
Congrats! And here's my reimbursement request!
WAIT A MINUTE! Did you create this body just so I'd handle more work?
What other reason could there be? Plus, it's way easier to track you down now.
Ku... Ku ku... System... Error... Ku...
Stop faking it, you cheapskate! Get back online!
Before we head off on our first mission, let's take a photo for a keepsake!
Alright, everyone! Our destination is—
NEW FEDERATION!
Hurry, the light's fading! On three—two—one—
Cheese!
Teeth!
Bees!

(A call from an unknown contact... What could it be?)
Hey, is it {PlayerName}? I hope I've finally reached the right person...
Yes, speaking. And you are?
I'm not interested in your product, thank you.
Hello, I'm Vida, running a modest business in Egla Town.
Oh, don't worry. I don't do cold calls. I run a small business here in Egla Town. Just call me Vida.
I've seen you before, haven't I?
What can I do for you?
Have you come across these paintings of vibrant colors standing in a dreary field in the wild?
As if the world around it has lost its color?
As if the world around it has lost its vitality?
Sure, it seems you've encountered them already. The Pioneer Association refers to those Tacet Discords as "Overflowing Palettes," and the areas they affect are known as "Faded Zones."
Such strange phenomena have quietly spread throughout Rinascita, leaving ordinary people completely helpless…
I've just restored a spot.
Wait... you did? I knew you were the right person to talk to.
Please find me in Egla Town when you have a moment. I have a favor to ask of you and we can discuss the details when we meet.
(The call has ended.)
Yawn—Just woke up and already hear you guys chatting...
Wait a minute, this person seems suspicious. How does she know your contact details?
We'll find out.
For I'm the famous Rover!
You're here at last! I was just wondering how much longer I'd have to wait.
Why did you suddenly reach out to me?
Because... 'Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders.'
Hmm, sounds familiar. Isn't that the slogan of the Pioneer Association?
Are you with the Pioneer Association?

I used to be. Back when I was a traveling merchant, I also worked briefly as a contract photographer for the Pioneer Association, capturing landscapes along the trade routes to earn some travel expenses.

Now... as you can see, those strange phenomena have drained the color from many places, making it harder to capture great photos. I've settled down and opened my own shop, so I haven't renewed my contract.
But deep down, I am still unable to move past the faded landscapes.
Do you want me to restore those areas?

Always feels like a breeze to chat with a sharp mind like yours. That is exactly why I got your contact from a former colleague. After all, no one wants the places in their memories to be covered in dull patches, right?
If we can only see those familiar landscapes in photos from now on... it's a depressing thought, isn't it?
Let's talk terms first.
How about a little something to sweeten the deal?
Certainly, I wouldn't expect you to help for free. The Faded Zones often hold abundant mineral deposits and resources. But they can't be accessed due to the influence of the Overflowing Palettes.
Restoring the zones will not only bring back the colors but also the resources. You can trade them with me for some... rare items on the market.
Sounds like this is her true intention...
As a merchant, it's my fundamental skill. So, what do you think? Those goods and offers are exclusively for partners.
Understood, let's seal the deal.
Alright, take a look at what's on the shelves. The resources are just what you need right now.
Thank you for your patronage. From now on, we're long-term business partners.
Let's work together to reclaim the natural colors of our world!
Oh, right, is there anything else you want to ask? For an important partner like you, I'm always an open book.
Where did these rare items come from?
Why not expand your business in Ragunna City?
Do you ever miss your life of traveling?
No further questions.
In my travels across Rinascita, I've built a network of business contacts, many of whom provide me with unique supplies.
Some items, however, have yet to hit the market for various reasons, such as a master chef's secret recipes or some efficacious alternative medicine developed by folks...
Doesn't that make these... black market goods?
Relax. No one's going to come knocking at your door. And even if they do... I'm sure you can handle it, right?
Egla Town is my hometown. Whenever I stand up high and gaze at the windmills spinning in the breeze, I feel a sense of peace.
Ragunna is a bustling city and the big families got eyes all over the place. Not exactly a friendly environment for certain businesses. You know what I'm saying, don't you?
I'm not sure I understand.
Anyway... Although I reside in the town, I actually have business dealings with some shops in the city. You might have indirectly purchased my goods already.
Of course, I often look through the photos I took during my travels, reminiscing about the delightful and challenging moments along the way.
People can't dwell on the past forever. I'll entrust you with <ano=restoring>safeguarding</ano> those beautiful landscapes for now, and I'll continue to support you all the way.
Some of the items on the shelves are in limited supply, but they will be restocked periodically. Be sure to check back often!
Ragunna has a shop called "Rosemary's Apothecary," perhaps you've visited it already. Its owner, Miss Rosemary, is an old client of mine. I wonder if you've noticed—
Her behavior sometimes changes, doesn't it?
I've heard from the elders in town that at the end of Whisperwind Haven lies a mystical island, surrounded by a circular forest encasing a mirror-like lake.
The lake, with its mirror-like calmness, is said to reveal one's "inner self."
It seems... no one has actually reached there yet.

You come across a tattered book. As you flip through it, nothing seems out of place.
Maybe this is what Benett left. You decide to take the book and inspect it later with Carlotta.
You spot a small, delicate rotor device, but you have no idea how to open it.
You decide to take the device and inspect it later with Carlotta.
My people just reported some initial progress on the Terminal repair.
Let's go. Our meet-up spot is right up ahead.

The initial restoration is almost complete, but some data is <color=yellow>overwritten</color> or <color=yellow>isolated</color> due to the extensive damage... We were only able to recover certain sections.
Our evaluation suggests that a full restoration might not be worth it. But if you insist, <color=yellow>Mr. Pierre</color> at the headquarters is an expert in this field.
Good, make sure to contact him. Now, please project the restored sections.
Absolutely, one moment.
Carlotta's agent takes out the damaged Terminal and projects the restored data before she leaves.

As you and Carlotta review the projected data, you notice a pattern of movements between Margherita's, Benett's home, and the vault with only two deviations—<color=yellow>Liberty Square</color> and <color=yellow>a dock</color>.
Liberty Square... I was there not long ago.
Yes, that's where I was investigating that night. Seems like the intel was right—Benett did go there.
And the other location... I think it's my uncle's private dock, primarily used for storage, not shipments.
Capollo again? That does sound fishy.
Should we head over after this?
Hmm, reviewing the records hardly proves the connections between these locations.
If time permits, we should take the Terminal to Mr. Pierre. He is an old friend of Grandfather's, and is an expert in this field.
There may be <color=yellow>other useful information</color> in the Terminal.
They call it a dock, but no ships ever come. Uncle has concealed what he took from the vault here—a secluded place entirely under his control.
For a secret trove of such value, the lack of security is strange. There was little resistance on my way here. This can't be right.
Wait, I sense an energy fluctuation nearby... Time to investigate. The size of this place is manageable. I should be able to trace the source quickly.
You track the energy fluctuation, sifting through the gaps between stashed goods and looking for its source.
A storage box catches your eye. Inside, a stunning handicraft adorned with jewels sits in stillness. It's exquisite, but not what you seek.
Just checking your location, have you reached the spot, my clever accomplice?
Everything's going according to plan.
Perfect. Remember to be stealthy. Scarlet Velvet and my operatives are positioned in all the streets around the venue. Should anything go awry, I'll set Plan B in motion.
The venue only has one entrance. I've arranged for a handler to get you in. You'll go in first and then help me slip in without drawing attention.
Ahem. Can you hear me?
Have you made it inside?
This area is under surveillance. On either side of the main stage, you should see something that looks like a control panel.
Operate it to disable the cameras, then place the "gems" I made with my Forte into position.
How did it go? Any issues?
Everything's fine. Just got to the place we agreed on.
The front of the hall. Done.
Main hall, five o'clock. Done.
Blind spot, done.
Back window, done.
The setup is complete, and the time we planned is drawing near.
How's it going on your end?
I'm out of the mirror, and the jammer's set up. Capollo actually inspired this plan, otherwise we wouldn't have been able to infiltrate.
The Order's agents have taken the bait and are at the location. "Blue Rain" and "Retriever" are primed for action.
We'll head out at the chime of the hour.
Scarlet Velvet's people have secured Duncan and will bring him to a safe house. He'll return after everything's settled.
Regarding the Order, I tasked "Blue Rain" and "Retriever" to <color=yellow>pose as Capollo's agents</color> and declare the cooperation null and void.
No data module, no explanation or any follow-up... Capollo is already a lost cause. The Order will realize this soon enough.
Nearly go time. The Order's men should be here.
Double-check everything.
We should talk, Capollo.
You? Why are you here?!
