Carlotta promised a generous reward once it's done.
Ah, well worth the trip then.
An opportunity like this doesn't come round often.
The family's favor is more precious than money. Remember to use it on something worthwhile.
Now about the job—Lady Carlotta must have briefed you in her letter. I'm curious what the Order is thinking stashing their relic in the Montelli vault.
At any rate, my job here is to keep you safe. Take this pass, it's the only one that allows visitors access to the vault's interior.
Time to go. The Order's rep is waiting for us.
Latest log: Ash
So, it seems this "Ash," whoever they are, messed around with the display cases, took the module, and triggered the lockdown that trapped us here.
Does each display case have its own log?
Ah, you know how it is. Some thieves have made "sneaking into the vault" their sole purpose in life.
Let's hope this Ash isn't after the "secret cache."
What's that?
Ah, I've heard rumors that the Montelli vault holds the most valuable treasure in all of Ragunna.
I doubt it. Not even the most senior Montelli employee knows anything about this so-called treasure.
But that ridiculous tale still draws in idiots trying to break in—hundreds of them every year.
They think a stolen ID will let them waltz into the vault, but as I said, each depository has its own security module. When the vault is in lockdown, it's impregnable.
Not even a single Shell Credit can be taken, let alone any of the vault's artifacts and collections.
Amazing, but we've got work to do.
Let's head up to the monitoring room on the top level and check if the old lady we saw in the surveillance footage is "Ash."
Some of the defense systems have been activated. We should tread carefully from here on out.
How beautiful... but why was it covered?
Really? You don't know this painting?
Isn't it just a landscape?
Be my witness, {PlayerName}—what I'm about to say is purely to satisfy our Acolyte's curiosity. No hidden agenda.
Why the sudden suspense?
Alright.
What's so special about this painting?

This piece, titled "Ballad Beneath the Stars," may appear simple at first—just a shepherd tending his flock under a vast sky. However, the pattern on the shepherd's clothes resembles the Order's emblem, only flipped upside down, and the number of stars matches the recorded blessings bestowed by our Sentinel Imperator.

What's more, the number of sheep is the same as the Sentinel's wings. Given that some fanatics claim the Sentinel's divine messages are fabrications, when you connect the dots, doesn't it seem like this shepherd is hinting at something?
Uh... What?
According my interpretation of the Codex, I don't see how this painting implies anything untoward.
Maybe not to you or some of your fellow Acolytes, and certainly not to the Montellis or the painter. But there are others who don't share that view and their voices are often the loudest.
That's why this painting is covered—to avoid stirring up trouble.
Very prudent, but it's still a shame people can't admire its beauty anymore.
What about the risk of people slandering the Order? Doesn't that bother you?
Just like some will appreciate a piece of art, others will hate or misinterpret it. The same goes for the Order.
People's views are shaped by their backgrounds and experiences. What's precious to one might be another's poison.
Everyone is entitled to their opinion. As long as they genuinely believe it, I don't see a problem.
Locking this painting away is perhaps the best option for now, but I believe it will eventually return to where it belongs, for everyone to see.
If more people thought like you, we'd see a lot less trouble in the world.
There's a covered vase here. What's the story behind this one?
Beautiful or ugly, what do you say?
Beautiful.
Ugly.
The Montellis think so, which is why they don't want to share it.
The Montellis disagree, but they keep it hidden for people of your taste.
...Hello.
Excuse me, ma'am, do you work here?
Sorry, if this sounds odd, but... I'm a bit confused. I don't remember why I'm here.
All I know is that I do work in the vault, and my name is... Lily.
But this isn't the section I oversee. Why am I here... Why are you here?
Lady Carlotta has tasked us with a special delivery. May I see your ID, Ms. Lily?
I only have this card.
Thank you. Hmm... Confidential Researcher? The vault does have that position, but a researcher shouldn't be in this section.
The ID is real—the anti-counterfeit features check out.
She doesn't look like she could be a thief's accomplice, either.
That thing you're carrying seems to disagree.
The Order's relics are kept a secret from everyone, including an Acolyte like myself. I can't say what it's reacting to.
But... I do have a strange feeling about Ms. Lily.
We shouldn't leave her here.
We should bring her with us.
She could accidentally trigger something dangerous if left alone. That's the last thing we need.
Agreed. And if she is somehow involved, we'd save a lot of effort by taking her with us.
I'm sorry, ma'am, but you'll need to come with us.
I understand your hesitation, but with the vault sealed, you'll be safer with us.
Alright, I'll come with you.
Good. Time to use your clearance, {PlayerName}. Let's find out what's really going on in this vault.
More guards are gathering.
The longer the vault stays in lockdown, the more defense systems and Echo guards get activated.
Someone's hiding over there!
Ma'am, does the name "Ash" mean anything to you?
Old Ash? He used to say he wanted to sleep among the Echoes to study their behaviors. What a stubborn man.
So the real Ash did exist. As for that man hiding over there... he might have stolen Ash's ID and gotten stuck here.
Ash's ID was stolen? Outsiders couldn't have done that—we've been in here for at least twenty years. Even with my fuzzy memory, I know that much.
Twenty years?!
Is this a vault or a prison?
Twenty years in this vault... Sounds like a living hell...
If it were me, I could maybe last... Well, ten years tops.
But... no one should be working in such awful conditions, Ms. Zani.
Yeah, well, personally I just hope to live long enough to make the most out of my retirement someday. Anyway, we've got an imposter on our hands posing as "Ash."
Let's take the train to the Echo depository. We must find this thief and retrieve the security module. After that, we can decide what to do next.
Stay alert, everyone. During training, I was told to avoid the Echo Depository unless absolutely necessary.

I'm fine. Be careful.

Thank goodness, everyone's safe.
Mmhmm, I see. You've done a great job—

Hi there, Phoebe.
Hello again, Acolyte.
It's been a while. Mind if I ask what you were doing just now?
Oh, we're just chatting. They seemed lonely. Not many people talk to them.
This train Echo? It's been running since the vault was built. It chugs along, doing its thing in silence.
But I do believe your company has made its day.
But if I remember correctly, you are not the representative the Order informed me of.
Yes, it was supposed to be another Acolyte. But she's busy with the Order's work, so I volunteered.
Huh. Did the thought of working with the Montellis scare her away?
Perhaps, Ms. Zani, but I'm sure she'd think differently if she met a Montelli employee like you.
Seeing as the Montelli family and the Order are both blessed by the Sentinel, our paths were bound to cross eventually.
...I'm glad you see it that way. Now, do you have it?

Thank you.

It's an important relic entrusted to the Montellis. That's all I know.
Same here, but it doesn't matter. Lady Carlotta gave me this job. I just follow orders, no questions asked. That's how you work for the Montellis.
Our top priority is to get the job done, nice and clean.

It must be from this book.

Old Ash carried this book everywhere. I heard it even helped him design a coded lock for the vault.
That letter you saw is indeed a page from this book. I remember Ash tearing it out in a fit once. We all made him clean the bathroom as a punishment, hehe.
So, Ash left this letter to tell his grandson about that mysterious "secret cache." Turns out it really does exist.
Then the "Ash" we're chasing now...
He probably found out about the cache from the letter and is attempting to steal it.
Exactly. It's just like Acolyte Phoebe said. He triggered the lockdown to get to the depths of the vault without interference.
If he'd acted like a professional and stuck to the plan instead of messing around, we wouldn't be in this mess.
We need to find him before he puts himself or others in danger. Plus we need the security module to leave. Let's head to the lower control room and check the surveillance cameras.

Don't worry. Keeping you safe is part of my job.
Alright, let's go.
Everything's under control now. The vault schematics show the next stop is the terminus. That man has nowhere to hide.
But I'm not sure where the terminus is exactly. The Employee Manual only states that the Echo Depository is located at the vault's depth, without any further information about the station.
My memory is hazy... I do remember something dangerous out there, but that's all. I'm sorry.
It's alright, Ms. Lily. May the Sentinel guide our way.
Whatever it is, we have no choice but to move forward.
Right. Let's get this done quickly, {PlayerName}.
Ugh, it's getting more ferocious.
Don't worry, {PlayerName}. We're all here with you.
Well, Sentinel above, if you can hear this, please keep us safe.
Phew... Is everyone alright?
Thanks to the train Echo, we're still in one piece, though I have no idea where we are now.
There should be other train Echoes available, right?
We'll need it to get to the terminus.
Please wait... Ma'am, are you hurt?
She seems lost in her thoughts.
Did you remember anything, ma'am?
I'm fine, child. This place feels so familiar. It's like I've lived here for a long time.
Any details you can remember would be useful. Since employee training didn't touch on this area, we'll be going in blind in search of the exit.
Hmm... this place. I've been here before with many others, but their faces are a blur...
Yes, we rarely left this place, but I do remember taking the train somewhere very dark...
You've been here before?
Somewhere very dark?
Don't be nervous.
Are you suggesting that people used to live in the vault?
Yes, if I'm not mistaken, a group of scholars made a home for themselves here.
It seems the vault's structure is more complicated than we thought.
I take it that this "very dark" place you mentioned is the terminus.
”Somewhere very dark"... What kind of place could that be?
We'll be just fine. Ms. Lily, take your time remembering. We'll take it slow.
Plus, we need time to find the exit.
Let's get going. We need to retrieve the stolen security module. That's our key to getting out.
"In memory of those who persist in the dark to keep the light. Though our names shall be removed from history, the truth we seek will one day dawn on Ragunna."
So, people actually lived here before... Ah, Ms. Lily's name is on it, and the name "Ash" too.
These look like diaries. It's not very polite to read them without permission—
"When the green leaves turn red, everything will be back to normal."
Ms. Zani!
We need to be thorough. I'm sure the Sentinel will forgive my intrusion. Anyway, it's just some person's diary.
Your conclusion might be a bit far-fetched, Ash.
Far-fetched? For the Sentinel's sake, I've been in the Echo Depository for seven straight days gathering data!
Even so, incorrect is still incorrect. Here, take a look at this control group...
Acolyte, should we bring these Reverberations back to the Order Tribunal?
I think your misunderstanding of the Order runs deeper than you realize, Ms. Zani...
My apologies. But why is that thing in your pocket still flickering? Did I say something wrong? Or is it because I haven't prayed to the Cathedral in three months?
It's just flickering, not burning or reacting in any other way. It should be fine, I think...
When will all this end? Any ideas, Ash?
I suggest you ask those artists. The day they stop tearing up drafts, we can finish the research.
I'm not talking about the research. I mean us—when will we finally get out of here?
And you're believer, right? Why not just ask the Imperator when we can leave?
...Until the Sentinel gazes upon Their land again.
It won't be long. I've heard the situation is improving. The Montellis even promised to send letters to our families.
Are you available now, Lily? There's a problem with the results you gave me.
Lily? Are you there? Lily?
Lily...
Ms. Lily...
I'm all right child. We shouldn't dawdle here.
Bad news. I know nothing about deciphering passwords.
You might want to try the Echo book. It's an expert at this sort of thing.
This vault... feels suffocating.
I find it comforting. There's no idle chit-chat here—just work, plain and simple.
Can you pray to the Sentinel on my behalf, miss? I'd rather not run into any more trouble.
With you and {PlayerName} here, there's no need to worry!
Be careful, it's on alert now! You need to force it to stop!
Be careful!
If you stole anything else from the vault, I advise you to surrender it immediately.
Hmph, you Montelli dog! I couldn't care less about that so-called "secret cache"! I just want this place destroyed for good!
Open your eyes! This isn't a vault. It's a nightmarish prison!
You locked up my grandfather, and now you want to do the same to me!
You must be the young Ash. I've seen your picture, child. Old Ash spoke a lot about you.
As for this vault... Yes, it's nothing but a prison.
Ms. Lily...
But we chose this imprisonment—not just our bodies, but our very souls. Freedom was never an option.
We had to erase every trace of our existence to survive, to discover, to create.
...What do you mean?
We followed in the footsteps of our predecessors, but one day, we unexpectedly uncovered a hidden chapter of the Order's history.
They hunted us down in the name of preserving stability, stripping us of our rights as researchers and artists.
The Montelli family took pity on us and came to our rescue. They feigned loyalty to the Order and locked us in this vault, but in reality, it became a refuge for outcasts like us.
Five years, ten years, twenty years...
So, the Montellis didn't imprison Grandpa... he chose this path himself...
That thing he mentioned in the letter... I...
Please cheer up, Mr. Ash. Everyone was blind to the truth as you once were, but now, we know everything thanks to you.
Very touching, but I'm not as forgiving as our Acolyte. You have a price to pay for breaking into the vault.
The exit is open. You're free to go now. I'll stay to tie up any loose ends.
Thank you for helping us again, {PlayerName}. I thought this would just be a routine job.
I'm used to it.
You're welcome.
Here's the reward Lady Carlotta promised. Naturally, she did not forget to include a little "overtime pay" for your efforts.
By the way, miss, I'm sorry but I'll need to take that relic from the Order. Don't worry, the rules still allow you to come and go as you please.
Of course. I need the Sentinel's enlightenment on certain matters... but I'll still be around if you need me.
Are you praying for them?
No... not really. Just bidding them farewell.
A resolute soul needs no guidance. I simply want to understand the future they've paved the road for.
You've been a great help. Thank you. Lady Carlotta mentioned she left you a special bonus downstairs.
I have other matters to attend to. Until next time.
She will find the path worth her devotion.
Greetings. The Averardo Vault is in lockdown. Please proceed to the train Echo station and take Line 1 to evacuate the vault.
We need to go to the evacuation site. When will the train depart?
We won't be taking the train for now.
Understood. Current train Echo passengers: 0. You may depart at a time of your choosing.
Perfect. Do we need anything to board the train?
We won't be taking the train for now.
To depart on Line 1, please present your employee ID, or temporary ID, and a valid emergency pass issued by the security room.
(Present the clearance device.)
We won't be taking the train for now.
Verifying now. Please wait.

Please present your emergency pass to board the Averardo Vault's train Echo. Running on a specially designed track, the train Echo ensures an evacuation that is both efficient and convenient. We wish you a pleasant evacuation.
How can we get this emergency pass?
We won't be taking the train for now.
Please demonstrate lawful vault entry by presenting an emergency pass issued from the security room located in the next depository. It may be accessed by the train Echo.

Once you obtain an emergency pass, you will be authorized to board. Running on a specially designed track, the train Echo ensures an evacuation that is both efficient and convenient. We wish you a pleasant evacuation.
Hold on...
We won't be taking the train for now.
Are you seriously telling me that I have to go deeper into the vault to get out of here?
Processing... Please present your emergency pass to board the train Echo of the Averardo Vault...
I've had enough!
...It seems I won't be taking the train.
I ought to take you to the scrap yard.
Security lockdown… That's odd. The Employee Manual says this mode can only be activated by...
Um, miss. If I may, what are you doing?
Me? Oh, this Echo seems to have a headache. I'm trying to help.
Wait, even if it is malfunctioning, you shouldn't hit it with your—
Beep... Bleep...
Depository One security module malfunction. Lockdown detected. Emergency pass override activated. Line 1 temporary access granted. Please evacuate via the nearest exit.
What the?!
Is something wrong, Ms. Zani?
No... never mind.
The security control room in this depository is right ahead. You can put your device to good use there.
Each depository has its own security room. Just verify your device here to obtain security clearance. It's only valid for this depository, though.
Sounds complicated.
Necessary for the vault's security, but yes, it's a hassle.
We're stuck here for now, and the only way out is to get clearance from each of the depositories. That means going deeper into the vault.
How much deeper?
Beats me. The security room only controls the depository it's in and grants access to the next.
So, aside from a handful of senior members of the Montelli family, no one knows the full layout of this vault?
I don't know. Maybe a handful of people who've worked here for over thirty years might.
Let's get clearance first. It might help us avoid most of the defense systems triggered by the lockdown.
Do the Montellis have a love for building labyrinths?
Not really. It's all for the security of the vault.
With top clearance, you should be able to disable some of the cameras. Give it a try.
Maybe we can make a detour from this side...
Wait... something's off with this thing. Has it been tampered with?
Let me see... Tsk, someone removed the hidden security module.
Check the log file with your clearance... There it is, it was taken by "Ash." The name rings a bell...
Yes, the Employee Manual mentions an old employee named Ash who designed most of the vault's security features. But he passed away.
This is only speculation, but what if this "Ash" stole from the vault and took the security module? That would explain why a complete lockdown was triggered.
What's a hidden security module? Is it like a key?
Pretty much. It's the monitoring core that powers this entire depository. If we don't get it back, we'll be stuck here for good.
A vault employee could easily access the module, but nobody would dare steal it. Everyone knows that'll trigger a lockdown of the entire vault.
But what if that's exactly what they want?
Think about it. There's no one in the vault except for us, and all comms are blocked. It's the perfect opportunity for a thief.
Don't tell me they're searching for... Never mind, we need to catch this rat before they cause us more trouble.
It seems this "Ash" also had access to the control room. Could it be... that old woman?

Eeya—

Help... Help...

Did you hear that? Oh, the panic in their voice! How they must be begging for a capable leader to come and save the day?
In the presence of the just Divinity, feel free to express your doubts. I shall speak without reservation.

Why do you banish people in the name of pilgrimage?

We must create a land that aligns with the Sentinel's vision. We must purge this land of individuals who stray from the righteous path to ensure that our collective will remains unified and pure.
However, we honor the deeds of Napoli II, the founding Primus, and offer those who have strayed a chance for atonement.
The Pilgrim's Sail follows Napoli's path. He too once endured this arduous journey, yet emerged victorious, earning an audience with the Sentinel.
The trials are not mere sufferings but steps toward redemption. The penitent who confront the trials with sincerity will be allowed to return to the divine's embrace.
Unity is our shield, bound by the law of eternal continuity.
Though we revel in the joy of the Carnevale, we must also be vigilant.
For division is a chronic disease plaguing this city. The growing indulgence among our citizens has already invited divine punishment.
We, as stewards of divine will, must guide the people, erecting barriers of reason against the floods of passion. This is the only way to withstand the ever-changing tides.
We uphold the Sentinel's principles of justice. The gates to our divine land remain open to all who seek it.
This is a city of inclusiveness, welcoming all visitors… including those who try to overstep their bounds.
These charlatans misled our people with lies and flattery, diverting them from the divine will.
But your timely intervention corrected their course, sparing them from a ruinous fate. Once again, I offer my sincerest gratitude.
May the Divinity bless you, and may you always walk the path of righteousness.
Let's go over the cabins again. Door by door.
Hehe, you caught me again.
Here for the sea again, huh?
This is just a coincidence.
Mmm, my secret haven in the Black Shores… And guess what? You're the only one I'd ever allowed here.
Oh? Reall? After all the times you've "accidentally" bump into me? Hehe, how cute…

...I recall you wanted to be a knight, right?

So… I… I actually did it? I defeated it?!
Congratulations.
This is my first time defeating a Tacet Discord! My very first step forward!
But the Sword in the Rock you gave me is broken now…
It fulfilled its purpose.
And now it's time for you to get a new one.
I'll keep it as a memento. By the way, do you have any feedback on my performance in that battle?
You want me to be honest?
Absolutely! Enlighten me!
Your backhand is weak! So is your forehand! Your legs too! And your reactions! You've got a lot to learn.
O-okay! I'll practice harder! I promise!
Good. Let's get started then.
Under your guidance, Faro has fully trained his strength…
The people who were attacked by the Tacet Discords express their gratitude for your help and leave the scene.
Phew! Thank you for your help. Otherwise, I might've gotten myself into trouble again.
You bought me some time.
You still need more practice.
I was just overstretching myself… I know I'm not yet capable of protecting others.
Yeah, I know I'm not yet capable of protecting others.
Just facing Tacet Discords at this level was already overwhelming for me.
But you still did your best to protect them, didn't you?
I swore during the "Sword Bestowment Ceremony" to lend a hand to those in need.
Just like the knights in the legends. Even when they knew the battlefield held more than just victory and glory, they marched on without regret.
You're getting more and more like a knight.
Ahem, it's all thanks to your guidance. Without you, my dream of becoming a knight could've ended long ago.
Oh, dear Imperator, I'll always remember that knight's bravery…
You met a knight?
Indeed. On that fateful day, I ran into a fierce Tacet Discord outside the town. A brave young man rushed to help me, fighting the monster with something like a pitchfork.
Once we were safe, I asked for his name, and he told me that he was the squire of that "Roving Knight who wanders between the realms of day and night."
It appears that knights still exist in this era…
Well, I think I've met him before too.
Is that so? He left in such a hurry, and all I could do was watch him go.
This brief encounter brought comfort to my broken heart. Perhaps our paths will cross again someday?
I'm ready, so what do we have for today's training?
It's you! Squire of the Roving Knight!
Oh… Haha, how did you know that?
Why did you leave my title when you were the one doing good deeds?
I'm sorry for doing that without asking. It's just that your guidance has brought me closer to my dream.
Just as the tales of knights inspired me, I hoped that by spreading the name of the Roving Knight, others might also find motivation.
People would see that knights who uphold justice and righteousness are still active, in Whisperwind Haven and even in other places in Rinascita, not lost to time.
You'll earn your own title one day.
Leave your own title next time.
I will! But there's still so much to learn, so I hope you'll keep training me!
Absolutely.

It's you! Nameless Knight!
Oh… Haha, how did you know that was me?
You're probably the only knight who fights with a pitchfork.
I was on my way to help with some farm work when I heard someone calling for help. So I grabbed my tool and rushed to assist.
Why didn't you leave your name?
Well… I thought names weren't as important. What truly matters is that the deeds of knights are passed down by people.
Besides, I'm far from being worthy of a knight's title… So I really hope you'll continue to guide me in my training.
Absolutely.

Phew, I'm really glad you were here. Dealing with those Tacet Discords alone is still a bit much for me.
Don't push yourself too hard.
Don't worry! I'll immediately run away if things get too tough. I just wanted to buy some time for those passersby.
Seems like I'm not that afraid of those monsters anymore, but I still need the strength to protect others.
On that note, it's time for your training.
Then let's kick off today's session.
Wait! You mean now?
Under your guidance, Faro begins an intensive and comprehensive training session.
Phew… You're here. I managed to defeat those Tacet Discords, and the people were only a little shaken.
I thought you needed my help.
Oh no, I may have used too much force and broken my weapon again. It took me quite a while to find one as suitable as that.
Out with the old, in with the new!
Weapons are expendable.
You're right. What matters most is the chivalrous spirit of protecting others, right?
I will keep moving forward, following in your footsteps.
Phew! Thank you so much! Without your help, I'd have been in real trouble!
I'm Faro from Egla Town, by the way. I'm training to become a knight. How should I address you, hero?
(For some reason, you feel that your response will leave a lasting influence on this young man.)
I'm the Roving Knight, a wanderer between the realms of day and night.
Just call me {PlayerName}. I merely passed by and did what I could.
The Roving Knight…?!
No wonder you fought with such skills! So you really are a knight. I thought knights... no longer existed.
Oh, you're as mighty as the noble knights in the stories. No, you've surpassed them all!
Well, I know a thing or two about fighting.
You flatter me. But I like it.
It's truly an honor to meet you! Actually, I've been searching for someone skilled in combat.
I know this is a sudden request, but could you be my mentor and train me for a while? I want to be stronger, a knight who can protect others.
Why do you want to be a knight like that?
Well, it's a long story. When I was little, I got lost in the wild and ran into some scary Tacet Discords at night. Just when I thought I was done for, someone showed up with a sword and saved me.
I can't remember his face or voice, but I still vividly recall his figure—a knight shielding the weak from danger.
That moment inspired me. I want to be a "shield," not a coward who trembles at the sight of Tacet Discords.
But confronting Tacet Discords is dangerous for ordinary people.
I know. It may be hard to tell, but I'm also a Resonator.
(Though very subtle, you do sense a hint of Resonance power in him.)
Please, will you be my mentor and guide me?
Alright, I'll help you.
I'd love to, but I'm quite busy right now. Maybe sometime later?
Thank you. Ouch, seems like I twisted my arm while fighting those monsters…
We can start your training once you've recovered.
No problem! A good sleep will fix me right up.
That's fine! I'll focus on my practice while you handle your business!
Thank you for saving me again. I was so close to being overwhelmed by those monsters.
You really need to stop putting yourself in danger like this.
Recklessness won't help you.
But if I stay in safe places, my dream will slip away from me.
A-and my efforts aren't in vain! I can feel myself getting more familiar with their fighting styles.
But you may keep getting hurt.
I know. Just the thought of a future like that sends shivers down my spine and makes my legs tremble when I face those monsters.
But think of the knight who ventured deep into Whisperwind Haven and faced the Giant alone. He must have encountered something far worse.
Even in the darkest moments, he endured until the end. I wish to follow his example.
You're quite stubborn, but that can be a good thing.
Do you remember the favor I asked before? Will you train me this time?
Fine.
I have to excuse myself for now.
That's great! You finally agreed! Thank you! Ouch, seems like I twisted my ankle in the last fight.
We can start your training once you've recovered.
No problem! A good sleep will fix me right up.
I see. Goodbye then. I'll keep practicing on my own until you're willing to teach me.
HELP!!! IS ANYONE OUT THERE? CAN ANYBODY HEAR ME? PLEASE, HELP!!!
That voice sounds familiar… Could it be…?
Phew! I'm finally out! I thought I'd be stuck in that dark cave forever!
How did you get trapped in there?
Well, I wanted to find a proper weapon before the official training started.
I heard that the Mad Knight's sword was hidden around here, so I came to look for it.
And there it was! Just like the legends said, stuck in a rock!
You mean that giant rock over there?
That's right! But no matter how hard I pulled, it wouldn't budge.
I must've spent ages trying! Then suddenly, I heard rumbling and loud crashes from outside. Before I knew it, I was trapped by falling rocks.
Let me give it a try.
Maybe you are the one that can really pull it out…
Legend says this Sword in the Rock chooses its owner, and only those with true courage and integrity can wield it.
Really?
That sounds like me.
The stage is yours now. Oh, I can almost hear it whispering to me—"You don't have the right, O you don't have the right."
The sword looks like part of the rock now…
Congratulations on retrieving the long-lost Sword in the Rock! I never expected you could just break the rock to get it…
Is this really a sword?
Well, after all those years, I guess it's a bit weathered…
But look at its blade! It's so slender, and it definitely has a unique texture compared to an ordinary sword.
It's not a pipe, is it?
How could that be? It is… Well, fine, it's just a piece of pipe.
Maybe some prankster decided to follow the legend and stuck it in that rock?
*Sigh* I'm becoming more gullible. I once searched for the Sword in the Rock with Carlow for ages, but we found nothing…
All these mysteries of knighthood... who knows which is real and which is not? I just didn't want to dig deeper and end up disappointed…
Faro, the Novice Knight.
…Yes? Are you calling me?
Can you swear to this sword that from now on, you will only fight for justice and righteousness, and help those in need?
Absolutely! I, Faro, swear to this sword that I will only fight for justice and righteousness from now on.
Good, then this Sword in the Rock belongs to you now.
You pick up the weathered "sword" and hand it to the young man before you with sincerity. He stands there, surprised, and after a moment, he accepts it with trembling hands.
But it's just a piece of pipe…
Even if the legend isn't real, your vow is.
What makes a knight isn't their weapon but their spirit.
You're right. When I was a child, I used to play knight with a stick.
Whether it's a weathered pipe or a magnificent sword, a knight's responsibilities remain the same.
Thank you. This looks sturdy and should last quite a while.
So, today's training's about breaking rocks? I remember I once heard from a Pioneer Association member that…
Breaking rocks with your chest is quite popular somewhere outside of Rinascita.
I think you might have misunderstood.
Well then, today's training is "breaking rocks with your chest."
Haha, you're right. It's impossible for an ordinary person to do that!
What? Really? But that sounds impossible!
Alright, chit-chat's over. Today, we simply focus on fundamental strength training. We'll be shattering the rocks with our weapons.
Just like how you got the Sword in the Rock? I'm ready. We can start any time!
No rush. I'll show you how it's done first.
Understood! I'll watch and learn carefully!
What? A Tacet Discord in the stone?!
Looks like today's strength training just turned into a real combat session.

You made it.
I've been here waiting for you.
You've already recovered?
Didn't we just fight?
What do you mean? I don't understand.
(Something's not right... It's like he has no memory of our battle.)
You can call me Gatekeeper for now. My name isn't important—what matters is this gateway.
I recognize this gateway.
It leads to the Somnoire.
Is that so? It leads to the Somnoire, a place where all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 converge.
You know about the Somnoire? It's where all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 are stored.
It knows the taste of a child's favorite candy and the wild schemes of a dictator. It understands the beauty and darkness hidden in the subconscious of life.
In other words, it holds the dreams of everyone, forever recorded.
Why are you waiting for me?
The Somnoire records everything about our planet, and your presence is key to keeping it running smoothly.
That's nothing new to me.
I know, I'm the Dreamwalker.
...So you remember this place?
Before your reawakening, something that shouldn't have been there infiltrated the Somnoire.
Now, the Somnoire is in chaos, and your assistance is much needed to restore its stability—Wait, something's not right…
How are you feeling?
What do you mean?
The monsters in there weren't that hard to beat.
You seem calm. Good. That means the Somnoire's effects haven't gotten to you.
Keep up with the good work, will you?
Well, that clears this area nicely.
As you've probably already noticed, the Somnoire's size is near incomprehensible. This is just the tip of the iceberg,
There is still much work to be done if we are to prevent the Tacet Discords from escaping again.
I'll come here often.
Don't forget the rewards you promised me.
I knew you weren't one to just sit back and watch.
Of course, I haven't forgotten the reward I promised you.
Let's wrap things up for now. Next time, we can go deeper into the Memory Zones together.
…But when that day comes, maybe the real "me" will be taking charge, don't you think?
Impressive as always…
With you on board, I'm confident we can restore the Somnoire to its normal state.
What do you need me to do?
Looks like the problem isn't solved.
I can't explain it further to you just yet. Not before you regain your memories.
The Somnoire needs authentic memories and experiences, and I shouldn't tamper with them.
At least now you know that these gateways are kind of like Tacet Fields. Tacet Discords can escape from them.
If you can help us fix the Somnoire, we may be able to prevent more Tacet Discords from spawning. Think of it as dispelling a Tacet Field.
Of course, you will be adequately compensated. What do you say?
Even if you didn't ask, I'd do it anyway.
I'll consider it if the rewards are generous.
Yes, you've always been like this. Maybe that's why the gateway chose you.
Yes, you've always been like this. But don't worry, I can guarantee they will be.
Time is ticking. Let's go inside, then.
Meow!
And you are?
Are you that white cat from before?
Meow!
Say something other than "meow."
Come on, I know you can talk.
Meow!
Dreamwalker, you've returned.
It's nice to meet you.
The Ebony Gatekeeper didn't recognize me.
Didn't we just have a grand adventure together? I know, you haven't managed to wrap your head around it yet, have you?
Yes, you see… he's in a bit of situation.
That fella who greeted you at the gateway wasn't actually the real Ebony Gatekeeper.
Not the real Ebony Gatekeeper?
What do you mean?
After your battle in the Somnoire, he lost control over that realm for a time. To fill his unforseen absence, the Somnoire activated his backup.
The backup only retains limited memories from a certain point in the past, so it makes sense he doesn't remember what happened.
He asked for my help in restoring the Somnoire.
So... is there another problem brewing?
At the moment, that fella is just a backup, so he's probably just doing his job, plain and simple.
Behind this gateway lurks all sorts of mysteries. The chaos in the Somnoire hasn't been fully resolved, and I'm continuing my investigation.
I'll be here to help you along the way, just as I did before.
I hope it will make a difference.
What should I do next?
You can follow "his" guidance and carry on with your exploration.
Okay.
You mean to complete this beginner's guide?
Thank you, this will help to restore some of the Memory Zones.
Exactly. "He" has mistaken you for a newcomer to the Somnoire and laid out a special route for you.
But the real Ebony Gatekeeper's power is gradually being restored. Before long, that backup of his might be decomissioned...
But that's for another day. For now, your path is already set.
What took you so long to leave that Memory Zone?
Well, forget it...
Ugh, enemies are everywhere.
But you handled them like it's second nature... Truly impressive.
As you can see, we are now inside the Somnoire. What do you think of it?
It's beautiful.
It's bizarre.
It's familiar.
After all, it's made up of the memories and dreams of countless individuals.
Dreams often take us beyond what we can imagine.
Back to the point, in the Somnoire, you'll encounter other entities apart from me.
Like her.
She is…
She is a virtual entity, a fusion of countless consciousnesses within the Somnoire, and the one experiencing this dream.
Just think of her as someone dreaming, but she doesn't truly exist. She's just an Illusia created by the gateway to the Somnoire.
Why is she here?
Because there has to be someone dreaming for a dream to exist, doesn't there?
In fact, she will be a valuable ally as you navigate the Somnoire.
You cannot bring anything inside here. If you need anything in battle, you'll need to manifest them from the dreams recorded in the Somnoire.
Such as... the Echoes you use in battle.
Go talk to her. She'll give you some important things for your dream.
Ah, hello. Are you dreaming too?
Are you really dreaming?
Yes, greetings, my fellow dreamer.
Hi, please give me an Echo or two.
Yes, I've been dreaming forever. You wouldn't believe the things I've dreamed.
Haha, hello to you! I've never seen anyone as lively as you here.
There is no need to rush…
Now that you've found me, I'm guessing you want to hear about my dreams? I've been dreaming up some amazing things!
Just now, I dreamed about...
So, what do you think? Aren't my dreams exciting?
There are some powerful things in your dreams.
Thank you for sharing your dreams with me.
Hehe, I didn't lie to you, did I?
You're welcome! I really enjoyed sharing that with you.
I've had so many amazing dreams, but sadly, there's no one here to listen...
I'd be happy to share my dreams with you anytime you want!
Why not now?
Because I understand you're here for business, not my dreams.
You know that something's gone wrong here, right?
Strange things have been gathering in the Somnoire lately, and I've been having nightmares too...
So I won't keep you much longer. If you can help restore things to normal, we'll have all the time in the world to chat.

Tails. Tails. And... tails.

Ahem… Apologies, friends from afar. Didn't realize you were watching.
Is something wrong?
Just a pain in the neck… When you get old, trouble finds you everywhere.
Last night, some thugs broke into my house looking for documents. Daisy caught them in the act...
She rang the alarm and tried to wake me up, but they were armed. Tried to cover their tracks… Daisy didn't make it.
How could they!
That's awful! How could they?! Jerks!
Daisy's been with me for twenty years... twenty whole years. If someone told me back then that people would harm the Order's Echo, I'd simply call them crazy.
So Daisy was an Echo? Wait, I'm an Echo too! How dare they hurt a poor little Echo!
I lost everything after my wife passed away twenty years ago—until Daisy showed up at my doorstep. She was my wife's last gift to me… and now she's taken away too.
What do you need?
...Guns. Lots of guns.
Huh?!
I'm old now, but in my younger days, the Primus always told me: "Wicktorio, there is no need for extreme measures."
"As an accountant of the Order, you must act professional and decent..."
Is accounting that intense?
Do it long enough, and you'll understand. It's all about the numbers. As long as the books balance, anything's fair game.
After I retired, my buddy Cosimo once told me I couldn't just "shoot" my problems away.
But when the problems kept piling up, I thought: why not deal with the people who created those problems?
I get the logic… but it's a stretch...
Anyway, my friends... how about joining me for a little adventure? I can tell you've got potential. And don't worry, my savings will make it worth your while.
Nothing complicated, just some debt collecting.
Alright.
Good. I'll show you where they're hiding. You can handle them however you like. The reward will be worth it.
Good evening, {PlayerName}.
Is it that late already?
You look refreshed now.
Well, we've both had a busy day. Time for a drink, don't you think?
So, care to share what you found inside?
You tell Wicktorio what happened...
The gold coins they hoarded were old currency that was meant to be issued but abandoned after a currency swap.
Given Ragunna's trade history over the past two decades, they probably planned to exploit the information gap and run cons overseas. That's why they needed those documents.
Why was it abandoned?
What did you do to those people?
They made too many. Way more than the market could handle.
People always believe more money is better, but there's a limit. Once it's breached, everything spirals—a chain reaction.
As you can see, Ragunna eventually adopted Shell Credit as its stable currency.
Them? Heh. Let's just say I hope the coins I placed on their eyes cover their fare to the underworld.
Sentinel above, forgive the violence. But for those blinded by greed, it was the only fitting end.
Wow… like a scene straight out of that Ragunnesi play.
By the way, here's the reward I promised. As for the extra Shell Credits, consider them a handling fee for converting that outdated currency.
In life, you either handle the people or settle the score. Peace doesn't come easy, even after retirement.
Anyway, this old man's heading back now. Stop by Egla Town anytime. You're always welcome.
Yes, that's right... Keep moving forward, you're getting close.
You have to press ahead. Don't doubt yourself.
Don't you see? This is what happens when you choose the wrong path and back the wrong horse!
The cost... will be far greater than you thought. Why do you always end up on the losing team?

His conversation with a young girl leads him to the realization that he, too, is just a string of data, and that these so-called "useless dreams" hold the power to inspire and motivate people. Determined to change his course, he resolves to preserve every dream within the Somnoire.

Pincer Maneuver Warriors II

[About]

It seems that someone has just updated the mysterious combat simulation program that's going viral on the Huaxu Hive at the Academy...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 40.

[Event Rules]

1. In Pincer Maneuver Warriors, challenge waves of powerful enemies by controlling two teams with special buffs across two separate simulated battlefields.

2. The simulated battlefield offers buffs that either apply to both teams or are exclusive to one team.

3. There are 4 stages with limited enemy waves and 1 stage with infinite waves.

i. In stages with limited enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half of the battle when time runs out or after eliminating all enemies.

ii. In the stage with infinite enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half when time runs out.

4. Points earned in stages with limited enemy waves include both Time Points and Monster Points, while Points earned in the stage with infinite waves include only Monster Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time left when a challenge is completed.

Is there a reason the Order has to let the Carnevale happen?
It had a romantic flair.
Lingyang asks you to keep his beastly side a secret. After hearing about your efforts, Bei Ji opens up about his conflict with Bei Shi, sharing his true feelings.
As you approach the Academy, Chixia's Terminal suddenly rings. She rushes off, leaving you and Yangyang to enter the Academy alone.

You deliver the parts to Mortefi. Meanwhile, Baizhi completes her analysis of the mysterious tokens. The mangosteen is ordinary, the purple leaf shows signs of exposure to Waveworn phenomena, and the Sugar Pearl is a vaccine that expired over 20 years ago. As you piece together Baizhi's findings and the restored sundial's ancient Sexagenary Cycle, a revelation dawns.
In the unsettling realm you find yourself in, an unknown entity attacks you. It seems to be saying something, but before you can decipher what it means Yangyang's voice pulls you back to reality.
Baizhi listens to your account but remains unsure of the cause. She needs more data before drawing any conclusions. The good news? Every test shows you are in perfect health.
Yangyang is relieved to see you unharmed. Baizhi, however, wastes no time and asks you what happened in the simulated training ground.

You find information about the Sugar Pearl's origin. Jinzhou's past begins to unfold before you—a past that may be intertwined with your own. At the same time, you begin to understand the deeper, more pressing reason behind Jinhsi's cryptic messages.
It's late at night when Chixia meets up with you again. With the day's discoveries weighing heavy, you decide to rest before tackling tomorrow's challenges.
Baizhi suggests running a full analysis on the Sugar Pearl and sundial to uncover more information. Before parting, she encourages you to have a medical examination when time allows.
You cross paths with a researcher named Mortefi. After learning the purpose of your visit, he leaves to inform Baizhi of your arrival.
You see Baizhi for the examination. Before she begins, she shares key insights about Echoes, Resonators, Threnodians, and your place in all this.

Mortefi ends the call. The caller was Xiangli Yao, an Automata Mechanic expert and a Principal Investigator at the Academy. Mortefi will draw up a design for you, but he doesn't have the parts to rebuild the item. He needs you to fetch them from Xiangli Yao's workshop.
Mortefi has cracked the sundial's secrets. He explains what it looks like inside and how it works, but is interrupted by a call. You and Yangyang decide to explore the room until he is free.

Back in Jinzhou, you reunite with Chixia and share your findings from Desorock Highland and Qichi Village. You suspect Jinhsi intentionally led you there after learning of the Fractsidus' plan, but her true intentions remain unclear until you solve the sundial puzzle.
You solve the sundial puzzle. A note appears that directs you to the Grand Library at City Hall. Noticing something unusual about the sundial, you decide to go there alone.
You defeat Scar, but he appears unbothered over what will happen to him. He is more curious to know when you and Jinhsi hatched this trap.

The sundial holds two puzzles. Solving the second unveils a message from Jinhsi, inviting you to a meeting under the cloak of night. When she arrives, she reveals secrets about Jinzhou and the Threnodians, shedding light on your identity, and hints that you might be a legendary figure mentioned in ancient records.

You ask Scar why the Fractsidus is holding Jué captive and attempting to awaken the Threnodian. He explains their goal of creating a new world order and invites you to join them. Before being taken away, Scar whispers a secret to Jinhsi that visibly unsettles her.

Jinhsi reveals a prophecy from Jué foretelling your quest to find Commander Jiyan in the Norfall Barrens at a time when raindrops fall upstream. Until that day comes, she advises you to seek out an organization known as the Black Shores.

After your departure, Jinhsi reaches out to her mentor, Changli. Jué prophesied a showdown between Jinhsi and itself at Mt. Firmament, a place where time stands still. Determined to protect Jinzhou's future, Jinhsi vows to face Jué alone. Changli, impressed by her growth, pledges her support.

You run into Lingyang chatting with some children. He introduces you to the Liondance Troupe and tells you about some of Jinzhou's traditions. He asks you to accompany him in preparing for the upcoming Liondance—and also offers to grab a bite en route.
A courier tells you that locals have been paying "The Savages" to fend off the "Jingle Beast." With this clue, you head to the area where the beast is often spotted.
Near an Exile's camp, you overhear that "The Savages" are exploiting the "Jingle Beast" legend. You also learn that a new member has joined their ranks hoping to find the Beast.

Everything points to "The Savages" spreading rumors about the "Jingle Beast" and selling spoiled ingredients. You discover the new recruit is Bei Ji. To keep you safe, Lingyang volunteers to investigate "the Savages" himself while you and Bei Shi focus on finding Bei Ji.
Bei Shi shares that Bei Ji has been feeling guilty about her. She also opens up about her fear of the "Jingle Beast," which stems from a past encounter out in the wild.
Lingyang tells you that "The Savages" have taken Bei Ji to a cave. Sensing danger, he suggests you join him in the rescue while Bei Shi alerts the Patrollers.
With the Patrollers' help, you catch "The Savages" and the Bei siblings are finally reunited.

You learn that Bei Ji had originally planned to kill the "Jingle Beast" to prove his courage and earn his sister's respect. Though he feels like he has failed, Lingyang reminds him that true bravery lies in overcoming one's weaknesses for those we care about. Bei Ji gains Bei Shi's understanding, but her fear of the "Jingle Beast" remains. To help her, Lingyang invites the siblings to watch the Liondance, believing it may help dispel Bei Shi's fear.
After talking with the client, Lingyang agrees to celebrate an elderly person's birthday during tomorrow's performance.
Lingyang asks you to check backstage for props that might help Bei Shi form a new opinion about the "Jingle Beast."
Before the performance, Lingyang shares the origin and meaning of the Liondance, suggesting that it might help Bei Shi overcome her fear of the "Jingle Beast."
Thanks to the Liondance performance, Bei Shi can recall how the sound of a bell saved her during a previous attack in the wild. Her fears begin to shift as her courage is restored.

In the end, Lingyang reveals the truth about the "Jingle Beast"—it is the last "Suan'ni." Moved by humanity's bravery against the Lament, this creature longed to become one of them. It had been trying to understand what it means to be human and ultimately discovered that the answer lies in the "heart." Since that day, it has sought to express the beauty it sees in humans in its own unique way.
After talking with the clients, Lingyang agrees to include the "Liondance Officiant" ceremony in tomorrow's performance to celebrate their wedding.

Lingyang treats you to some local Jinzhou specialties at a food stall, suggesting the stall owner—one of his clients—offer snacks during the performance as a way to advertise. However, the owner explains they are short on ingredients due to the disruption caused by a creature known as the "Jingle Beast" and a gang called "The Savages." Hearing this, Lingyang appears deep in thought.

At the teahouse, you find Lingyang discussing a mysterious request with Bei Shi. They suspect the request came from Bei Shi's brother, Bei Ji, who has been missing for a week and may be involved with "The Savages." To find out more, you and Bei Shi start investigating Bei Ji's packages.

Lingyang heads to a teahouse to take care of an unresolved request. The stall owner expresses concern about Lingyang's tendency to prioritize others over himself and asks if you can check on him. You agree to help.
At the Riverside Games, you gather details from Jiyan and Wenshu as you prepare to assist with the event.

You find out that two members of Lingyan and Ganquan's team are injured and unable to race. To fill the gap, you join the team, but you still need one more member. After discussing it with Wenshu, you both agree that Jiyan is the best fit, so you decide to invite him to join.
Jiyan gives Mortefi the recorded frequency samples, and Mortefi promises the Academy will use them well.
Wenshu shares the full story of the temporary team and gives you a photo of you and Jiyan's team as a keepsake.
You invite Jiyan to join the team. He agrees to be a substitute after careful consideration.

At Knell Square, you see the flowers Jiyan planted for the fallen soldiers. Together, you plant an "Emortia" seed, hoping the souls you met in the Sonoro find peace and return home. Jiyan asks you to plant an Emortia for him if he cannot return home someday.

Once the injured are safe, you and Jiyan learn from Mortefi that the manic Gulpuffs were affected by abnormal frequency fluctuations upstream. The timing of this accident strikes Jiyan as suspicious, so you decide to investigate upstream.
Jiyan gives a pep talk before the race. You learn that the fastest race record was set by a temporary team a decade ago. You finalize your team name and relay order.
The race is halted due to a disruptive incident. Jiyan points out something strange. But before investigating, you need to evacuate the spectators for their own safety.

You enter the Sonoro Sphere with Jiyan and find illusions discussing the temporary team from ten years ago. Jiyan seems to know the story but chooses to avoid the subject. Then, before you can act, the illusions turn into Tacet Discords and attack.

Jiyan explains these Tacet Discords are reenacting the Riverside Games from a decade ago and reveals he was a member of that record-breaking team. He believes the anomalies are linked to them. You hear the Knell Square's bell and continue exploring.

Jiyan speculates that the Sonoro Sphere is composed of the Reverberations of his late comrades who have been trapped here and forced to relive their memories. Their frequencies are stuck in a past battle against the Tacet Discords and they implore you for help. Guided by the bell, you venture further in the Sonoro.

Jiyan is struck by how the Tacet Discords are mimicking the Midnight Rangers' tribute to fallen soldiers, finding it absurd as these monsters shouldn't have been able to understand the ceremony's meaning. As the bell rings again, the Tacet Discords move slowly towards the fog. You and Jiyan are ready to bid them a proper farewell.

They all say that Rinascita's outer sea is riddled with dangers—storms, mist, reefs, and TDs that could swallow a ship whole. Some even claim that the world beyond Rinascita had already died in the Lament long ago, with only our isles left under Imperator's protection.

What's wrong?
What's that about?
She says this accordion was from her master.
Even though she hasn't found her master yet, this accordion left her with many fond memories.
"As the mist fades, so shines the star's unbound light—"
Her master used to sing this to lift the spirits of people who had been wronged, and naturally, she picked up the tune.
The misty maze we just went through was her attempt to recreate the opera. She used the misty coastline as a stage, with the help of her Echo friends, of course.
You did a great job.
I guess she was trying her best to protect all her memories with her master.
But protecting your own shouldn't come at the cost of everyone else's memories and hopes.
For anyone who's been hurt, we're probably better off sticking together than dragging each other down, right?
Did the Montelli family invite some kind of… traveling troupe for the Carnevale? Never heard of a group like that around Rinascita...
Hah, interesting. I knew the Order canceling the Carnevale wouldn't kill people's love for theater. Now that it's back, everyone's after that Laureate title.
I wonder what their style is like. With the Montellis sponsoring them, I bet their costumes and staging will be over-the-top.
Oh, come on! Don't let that throw you. It's not money or connections that make a great performance. By our founder's name, the Guinizello Troupe is gonna present the most unforgettable show!
You're right. Plus, it's not like we can predict what the Sentinel's looking for in a Laureate. The most important thing is that we get across what we want the Sentinel to see.
Heard the news? The Order's bringing in a "Conductor" for this year's Carnevale!
A Conductor? Yeah, I bet they just want to control the whole thing again.
No way... People have been really pushing for more freedom this year, and the Order said we could organize our own performances during the Carnevale.
Sure, they said that, but when have they ever kept their promises? In the end, they'll do whatever they want, and probably bring up that incident from ten years ago to justify it.
I just hope it's not more of those boring hymns… They're all the same! I'm so over them.
Shh! The Order's guards are coming this way…
But isn’t the Montelli family hosting the Carnevale this year?
Doesn’t matter. They’re businesspeople. Who knows what they’re really up to.
Keep blathering on about this without a shred of evidence and you could end up before the <ano=The Secular Court> of the Order's Tribunal</ano>.
Ugh, fine, I’m just saying…
That was so scary! I really thought Bakie was gonna lose control just like that Vitreum Dancer…
Anyway, you really shouldn’t have had to go through such a rough experience on your first visit to Ragunna.
Here, take these dishes—they’re on the house! Hope this keeps your day on the bright side!
Grandpa, what’s the Carnevale like?
Well, there are so many stories about the Carnevale…

At first, it was a festival to thank the Sentinel. Back then, people had just escaped the sorrow of the Lament. They’d lost their homes and felt a deep respect for the Sentinel, so the ceremonies were always very serious.
One day, the Sentinel’s voice came down from the heavens:
"Solemnity is not the only name of gratitude or remembrance." The Sentinel wanted people to build a future with joy and hope, to honor the past by living fully in the present.

Since then, everyone began following the Sentinel’s guidance. They put on their fine clothes, sang their favorite songs, and put on plays. Gradually, the Carnevale turned into the celebration we know today.
Every year, the Sentinel chooses the best performer and gifts them the Laurel as a sign of encouragement.
One of my old friends was actually a Laureate, hehe...
For kids like you, this festival is a time to hang out with friends and eat all kinds of special treats.
Wow! So… does that mean I don't have to do homework as well?
Hooray! Carnevale! Why can’t we have it more often, Grandpa?
Ah, that's a bit complicated, dear. But don't worry, Grandpa will explain it all to you one day…
A traveling troupe? Never heard of a group like that around Rinascita...
Oh, come on! The Guinizello Troupe is gonna win the Laurel at this year's Carnevale for sure!
Heard the news? The Order's bringing in a "Conductor" for this year's Carnevale!
A Conductor? Yeah, I bet they just want to control the whole thing again.
Carnevale, delicious Carnevale…
Oh wait, I mean gelato…
Carnevale, delicious Carnevale… Oh wait, I mean gelato…
Hey there! First time in Ragunna? Well, let me tell you this—Carnevale isn't just for partying! It's our big chance to make enough money to last us all year!
Plus, what the Laureate says about food can totally be a game changer!
Take the Laurus Salad, for example. It used to be just a plain ol' salad, nothing fancy.
Then, one day, a Laureate casually mentioned that the Sentinel liked it, and bam! It became the most popular dish in town!
They say the Sentinel's always watching over us, especially during Carnevale. Who knows, maybe They'll even show up as one of us!
And if They try our gelato… well, it might be just the thing to hit the spot!
Hmm... something's wrong with that Vitreum Dancer...
An Echo lost control? H-how could that be possible?!
Someone call the guards! Hurry!
What… just happened? How could a Common Echo harm people like that?
A Divine Envoy doing this… it doesn't make sense…
Wait, is that one of the Montellis' Echoes? I heard theirs aren't exactly considered "Common Echoes"…
Alert the Servitude Hall now! We need that Vitreum Dancer under control!
We must get security tightened around the Montelli Quarter.
Nooo! My pizza! I didn’t even get a bite! D-do you think the Sentinel’s gonna punish me for wasting food…?
Oh, don’t be silly. It was just an accident. No way the Sentinel would care about that...
O Sentinel above... Is this your fury? Are you trying to warn us...
Bakie! Are you okay?
Beep beep!
Thank goodness you're alright...
An Echo attacking humans? Right before the Carnevale? That’s wild…
Rumor has it, the Montelli family’s Echoes are "filthy"...
So the Montellis are behind this mess? Ha! Now that would be top-shelf entertainment!
Hmph, isn’t the Montellis the one pushing this whole Carnevale? And they can’t even control their own Echoes? A Vitreum Dancer show? Really, that’s their big idea?
They keep saying it’s for the people, but who actually buys that? It’s all about the money, fame, and power for them.
Ignoring past "truths," shrugging off the Order's warnings, disregarding public safety!
Are they just going to ignore divine will, or worse, go against the Sentinel? Heh, classic Montellis! Always "bold and pioneering"…
Or maybe… they just want to humiliate themselves at the Carnevale. Haha, that’d be top-shelf entertainment!
Just wait. Once the Order hands down their verdict, the Montellis’ so-called glory days will be over.
A Lycoris petal lies on the ground, emanating an ominous aura...
You vaguely remember seeing this kind of flower before...
A private gathering is currently underway ahead, and entry is restricted to members of the Order.
Greetings, esteemed guest. There is a private gathering underway ahead, and entry is restricted to members of the Order. We apologize for any inconvenience.
The Primus is currently unavailable for an audience. If you have matters requiring the Order’s consideration, please consult with Priest Alessio.
Should you wish to enter the Cathedral of Mercury, please proceed through the main door.
Before you stands a man clad in pure white—or rather, a hologram of him—and his grand throne.
Though merely a projection, there is an undeniable gravity and majesty to his presence.
This must be Fenrico, the Primus of the Order of the Deep, just as Priest Alessio described.
From what you’ve gathered and experienced, it seems clear that he is the Resonator of the Sentinel, Imperator.

You take a moment to study his figure. A golden mask conceals half of his face, while the other half reveals a deep furrow in his brow. His gaze lowered, carrying an unreadable expression. What lies behind it? Compassion? Or perhaps something deeper, such as... an unspeakable grief?
Why would he leave this projection in the Cathedral?
(To oversee everything?)
(To offer a silent reassurance?)
(Or simply to impress, because it looks… cool?)
As you mull over these questions, a sudden chill creeps over you. For a fleeting moment, you feel as if his gaze has shifted, directed straight at you. But when you look again, his face is unchanged.
Was it an illusion? You can’t be sure. But for now, you’d best focus on tracking down the channel Gilberto used to make his escape.
Was that… Mr. Gilberto from the Fisalia family? Why was he in such a rush?
The way he went, looks like he’s off to"seek forgiveness."
Ah, may the Sentinel guide him to "salvation"…
I don’t think I’ve seen these two before. Judging by their outfits… they don’t really look like the Order’s followers.
Probably some guests invited by Priest Alessio. Can’t put our fingers on the higher-ups’ business, anyway.
That’s true. Under the Sentinel’s sheltering wing, we’re all kin as long as we walk in righteousness.
But if they break the rules… well, that’s a different story.

Ah, it's you!
I'd still be dozing out in the wild if it weren't for your help.
Here, take these.
I stocked up on all these supplies back when I used to worry too much, but I don't need them anymore.
Now that I'm joining the Pioneer Association, it's time to gather my courage and face the unknown!
Ah, it's you—the strongest in the world!
Since you're here, take these suppliers. They were meant for my special training, but I no longer need them. Thanks to you, I've realized how limited my strength alone is.
But with my brothers by my side, I bet even someone as tough as you won't be able to take us down in one go, haha!
I can't wait to join the Pioneer Association!
Ah, it's you!
Thanks for helping me organize those pages earlier. Please accept these rewards.
There should be more, but I can't remember where I left them. I hope you don't mind.
Now that my brothers are here, I can leave the management to Fratellone!
Anyway, we'll definitely join the Pioneer Association! Your support won't go in vain!
Awesome, you're still here!
We were just chatting and realized you've actually lent a hand to all three of us!
Yeah! You are on fire! No wonder you're the strongest in the world!
Thank you so much!
Don't mention it.
Well, I need more than just compliments.
Such modesty! Joining the Pioneer Association is a dream come true, and you've helped us so much! We'll thank you properly for sure!
Of course! Joining the Pioneer Association is a dream come true, and you've helped us so much! We'll thank you properly for sure!
The strongest deserves the finest! We'll give you something blazing!
Hear hear! We're planning to commission a <color=Highlight>statue</color> in your honor, and it will be placed right here!
Alright, hit us with your coolest pose!
Ah... here you are. L-look at the "statue" we prepared for you! Hahaha...
This isn't a statue at all.
It was supposed to be a statue, but, well, something went a little wrong.
After the stone arrived, I was worried someone would steal it, so I stayed here and had Fratello deliver your portrait to the sculptor.
That's right. I almost ran my life out delivering it, and then... I got lost! Haha!
I figured Fratello was lost when he didn't come back, so I grabbed the backup portrait and went to find the sculptor.
But I dropped the portrait somewhere along the way...
With the stone gone, we had no choice but to use the commission fee to buy a projector and display your pose here instead.
Alright...
I still want my statue!
Thanks for being understanding, haha!
Well, we spent all of our savings on this, so making a new statue might be a bit too much to handle...
Or maybe we should put our plan to join the Pioneer Association on hold for now and focus on saving up!
If everything goes smoothly, we should have enough money in three or four years to build your statue!
That's not necessary...
Thank you for your understanding, haha.
Now, if you'll excuse us, we're heading off to the Association. Till we meet again!
Oh, it's you. What can I do for you?
Why do you want to join the Pioneer Association?
Me? Honestly, I don't want to. I can't stand the uncertainty it may bring. But since my two reckless brothers insist on joining, I have to follow.
I don't understand why people in the Association wander all over the world—places without the Sentinel's blessings are far too dangerous to venture into.
It's natural to be curious about the world.
Maybe you'll get it after you join them.
Curiosity is natural, but so is the instinct to avoid dangers. I just want my brothers to be safe.
I'm not that interested. I just want my brothers to stay safe.
Oh, do you need something from me?
Are you still in training?
Of course! My training never stops, not even for a moment!
Just wait and see. One day, I'll become the strongest in the world!
Hey, lifesaver! Is there something else you need?
Why do you want to join the Pioneer Association?
Well, don't tell anyone, but I suspect the Order has something to do with the Dark Tide!
At first, it was just a feeling, but the more I dig through these unofficial records, the more suspicious it looks.
It seems like someone's been fueling the chaos, using the Dark Tide to keep us terrified... and it's clear that the Order stands to benefit the most from it!
...So, the relic... is a sword.
*Cough* If only... I'd known sooner...
Curse those monsters... curse the Dark Tide...
I... will carry on... Teacher's wish... to the very end.
The explorers have retrieved a sword from the sea of clouds, along with the remains of an Acolyte, likely one lost to the Dark Tide.
The sword appears to be an artifact passed down by our sages. Judging by its form, it seems crafted not for combat but for Carnevale rituals.
I suspect it may have once belonged to a Primus. Regrettably, all records of this sword were lost to the Dark Tide.
In honor of the Acolyte who once safeguarded this relic, we've decided to place it in a small chapel untouched by the sea of clouds.
The chapel stands beneath the cliffside, near the remnants of the broken bridge. It should be easy to find.
We've stored the relic in the bell tower, with the hope that future pilgrims will remember and honor its presence here.
An ancient stone tablet worn by the passage of time. It bears inscriptions in the ancient Rinascita language, faintly legible. A prophecy, perhaps.
"Once whole... the Divinity was rent by warring creeds..."
"From Their holy wounds... sprang the curse of Dark Tide..."
"Though the woes of Rinascita yet endure... the shattered Divinity hath chosen Their herald..."
"On the grandest of days... the maiden, crowned with golden laurel... shall commune with the Divinity..."
"Thus she becomes the prophesied 'Enlightened One'... through whom Rinascita's woes shall end..."
"Then... the Divinity shall return to its true form..."
"and Rinascita, under its glory... shall be a paradise free of suffering..."
Vida

Fulmine, the manager of Wutherium Film Studio, looks worried these days.
The deadline for the next periodical is around the corner, but he seems to have trouble picking the right photos... he beseeched the Laureate for help.
Traces of Tides
Here you are! Actually, I've come to ask you for a favor today...
The deadline for the new issue of Wutherium Film Studio's publication is approaching, and this time, we plan to capitalize on a trending topic.
What topic?
Is it about me?
Oh! No need to be modest, of course it's about you—the latest Laureate in Ragunna!
Of course, you are the latest Laureate in Ragunna after all!
As you know, publishing is tough these days, and if sales keep lagging, headquarters will probably cut our budget again.
We've been following your work in Ragunna and thought if you, the Laureate, photographed a travelogue of Ragunna, it would surely be a hit!
So we'd like to commission you to take a series of photos for this issue to help boost sales.
Any profit from this will go entirely to you. Please, we're counting on you!
Alright.
All you have to do is ask.
Thank you so much! We've already set the coordinates for some of Ragunna's landmarks. I'll send them to you now!
What a perfect shot! Brilliant composition, exquisite colors!
Please, don't limit yourself to photography. What I mean is, your aesthetic should not be confined by the camera!
This is where my good partner comes in! Mr. C-MOSS! With your permission, it can capture the scenery you envision. Please, roam Ragunna freely and collect the scenes that speak to you.
Have you taken the first photo yet? Let me take a look!
Send the photo
Forward, the knight's mission is to move ahead... I understand.
But the knight's attire has been with me for half my life. Now, who can give meaning to the knight's path forward?
This land is no longer where I belong. If the art I seek is truly a sin beyond redemption, then... where should I go?
This is the final location for the last photo. Thank goodness you agreed to help — this issue will surely be the most brilliant since the magazine's inception!
But your story with Ragunna is still unfolding, and I truly look forward to witnessing more of your legacy here.
Ah...No! I can't fall asleep... Mmm...
What's wrong?
I wanted to capture a Nightmare Cloud for research, but I accidentally got hit... Quick, use that to help me...
Oh no... the nightmare's about to start...
Go to those Nightmare Clouds... and then...
Capture one... give it to me...
Ugh, I think I had a really long nightmare...
Are you okay? What are you doing here?
Oh, hello! I'm Fratellone of the Fratellis. My two brothers and I are training to join the Pioneer Association.
I was hoping to prove myself by catching a Nightmare Cloud, but I got attacked instead. Thank you for helping me!
By the way, once my training is over, come visit me in Egla Town. I'll repay you properly!
See you later then!
What exactly is the Nightmare Cloud?
The elders say that Nightmare Clouds are formed by the murmurs of people lost in nightmares.
They're filled with all the frightful thoughts that appear in people's minds while they sleep.

I... I'm really nervous about joining the Pioneer Association. There are just so many unknowns ahead! But I'm also worried about my two younger brothers. That's why I need Nightmare Clouds to train my willpower!
The Pioneer Association isn't as dangerous as you think.
You can do it, Fratellone!
No way! Going to strange places and eating unfamiliar food—I get stomach cramps just thinking about it!
Thanks!
Ah, it's you! Wait... does that mean I got attacked again?
I wonder if someone like me really belongs in the Pioneer Association...
You can do it, Fratellone!
You can do it! You're already ahead of most people!
If you say so... I'll give it another shot!
It feels like I'm getting used to being saved by you lately...
You know, I think I dreamt through every single problem I might face after joining the Pioneer Association.
It feels like I've already had enough.
But you haven't even joined yet!
Come on, Fratellone! You've got this!
Alright, since you say so, I'll keep pushing forward!
Aaah... Good morning!
Looks like you slept pretty well, huh?
Yeah, seems like the Nightmare Clouds can't give me bad dreams anymore.
Maybe I've already had all my nightmares?
Way to go, Fratellone!
Can you actually run out of nightmares?
Haha, I'm heading back to Egla Town for a bit. Maybe we'll meet there! I still owe you a big thanks!
Ugh... if we get surrounded by the Plushie Squad... each of us would have to fight 1.3 Plushies...
Please, don't make me eat Baton Bread again! They're so dry and hard...
Nooo... don't pick me to be the Blessed Maiden — I don't want to wear a dress!
The Dark Tide! Fratellino, don't go skinny-dipping in the Dark Tide!
Wait, I have to fight Lorelei? Are you serious...
Boil the great dragon into soup? Spare me, please...
I thought we were heading to the Pioneer Association, not boarding the Pilgrim's Sail!
Stop making me take baths, Lord Tubpup... My skin's wrinkled...
Welcome. Would you like to reach for the brightest star in the sky, or indulge in the greatest joy of the mortal world?
Or maybe… nothing could ever satisfy your endless desire?
Always so playful, Mammon. Unfortunately, my friend here isn't driven by greed.
All we seek is the first riddle of the "ghost girl" to set the tone for tonight. After all, even the smallest catch can serve as a splendid entrée for a grand feast.
I see, but nothing comes for free. If you want it, you'll have to trade me something entertaining.
Perhaps a loaf of bread that speaks, oil that melts into water, or... a glimpse into Fisalia's hidden past.
How about a special performance from a Laureate?
Oh, just for me? That would be an honor I'd truly relish.
What a pleasure to meet you again, {PlayerName}.
Offer your soul, surrender your flesh. Give all you have, call the lost from their rest...
That sounds uncanny.
Oh, sorry. Forgive me if it unsettles you. It's an old folk song about the Night of Remembrance. They say its eerie melody has a strange frequency that can draw the attention of ravenous "demons."
Ah… I can feel it now. There it is—the first stall.

Cantarella steps forward with unwavering certainty, her movement ethereal, drifting like a ghost. At this moment, she seems capable of summoning demons herself. Without hesitation, you follow her lead.
Will the lost souls truly return home?
It's been nine years...
Sometimes, it feels like they actually return to us on the Night of Remembrance.
Yes, but only on this special night...
