Hello, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}. It's been so long! Ever since you helped with the restoration, more and more Echoes have been flocking to the Plushie Village.
I can't remember the last time everyone's gotten so cheery and zippy.
Everything sounds great.
Yes, yes. And on behalf of those whose names I shall keep a secret for now, I would like to extend a formal invitation to you…
Wait, what's the sound?
You suddenly hear the delicate sound of silvery chimes. As you try to pinpoint the source, you realize it's coming from the Bell of Echoing Heart gifted by the Plushie Echoes before.
Sounds like they want to see you as soon as possible. Well then, we'll be waiting for you at the Plushie Village!
Riding a Gondola in a sea of clouds is really something else, huh?
Feels kinda like we're... drifting on the clouds. Err, how else can you put it?
It really is a unique experience.
We should be getting close, right? Hold on, lemme check with...
(Happy sounds.)
Hey, this is it! Let's take our picture here, {PlayerName}!
What a view up here... Hmm? What's that?
What's up?
They're asking if this is where you beat that dragon and if you were the one who put together this place the way it is now.
(Sounds of excitement.)
Whoa... What's with all this wind!? Keep her steady now, {PlayerName}!
(Mixed chirpy noises.)
I didn't know you guys could handle heights!
Wow. Everything's slowly coming back to me now...
Zargon Garden. Didn't really get a chance to enjoy it after putting it all together.
Well, there we go then. I'm gonna enjoy every detail of this place as much as I can!
With the swing of {PlayerName}'s blade, Echoes appeared out of nowhere!
It's like the scene is happening again right in front of me! Wait a minute...
...Where did these Echoes come from!? I didn't know I could summon Echoes!
Hey, this painting... It just started glowing for some reason.
You know, it's actually kinda pretty... Look at how the stars are lighting up too. What do you think is inside? You don't suppose there's Echoes waiting to jump on us again, do you?
How about you go take a look?
I'll go take a look.
...I might be Solaris's No.1 Echo, but I thought we're supposed to stick together when it comes to adventuring! Plus, who's gonna look after the Plushies while I'm gone?
If you say so. I guess Solaris's No.1 Echo has nothing to worry about with {PlayerName} on the case…
The glowing painting might be some kind of hint. Either way, we'll need to check it out.
Now, settle down everyone. I've already told you {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName} is on their way... Oh, you're here!
Here I am.
What did I miss?
At last! The hero of the Plushie Village graces us with {Male=his;Female=her} presence yet again.
Oh, no. Not at all. We were all waiting for you to start the adventure.
This is for me...?
It's our first bloom of the morning! These little guys wouldn't want anyone close to it until it finally blossomed.
They said they wanted you to have the very first flower.
(Sounds of being happy and shy.)
Thanks. It means a lot to me.
(Extremely happy sounds.)
They're really glad you like it! By the way, there's something else I'd like to ask you, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}. Have you ever seen a Seaside Cendrelis before?
As you can see, the rebuilt Plushie Village is now thriving, and the Echoes have been trying out new things every day.

Especially after the Plushies overhead Enzo and I chatted about the Cendrelis, which are flowers that glow like jellyfish, a few days back. They got really curious and excited, they wanted to see it for themselves!
You don't happen to have some of those magical-looking flowers on you, do you?
You find a Seaside Cendrelis from your bag and hand it over to Fulmine.

This is it... This is the kind of beauty you find once in a lifetime. Oh, thank you. Thank you so much, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}! Enzo swore that Seaside Cendrelis were long extinct, and I almost believed that until now!
Where did you find it, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}? Can you show the Plushies? If that's okay.
Our Plushie Squad, made up of the best of the best Echoes, was chomping at the bit for a new adventure ever since the Plushie Village was reborn from the ashes!
Sounds exhilarating.
Sounds like a lot of work.
That's right! This is all inspired by the stories of your greatest adventures. They'll have a present ready for you at the end of this new adventure!

No, no, no. Exploring new views is just part of it. They also want to witness the valiant {PlayerName} in action with their own eyes. And, there will be a present ready for our hero at the end of it as well!
Sounds nice.

Easy peasy, lemon squeezy.
Instead of hanging around the village all day, there's nothing more exciting than discovering exotic lifeforms and visiting exciting places!
Bubble and Old Bake always get cold feet when it comes to visiting new places. Maybe seeing some of the unique views beyond the village would help them change their minds.

New adventures, here we come.

Codex of the Deep: Preface (137th Edition)

Codex of the Deep: Preface (137th Edition) Many non-initiates misunderstand the Order of Deep and feel overwhelmed by words in the Codex such as "grace," "salvation," "mercy," and "faith." Indeed, never has the Sentinel Imperator revealed Their true form. So why then, are we to believe in Their existence? The chronicles of Rinascita record numerous battles of the Sentinel against the Lament. The ruins and wonders across Rinascita bear witness to Imperator's divine authority. Their destined path created a better world for mankind, leaving us to shape a new future, while They, silently watch over us. We are grateful for Their blessings. We honor Their teachings. We follow in Their deeds by disseminating wisdom that guides all towards good—such is the mission of the Order of Deep. Under Cassilin the Knowledgeable, we have compiled this introduction to elucidate upon the meaning of the Sentinel and our Order. This we hope inspires followers on the path of virtue. We begin with some frequently asked questions: 1. Who is Sentinel Imperator? Sentinel Imperator embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. It is important to note that we acknowledge other divine beings, for They have spoken of Sentinels in distant lands, with powers that control day and night, the flow of time, or all knowledge and wisdom. Without exception, all Sentinels selflessly guide humanity and shepherd civilization. As such, all Sentinels are great divinities. However We believe Sentinel Imperator holds foremost power to "Split." That is, They split the ocean, granting humanity land on which to "breathe." By right of Their providence, Imperator is elevated among all Sentinels. 2. What is the Order's doctrine? This mortal world is a boundless sea in which every soul must swim up to the divine. Life flows in waves, and only by reaching the shore do we reach the dawn of civilization. Our Sentinel is salvation from the gales and tides, is the unity from which Rinascita was born, and is ascension for our souls. The Order's doctrines are thus: “Salvation," "Ascension," and "Unity." - Salvation: By the grace of the Sentinel, Their followers must deliver salvation to others. Nary are we blind to injustice or suffering. We labor to save others from sin. To the wicked, the Order provides salvation, and for the unrepentant, may we exact penitence. - Ascension: To find salvation is to seek ascension. Members of the Order will not indulge Their favor in idle pleasures or desires. All must elevate their spirit through self-discipline or risk sinking into the abyss. - Unity: After granting us Their representation on earth, Sentinel Imperator left Rinascita in our care. Members of the Order are "brothers and sisters," who unite people of faith, regardless of origin or background. Only as one can we fortify ourselves from the perils of the deep sea. The first Primus, Napoli the Second, received a prophecy from the Sentinel: in a distant future, a "Last Wave" shall engulf the earth. Those saved must "breathe," to "ascend" in "unity" on new land, just as we once answered the Sentinel's call and made landfall on Rinascita. 3. Is there evidence to support the doctrine of the Order? Theology is a science humanity has not yet fully understood in theory or practice. The Sentinel guides civilization, and we trust Their word. Throughout the generations, the Order has established the following philosophical precepts. Excerpts from The Philosophy of the Order: Sacred Knowledge (Volume 1: Water): On Origin: Genesis in "Water." In nature "Water" is infinite as it is universal. In the beginning, Sentinel Imperator "split" this world, once a formless ocean, into the realm of land and sea. On Motion: Movement through "Water." The motion of "Water" heats and cools, wets and dries the realm of land. From water, all life was created in the "First Wave" and will end in the "Last Wave." On Revelations: Refractions of "Water." Man's image reflected by "Water" is a strange reality unto himself. So too applies to all reality when water refracts the world unto the Sonoro Sphere. Through reforms by successive Primuses, we have come to emphasize the scientific and practical application of our philosophical understanding. Readers may visit Arito Well in the Square of Liberty to experience the mysteries of "water divination": toss a coin into the well, make a heartfelt wish, and answers you shall receive. We would be greatly honored if this Codex engenders interest in the Sentinel's teachings, and we welcome all to the Order's library, where supplementary literature is available to borrow. While words are a paltry means to express the Sentinel's grand purpose, we nonetheless hope to have adequately conveyed fractions of divine essence. Let miracles recorded in the Codex be "symbols" of infinite, communicable power. Through narratives of common understanding, we envision a world of unwavering faith. Even as the Lament threatens to return, we reaffirm our place and purpose. We pray that believers and non-believers alike will view the text herein as an invitation for communion and reflection. May these words offer insight to us adrift at sea. The paths are many, but with virtue in our hearts, we illuminate a way amidst the waves.

With Ishmael's guidance, you manage to find the old captain, Ahab, at the dock. Ahab gladly lets you borrow his old Gondola, and you can go fishing at sea with it.

After you've recaptured the escaped fish, Ahab suggests you check out the market. To your surprise, Phoebe is there too. You find her in a sticky situation because of the locals' fraught history with the Order of the Deep. After You and Ahab help her out, Phoebe reveals she came here searching for Cetus the Tidebreaker. Ahab remarks that you'll run into the beast eventually just by going out fishing.

Following Captain Ahab's instructions, you and Phoebe manage to find his old First Mate, Starbuck, but the man seems to have fallen under some kind of enchantment. To help Starbuck come to his senses, you decide to locate his Gondola for clues.

You and Phoebe find Starbuck's lost Gondola. Having theorized that Starbuck's enchantment has something to do with the fish he was holding, the two of you begin brainstorming a plan to get it off his hands.

You and Phoebe finally manage to grab the fish from Starbuck, and the First Mate's sanity is restored. Starbuck claims he once saw Cetus the Tidebreaker at a place called Serene Bay, with a large fish swimming alongside it. He hands you the lighthouse key Captain Ahab entrusted in his care before you departed.
The Tidebreaker has indeed been wandering in Serene Bay. After the lighthouse was relit, the beast swam towards a small island covered in storm...

As you find it impossible to pass through the storm looming over Reyes Islands, you head towards the nameless island Ahab mentioned. You attempt to dispel the storm following the inscription on the ancient steles, but to no avail. In the end, it's Starbuck's peculiar method of "offering his love" to the island that finally calms the storm.
When the last lighthouse becomes operational once more, Cetus the Tidebreaker returns to its usual gentle self. Meanwhile, Phoebe has also made progress in her investigation of the island.

As the storm subsides, you meet the Tidebreaker again after it carried you back from the depths of the sea. Phoebe wishes to express her apology to the beast for what happened during the Carnevale, but the Tidebreaker holds no grudge. Maybe one day in the future, as a pro angler, you might be able to reel the big guy in...

After deciphering the ancient tablets, Phoebe believes the Tidebreaker is tasked to guide the lost souls to the realm beyond, and the "siren" invading these waters may be a creature similar in nature to Lorelei. With the information at hand, the two of you seek Captain Ahab's aid to deal with the "siren."

1. After unlocking Fishing Ability: Wonder Bubble, you can purchase Wonder Bubbles of the area from Planck, the dock merchant. Upon purchase, a Wonder Bubble will be automatically generated near the current dock, gradually catching crabs and urchins in the area.

2. The Wonder Bubble has a limited capacity. Once full, it will stop catching fish. Please claim your catches in time.

3. Steer Rachel to the Wonder Bubble and interact with it to claim your catches.

4. Enhance your Fishing Abilities to increase the Wonder Bubble's capacity and improve the quality of the catches.

1. After unlocking Trawl, it will be automatically equipped to Rachel and help you catch previously fished species in the area.

2. The Trawl has a limited capacity. Once full, it will stop catching fish. Please claim your catches in time.

3. The Trawl can only be accessed at the Dock interface, where you can manage your catches from the Trawl.

4. Enhance your Fishing Abilities to increase the Trawl's capacity and improve the quality of the catches.

1. After unlocking Quick Sale, a dashed Quick Sale area will be automatically generated in the Cargo every time you open the Dock interface. Place your catches within this area during sailing for Quick Sale.

3. Catches sold through Quick Sale fetch higher prices compared to dock sales.

4. Quick Sale is only available during sailing.

1. You can store your catches in Rachel's Cargo.

What's the difference between a coconut-flavored urchin and an urchin-flavored coconut? Nevertheless, one thing's for sure: both hurt like a charm when they hit your head.

It is a common belief among the Riccioli fishers that the crystal cavities on Cetus the Tidebreaker were pierced by a crew of godless sailors, incurring divine wrath. Then, the fragments of the shattered crystals transformed into the Black Pearls—though Captain Ahab firmly dismisses this tale as fanciful nonsense.

A variant of the Gulpuff, often found near the Riccioli Islands. Unlike its docile cousin, the Bampuff is highly aggressive and is used to make "Sweet Puff."
During the day, a threatened Bampuff will explode, dragging predators—or even fishing boats—into mutual destruction. At night, however, it can be fished like any ordinary catch.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.

A type of flax native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a kind of rough material.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.

A type of tree log native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a kind of rough material.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.

Metal debris found in the Riccioli Islands territory. Despite being eroded by the sea, it's still usable as rough material.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
As is well known, octopuses don't naturally grow inside clams. These small octopuses actively seek out suitable clams, devour the original residents, and claim the shells as their new homes.

During their brief breeding season, Bell Crabs shed their iconic bells in search of mates. Fishers humorously call them "Bell-less Crabs" during this time. Their meat is said to become exceptionally flavorful, attracting food enthusiasts from Ragunna eager to savor this seasonal delicacy.
Found across Solaris, this fish occupies a mid-tier position in the food chain. It is known for its ability to leap out of the water and glide for short distances.
True to its name, this jellyfish resembles and tastes like a fried egg. It is one of the largest exports of the Riccioli Islands.
Are they fish? Yes, yes, they are. Did I finish them? No, no...

At a distance, it resembles a drifting vegetable leaf, but up close, it brings to mind the legendary ancient dragon of Rinascita. Despite their grand dreams of becoming the mighty Pelagic Wyrm, their tiny size dooms their ambition to stay only a fantasy.

Most biologists in Rinascita agree that "Rainbow Eel" would better suit this creature than "Yarn Eel" based on their vibrant appearance. However, due to their timid nature, these eels are often found tangling with one another for survival. While "a cluster of timid Rainbow Eels" might be accurate, "Yarn Eel" is far less of a tongue-twister.

This octopus might not pack much nutritional value, but its charm is off the charts. With a cute appearance and a soft, graceful body that dances through the water, it has won the hearts of Ragunna's noble ladies, becoming a sought-after ornamental pet.

In the Riccioli Islands, misbehaving children are often warned about the Giant Gulper, a deep-sea predator said to snatch naughty kids at night. While this creature fuels many childhood nightmares for the islanders, the Sob Blobs, as its helpless prey, truly live in its shadow.

In the lightless depths of the sea, these clustered salps are a common meal for many deep-sea creatures—except Giant Gulpers. It seems these predators find the salps too small to bother with. To date, there have been no reported sightings of Giant Gulpers chowing down on salps.
It sobs for its insignificance in the vast ocean and its vulnerability to the gaping maw of its predators.
The Pokey Moray once vowed to leave behind its slow-paced life—only for its ambition to be cut short the moment it ended up on your line.

Food, shelter, and fashion are no concerns for a Gooberstar. It spends its days lounging in carefree bliss, untouched by predators thanks to its unappetizing taste. Its life is nearly perfect—if only it could find a sponge to make things even better.

Armed with a coat of sharp thorns, a Pricklecrab is a bold and aggressive predator of the deep sea. One fisher is said to have fended off a Tacet Discord by hurling a Pricklecrab at it. A creature of great ferocity indeed.

Known as the "Sea Angel," this delicate creature is as enchanting as a butterfly fairy. Many believe it serves as the envoy of Cetus the Tidebreaker, tasked with retrieving lost souls from the ocean's depths. Yet, given its diminutive size, one can't help but question its suitability for such a daunting mission.

These ancient sea flowers thrive in Solaris, fostering a harmonious bond with Seabed Snows. Their appearance resembles the decorative feathers often seen on performers' hats during the Carnevale, earning them the nickname "Star's Feather Crown."

The Stygian Phantom, a highly toxic jellyfish cherished by the Fisalia family, stands in stark contrast to Cetus the Tidebreaker. While Cetus is revered for its role in ferrying sailors' souls to the afterlife, the Stygian Phantom is said to deliver lost souls to the Underworld ruled by the Overlord Squid, where they remain trapped for eternity.

Often found alongside the Stygian Phantom, this fish is said to carry the souls of lost sailors who have entered the domain of the Underworld. Fishers hold that these souls are even beyond the reach of Cetus the Tidebreaker, eternally adrift, never to find rest.

During the breeding season, some ocean trenches experience a Seabed Snow population explosion, turning the seabed into a pristine white landscape adorned with vibrant flowers—a truly picturesque sight to behold.
If you ever venture into the depths of the Riccioli waters, beware of any glimmers in the darkness—no matter how enchanting their colors.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. The origin, structure, and power force of this mysterious mechanical device are all shrouded in mystery. Could it hail from a world where humans can be transformed into machines, robots talk, airships dominate the skies, and fish are made of iron? What? You want to know why the oceans there are red?
A dreamy creature found in the ocean trenches, like a cute tiny elf. Its survival hinges on extremely specific conditions, making it impossible to sell as an ornamental pet in Ragunna.

Captain Ahab and Bertoli, a biologist from the Pioneer Association, once had a heated debate over the name of this fish. Ahab insisted that its fondness for sunbathing warranted the name "Sunfish," to which Bertoli retorted, "Then why not just call it 'Dried Flatfish' instead?"

This vibrant red shrimp has an intimidating name, but its flavor tells a different story. Renowned for its exquisite taste, some food enthusiasts believe the name "Legilimens Shrimp" stems from its ability to captivate anyone who takes just one bite.

A top predator in the oceanic waters surrounding the Riccioli Islands, the Lancetfish is known for its fiery temper. Once it sinks its teeth into prey, it never lets go, swallowing its victim whole. This habit has led to frequent catches of Lancetfish that died from attempting to devour a Trombone Ammonoid—shells and all.
Wait, is that... Astrite!? Holy crab!!

This peculiar fish always "stands" on the seabed with its three slender fins. Its primary diet consists of Seabed Snows, but these poor little deep-sea bunnies occasionally try to climb its fins for a counterattack. Alas, their attempts are always in vain.

Painters in Ragunna once tried to extract the vivid hues of the Rainbow Dolphinfish for their artwork but abandoned the idea when the pigments proved impossible to blend. This type of dolphinfish carries its offspring while hunting and is fiercely protective. If its young are threatened, it will retaliate without hesitation, even capsizing fishing ships—hence the nickname "Iron Lady."

As a rare survivor of the last Lament, their shell is revered by the Order of the Deep as a sacred material for crafting instruments. Yet, with natural predators at every turn, their numbers in the Riccioli waters are dwindling rapidly.

A colossal hairtail that can stretch several meters in length, the Reinfish is a legendary creature in the Riccioli Islands. According to local lore, it serves as the reins of the sea god's chariot. In Ragunna, however, its appearance is seen as an omen of an impending earthquake. Like the Lancetfish, the Reinfish reigns as a top predator in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.  Legend has it that this shark only preys on pirates attempting to bury their treasures, devouring them whole along with their gold. Recently, the Aureo Shark has been hunting a notorious pirate named Aldric, who narrowly escaped its jaws—until fate brought it to your fishing boat instead.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. Legend has it that during Napolis the Second's pilgrimage, a storm arose. To calm the tempest, a pink sacred relic was cast into the raging sea, restoring the waters to their former tranquility. An ordinary ray fish happened to pass by the relic and was imbued with its pink hue.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This rare, colossal sea dragon was once believed extinct until it was spotted in the depths of the Riccioli Trench. Locals of the Riccioli Islands believe it to be a guardian of the sea, akin to Cetus the Tidebreaker. In the scriptures of the Order of the Deep, the Pelagic Wrym is deemed a harbinger of the Sentinel's manifestation.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. It is said that after Threnodian Leviathan was defeated by Sentinel Imperator, its subordinates were stripped of their power, left to barely survive in the depths. Draco Cobia, once a loyal servant of the Leviathan, has long lost the power granted by the Threnodian, yet it still remains a deadly predator to smaller sea creatures.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.
"In the Underworld palace, the archdemon sits on its throne, awaiting souls delivered by the ferryman. With a thousand grasping arms, it rises to seize the heart of the condemned. From that moment, the wretched soul is bound to serve the archdemon for a thousand years, a fate from which neither Cetus the Tidebreaker nor Imperator can deliver them."

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This creature is a top predator who has survived thousands of years in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands. Surviving the Lament might sound impressive, but facing its razor-sharp fangs is an even greater challenge.

About Tactical Simulacra III

[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra III, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges. Use different buffs to defeat enemies to complete the challenge objectives in Bonus Challenge and obtain additional rewards.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered.

[Combat Rank]

Hitting the enemy steadily improves your Combat Rank. Defeating enemies provides a significant boost.

Data File Segment

... very few people, including those within the Montelli family know when the Vitreum Dancers first appeared, even though these unobtrusive, unremarkable Echoes have long served the family. In fact, most of the Montellis do not know of Vitreum Dancers as anything other than their domestic security detail. Thus it remains easily overlooked that no two Vitreum Dancers are alike.

Knowledge gleaned from the stained-glass artwork found in the ruins around Ragunna suggests that Vitreum Dancers were once Tacet Discord frequencies. They appear in stained-glass art along with general depictions of The Order's religion. To this day Montelli explorers have yet to find two identical panes of stained glass. The Order's artists took pains to alter the composition of panes that depict the same story or motif. This suggests that the frequencies of modern Vitreum Dancers each contain unique information, much like their Tacet Discord forbearers.

According to the book "The Wealth and Legend of the Montellis," the origin of the Vitreum Dancer dates back in history to a time when a Montelli ancestor received the Laurel during the Carnevale from Imperator who then instructed him to go to a tower abandoned by The Order. Upon his return, he would not divulge what he saw and forbade all Montellis from approaching the tower again. Undoubtedly this Montelli ancestor brought back the very first Vitreum Dancer. On his deathbed, his last words were that the Sentinel's Oracle would not exert influence over Montellis at present, but would determine their future course of events.

And with that the tower was barred to all subsequent Montelli, and as the family's cohort of Vitreum Dancers expanded, the legend of their origins faded into obscurity.

Round Hat... for you.

At long last, the final performance.
Dance! And fight!
The Maiden's crown will soon appear—
And rest upon one among you.
Round Hat. Thank you.
Odd… but, thank you.
The final performance. Begins now.
Go. The front. Closer… clear… reassured.

Show time. Need light.

Light. Lamp.
The frequencies... are in such a disarray... It will be hard to switch between worlds now...

No worries. We'll try again.

You must be Annis.

You want me to find her, right?
We'd better watch ourselves! They might have tricks up their sleeves we can't even imagine!
How dare she show up in the town after everything they did!
Will the lost souls truly return home?
So... painful...
Ergh...
All those years of lying and scheming, and what have you gained?
A tarnished reputation? You could have walked away from this, Cantarella.
I still remember the little you. The youngest, the most neglected of all the Fisalias. You always lingered by your cauldron, and only smiled when a bird fluttered past the window.
You despise this place, don't you? But the blood in your veins... it binds you, holds you prisoner in this endless nightmare.
You loathe our rules, yet they have already seeped into your very existence.
Tell me, have you ever considered leaving? Let go of this burden that crushes you, and you'll be free as air, free to live the life you've longed for.
My dear lord, I've already gifted you the sweetest of dreams. But why do you still cling to this earthly burden?
You watched with satisfaction as I climbed over the fallen, ascended the steps to glory, and wore the thorned crown... Was that not enough for you?
Illusions are no match for poison, Cantarella. False bubbles burst, and here we are—the end of it all.
Well, you see, illusions can also lead to true beauty.
Your obsession, corrupted by whispers, has become a shadow over the castle… A deluge of delusions that shouldn't exist in this world.
I can feel the pain those whispers inflicted upon you. Allow me to free you from them... once more!
The abyss may reside in shadows, but even the deepest darkness cannot endure the touch of light.
Your trust strengthens the lamp. It now burns brighter.
Now is the time. Let the light shine brighter.
Now! Free him from the Threnodian's whispers.
We haven't fully banished the whispers. Watch out. The twisted obsession is returning to the shadow.
My lord, I offered you the sweetest of dreams and safeguarded your legacy when you departed.
I have entrusted Fisalia's true faith to one most deserving, and the Threnodian's deceptions in the Inverted Tower have been laid bare.
No more whispers shall haunt us. Our children are freed from the cruel burdens of those trials.
Now, you too shall find release from the Threnodian's whispers.
They aren't ghosts, are they?
So, this is the answer?
Heh, nothing escapes your eyes, does it?
We're here, alive and well!
In that hellish duel, Cantarella shielded us with illusions.
Once Cantarella took charge of the family, she shielded us, keeping us safe in the castle's depths.
The Order's members were always prying, eager to find out the truth... I knew if we went out recklessly, we'd only invite danger.
Though... I really miss my home, more than I can say.
Fortunately, Cantarella holds the Night of Remembrance every year. With our masks, we can slip away, even just for a while, back to our village.
It's always a great comfort to see Jojo living happily and in good health.
My dear, from this night forward, you're free to be with your families.
The {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} here has solved the riddles. Together, {Male=he;Female=she} and I will craft the elixir of revival.
Wait, what's going on?
I think I'm getting the picture now.
Since the Threnodian's lies were unraveled, the frequencies and situations on the outside have shifted.
Thanks to you, the Order is now entangled in its own troubles, too distracted to reach into the Fisalias.

Most deeply affected by the Threnodian's whispers was the castle—where the former head was trapped, where innocent girls were lost to the trials... As the Threnodian fell, all these frequencies broke out at once.
The long-standing fear, pain, resentment, and repression—all that the whispers had suppressed burst free, becoming a new cage.
The shackles of one's spirit were heavier than those from the outside. Yet, thanks to you, we shattered those shackles together.
I knew then... the time had come for the girls to finally go home.
I never meant to draw you into this. I was planning to shoulder it all alone. That's why for this year's Night of Remembrance I took part myself, and as host, I chose "ghost girls" as the theme.
My plan was to break through the Sea of Ghosts, claim that I've solved the riddles and won the elixir of revival, and then use it to send the girls home when the Dance of the Dead begins at midnight.
What about the letter I received?
What about the influence on me?
Your arrival, seemingly by chance, was perhaps destined.
The letter wasn't my doing, but I think I know who brought you to my side.
She had no intention of hurting you with the abnormal frequencies, but she had been in the twisted Sonoro for too long... long enough that she was nearly one with its frequencies.

When I saw that letter and sensed something unusual about you, I realized you could no longer stay out of this matter. With a special constitution, you were affected by the frequencies overflowing from the Sea of Ghosts.
Looking back, my arrogance blinded me... Ah, forgive me, for showing you this weak side of myself.
The currents here run deep, and the tangled seaweed is thick. Even I can easily become ensnared.
But you… you helped me untangle these knots and weathered the torrents by my side.
Thanks to you, the elixir was much easier to make. That's why I said, a skilled brewer is far more important than the ingredients or the process.
Please, accept my heartfelt gratitude. Thank you for being here, and for staying by my side.
Cantarella, you don't have to bear it all alone anymore! You've got someone you can truly count on now.
Hehe, you're right. I have one last favor to ask, {PlayerName}. Could you take the elixir and see the girls home on my behalf?
The Fisalia doesn't enjoy a good reputation, and some villagers would resist my presence. At this point, causing any complication is the last thing I want.
You, however, as the Laureate who exposed the lies and turned the impossible into the possible, will carry a weight they can't ignore. If you're the one to handle this, the people will be convinced.
Besides, even if the Order intends to look into this "miraculous revival" later, your status and capabilities will hold them back.
But putting all that aside, it's with your effort that this elixir was possible. I can think of no one more fitting for this task.
I'll help until all is settled.
Don't you want to clear your name?
Thank you. Both I, and the entire Fisalia family, will aid you in any way we can.
Names are like sea foam that easily fades away. It hardly matters to me. Besides, it may not be a bad thing for people to stay wary of the Fisalias.
After all, we're a large family, with deep-rooted issues. Change takes time.
Girls, gather your things. It's time to go home.
Is this still Porto-Veno Castle? Something feels… off.
Yes and no. The past has spilled into the present here.
The overflowing frequencies have enveloped the entire castle, forming this Sonoro, the Sea of Ghosts.
The voices of the ghosts rise faintly from the depths, like the soft pop of a bursting bubble. Listen closely to these whispers of the past.
Piece together these fragile clues, and the answers will emerge on their own.
But do take caution. One wrong step in these murky depths, and we may be drawn into an endless abyss…
With a bit of light, though, we can hold back the darkness.
Though the black of the sea is overwhelming, I've managed to preserve the last ray of light.
You see, light is something that darkness can never fully devour.
As long as it flickers, it can guide us out.
I, Cantarella Fisalia, hereby grant {PlayerName} unrestricted passage through Porto-Veno Castle.
Let us explore and weave through the past and future together.
We are now in a fragment of the "past"… You've done well.
The past that emerges from the Sea of Ghosts is not entirely real.
It only reveals what it chooses to show, which means we must uncover the hidden truth ourselves.
Spirits bound in the cracks of time, wander no more.
Please, set them free with the light.
They've been trapped here for far too long.
A few written lines appeared on the surface, seemingly the last message left before the frequencies dispersed.
It seems this little lamp has something to say. You may go ahead and touch it.
See how it glows? It's time to use its power.
Perhaps we need to switch to the right time.
The dark sea is where treasures often hide.
It's like how precious memories drift in the cracks of time.
You may use your lamp to locate them.
A pearl that shimmers but is out of reach is not necessarily an illusion.
Let the lamp work its magic… for light can travel through time.
In the depths of darkness, forgotten treasures await.
Light holds the power to reveal their resting place.
Be careful.
They've lingered here too long, tormented by agony and anger.
We will set you free.
Off you go, trapped little fish.
Born of water, returned to water.
It's getting turbulent.
The fluctuations you create can bring a brief calm to these restless frequencies.
In other words, when you swiftly dodge their attacks or block with your weapon, the ghosts lurking in the cracks will be momentarily exposed before you.
This book looks familiar.
Just put it back on the right shelf, like how you did before.
Well done. You never disappoint me.
They say most questions can be answered in books, but can they really?
The Divine Trials stand as a hallowed tradition of the Fisalia family, a ritual that demands every family member to offer their daughters to face the ordeal.
Yet tales of these perils have driven some to seek out young girls resembling their own and use them as substitutes.
These girls' parents are often offered a generous sum of money or sweet promises as compensation.
Behind this intricate web stands the late head of Fisalia. To him, the Fisalia daughters who had been replaced were nothing more than "useless stones."
The substitutes, however, he considered "rough gems" that could be polished into dazzling jewels through suffering.
For him, regardless of blood, the Maiden must be a Fisalia. To this end, no sacrifice was too great.
There are many footprints of varying sizes in the hall, all seem to belong to women, but only one is clear enough. Cantarella's footprints are among them.
To avoid the watchful eyes, the girls formed secret pacts in whispers.
"Hum a special tune," "use the right color," "knock on the door three times every two seconds"…
In the cold, unfathomable sea, they clung to each other, seeking warmth and comfort.
The little fish huddled close, unaware of who might vanish, or what tomorrow would bring.
The Fisalia family is built on poison, and from a young age, every Fisalia child is introduced to it.
Years of exposure gradually built up our resistance. At first, we suffered, but over time, few poisons could harm us.
We are no longer merely the bearers of poison. We become the poison itself.
So... painful...
Ergh...
Sweet dreams, girls. May you rest in peace.
The answer remains submerged, yet from the ripples of the past, a familiar door rises.
Maybe try knocking three times, as the girls once did. Knock, knock, knock...
Hmm… It seems safe here. We can catch our breath amid the surging undercurrents.
Even in the depths of the sea, there would be a place for resting, like the eye of a storm.
Perhaps we should take a moment to explore this room. It seems like an ideal setting to gather our thoughts or simply rest.
Young girls are always brimming with dreams.
Though their bodies are caged, their hearts take flight, winging freely through realms of imagination.
They recorded these ideas on paper, each word melting into a sweet candy to soothe their sorrows.
I still remember there was a bookshelf that kept many such pure, sweet fantasies.
Though time has yellowed these pages, the girls' laughter and joy still dance vividly across each line.
But it remains trapped on paper, lost to time.
These girls...
Chloe...
What exactly happened...
Every girl came from different backgrounds, each with their own unique personality yet the same determination.
Even as poison gnawed at their bodies, they never lost faith in a future where freedom might bloom.
Little Chloe… I hope she's found peace somewhere, where no pain can reach her anymore.
Forgive me that I can't tell you more while we remain trapped within the depths. Once we've explored the whole of this sea, the truth will rise to the surface.
An aged diary rests before you, its pages filled with notes the girls once exchanged.
The cute symbols, paired with messy handwriting, pull you back to those memories of long lost past—ones too painful to dwell on.
The Sea Apples' crimson hue is so vivid that it almost burns the eyes.
The jellyfish drift gracefully, their translucent forms gliding through the water. A Jellyrose Medusa sways its delicate tentacles, its rounded body resembling an elegant hat.
It gestures behind you, and as you turn, an unexpected door stands in the center of the room.
Before opening the door, have you ever imagined a scene where seawater rushes out, flooding everything before you…
But for now, I don't think that will happen. We haven't quite reached the deep waters yet.
Should we go now and see what the jellyfish are trying to say?
Let's go.
I'd like to stay here a bit longer.
Lovely. Don't forget to knock three times.
Take your time. This place feels like a gentle embrace, one that makes you reluctant to leave.
Darkness breeds the unknown, and the unknown gives birth to fear.
In a place like this, the only anchor you can rely on is the faint light by your side.
Trust its guidance. It will clear a path through the shadows and quell your fears.
But can the glimmers from these delicate drifters truly light up the entire sea?
In this spacious room, it's just you and Cantarella. Her gaze lingers on you, dark and endless, like a bottomless abyss.
It seems like fate insists we move as one, side by side.
In the realm of poison, none can rival the Jellyrose Medusa.
Ah... a scent I know well. There's a Jellyrose Medusa, lying in wait just a little deeper.
They tend to be wary when alone, their nerves quick to tingle at the slightest move.
But worry not. I know what to do.
The jellyfish drifts on the other side of the room, its movements slow and unhurried, as if the bookshelf's cover lends it courage.
Ah, I know this bookshelf well.
Today, it seems ambitious. Hungry enough to devour two books at once.
One titled Past, the other, Present.
Are we prisoners to the insatiable appetite for knowledge, or to the ever-expanding void?
Yet I trust your eyes. They'll see through the tricks hidden within.

Many books seem to have been leafed through, their pages adorned with sketches and annotations in diverse handwriting styles.
Judging by the fresh ink, these touches were added not long ago.
An empty shell... the remnants that Past has left behind.
Just one more to go—the shadow cast by Present.
This one isn't picky. It's a mere accident born from the twists of time.
Offer it any book, and it may reward your courage.
Now, both Past and Present are ours.
Go ahead, knock upon the door where Future lies waiting.
Ah, frightened away... our lethal yet delicate little friend.
Looks like we need to handle these two first.
A gentle glimmer lingers where the jellyfish once was, as though it is trying to tell you something.
Hebenon... She was such a timid girl, like a frightened rabbit.
She'd peek out from behind Mandragora, her little face half-hidden.
She cried so often... I still remember the day she brought me tea laced with mercury. Her hands trembled so much, tears spilling into the cup as she tried to serve it.
Look. There it is, just a step away.
Heh, it seems everyone desires the deadliest jellyfish.
Expired obsessions rarely know when to stop.
All roads lead to our destination. Let's explore another way, shall we?
These walls can't withstand the erosion of water.
Let's return to the embrace of the underwater realm.
Mandragora, just like her name, was a bright yet lethal flower.
Oh, please don't misunderstand. "Lethal" is the highest praise for a Fisalia.
She clung to every teaching of the head of our family, shaping herself so meticulously that her thoughts and her very self vanished, lost to the family's cold framework.
I saw the weight of what she gave for that trial, all for a cause that was barely worthy of her sacrifice.
So, when she served me the scone dipped in the essence of Jellyrose, I didn't hesitate to swallow it all.
She was much tougher than Hebenon, but still, behind her unwavering gaze, I caught a flicker of reluctance, a shadow of something almost tender.
As for the poison, the sensation was... I felt like I was drowning in slow waves, my body twitching without control and my vision slipping into a soft blur...
And somewhere, within that haze, I saw us transformed. Birds, perhaps, dancing on a sunlit shore, carefree and joyful.
But then, I woke up... There was no sunlit shore around, and I lay here, as ever, in this cold abyss.
Leave, restless obsessions.
There's nothing left here that deserves your grasp.
Leave this boundless abyss.
Seems like this little one is ready for a "duel," trying to take your life with its venom. But I despise unnecessary fights... Hand it to me.
Yes, just place it gently here.
No, I can't...
You've already endured this before.
Nothing fret about, dear. I've long since made my peace with poison.
This jellyfish, a remnant of the past, can't harm me now.
You have such a kind heart, {PlayerName}… Always ready to take on burdens, even while carrying your own.
But some weights belong only to those who've already weathered their storms. So, let me bear this one.
See? I'm fine.
Come now. We've more to uncover.
Jellyfish have no voice. They simply drift in the tide, struggling to let their faint glow disperse the darkness.
Yet here it is, a small shimmer of light, escaping the grip of the past to reach us now.
Ah, it seems a subtle shift has taken place... I can smell danger...
Let's look closely and see what new presence lingers here.
The waves came crashing, eager to snuff out every spark they found.
Poison and whispers slithered in, seeking to clip every wing.
Sweet dreams were shelved away, locked tight… only to wither into silent, brittle tears.
You sense an ominous presence emanating from the bookshelf.
The next moment, it takes shape before you.
The girls' despair seeps from the book's pages, winding around your heart.
You press the book shut, your chest tight, and draw a deep breath to steady yourself.
About Hebenon…
And Mandragora…
Are you all right?
Hebenon was fragile, an easy prey to the Threnodian's whispers.
She was never suited to be the Maiden. Truthfully, being chosen would never be an honor.
So, it was a good thing she wasn't chosen. Both she and Mandragora vanished during the trial, and no one knew their whereabouts.
As if someone had quietly guided them out of sight, right under the head's nose.
Ah, Mandragora. She was so… rigid, so willing to bend to the rules, even if they were impossible.
I wish she could have seen that in this world, there's more than rigid obedience. Many things are far more precious.
Both she and Hebenon vanished during the trial, and no one knew their whereabouts.
As if someone had quietly guided them out of sight, right under the head's nose.
Why? I stand perfectly well right before you.
Tears wouldn't grant me mercy, and I never intended to blindly follow rules that were never meant to be kind.
I earned my place my own way. That's why I stand here now, able to share this with you.
An old diary, with exchanged notes between young girls.
The tiny, endearing symbols and untidy scrawls pull you into the memories of that harsh, unforgiving trial again.
Sea Apples flourish in wild clusters. Under the shimmering water, their red hues look almost freakingly bright.
The Jellyrose Medusa drifts lazily nearby, its long tentacles weaving strands of both fortune and misfortune.
A doll wearing a red hat has appeared on the table out of nowhere, drawing your attention.
You recall someone saying it is a symbol of fortune.
"As long as you follow the Divinity, luck will surely be on your side!"
But... is it really so?
You are lost in thought as a door silently appears behind you.
There's a weight to the air behind. A mixture of whispers from the deep, dried tears, and the stale, lingering scent of blood.
Behind this is the deep water zone.
Are you ready to face the relentless surges? The place ahead is beyond the reach of light, like the night sky devoid of stars, hungry to consume everything within.
Let's go.
I'd like to stay here a little longer.
It will be dark and murky there. Please, stay close to me.
Hmm, we do need to be well-prepared before diving into the depths... both in body and mind.
The doll's lifeless face stares at you as a prickling unease crawls up your spine.
Final performance. Begins soon. Hat, unfit.
Help me. Bring the Round Hat.
What final performance?
You're talking about Round Hat's final perforrmance...
Alright then.
Okie. Dokie.
The doll remains still, offering no response.
The doll hesitates for a moment, then lowers its head, remaining silent.
The doll stands still, responding to your generosity with silence.
The doll stands still, responding to your teasing with silence.
Hm...
Are you okay?
You're affected by that jellyfish, aren't you?
No, it's… merely some old memories resurfacing. Don't worry. I'm quite well.
When I entered this place, I knew that certain memories would seek me out, even if I did not wish for them to.
Seems I'm not as resilient as I thought…
Here, the past and future, dreams and reality, are intricately intertwined, inseparably bound.
The chaotic frequencies here might have trapped the light.
Let's try once more, gently. Patience and encouragement always help.

The world inside the mirror seems no different from reality, yet it is only a projection of memories, past, and desires. As Carlotta explores her surroundings and interacts with the family members, she realizes the hand that dragged her into this world belongs to her mirror self. To escape, she needs to find her mirror self.

Carlotta demands that her mirror self reveal the way out. However, this reflection, sharing the same memories, past, and desires, exposes Carlotta's complex emotions—her fear of abandonment, gratitude for her family's protection, and relentless drive to live as their blade, bringing honor to the Montelli name.
Why, then, does she reject the perfect life offered in the mirror?
Frustrated, the mirror self recreates the "stormy night," forcing Carlotta to prove her worth and make up for regrets once more.

During an attack by Fisalia, Padrino is gravely injured. As senior members like Capollo gather to devise a plan, for the first time, they turn to Carlotta for advice. She seizes the moment to voice what she couldn't on that fateful day, "hit Fisalia's base."
Carlotta proposes evacuating the exposed headquarters while launching an offensive against Fisalia's key locations, volunteering to stay behind and cover the retreat.

Reality is completely different—no one listened to Carlotta's opinions that day. The family's wrong decision led to the tragic fall of the headquarters. Duncan lost his last family member, and Padrino was left to hold the family together despite his injuries.
Now, Carlotta's mirror self reveals the harsh truth: she has never been trusted to lead. 
Tempted by an illusory perfect future, Carlotta steels herself against the deception, resolved to stop Capollo.
Her defiance enrages the mirror self, who then traps her in an endless labyrinth.

As Carlotta's mirror self begins to fade, she desperately questions the real Carlotta about what makes them different. 
Carlotta, however, silently walks past her and joins your side, beginning to share the beginning of her story with you.

Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present you the bountiful campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your exploration record at the Lollo courier truck to get various rewards! 

[Eligibility] 

Reach Union Level 14. 

[Event Rules] 

During the event, you can complete event objectives once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs. 

Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package. Adventure Packages contain special mechanics that, when triggered, unlock a large amount of rewards. 

There are 3 Inventories for the Adventure Packages. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
Beyond the Waves

You find yourself stumbling into Brant and Battier's bet. Just as they get into a heated debate, you manage to catch the winning King Fish.
Now, you've become the Captain of the Day for the troupe.

While having dinner, Battier hands you half of a lucky coin.
Brant recognizes that it belongs to the legendary adventurer, Captain Drake, which may lead to treasures beyond imagination.
A troupe member, Hymer, shares information on the other half's whereabouts. You and Brant set off on its search.

You come across Bella and inquire her about the coin.
The noblewoman with an odd obsession with good luck charms grudgingly reveals a sad truth: The coin has been stolen. Brant, known for being theatrical, applies his way of responding to the circumstances. Through his unique approach, he attracts everyone's attention and shares the story of the lucky coin!
Time to join in that act with Brant and dig out that lucky person.

You make quick work of the thief and pin him down. According to your lucky gentleman, the coin was taken by a pirate named Aldric.
You also learn that this pirate is planning something big at Egla Town at midnight tonight.
That doesn't sound good! Better find out what he's up to quickly, Captain!

You and Brant find yourselves bumping into a grand gathering right in the middle of Egla Town.
As much as you'd love to stoke some fires, it's best to keep a low profile and avoid alerting the pirates.
But worry not, Brant has come up with a wonderful plan as he puts something on you, and just like that, you've transformed into the superstars of tonight's Plushie Gathering, Cuddle Wuddle and Lottie Lost!
Look out, Aldric, a surprise is coming your way.

Having lost the coin to you, Aldric makes a break for it amidst the chaos.
You finally have the map. To the treasure!
There's a troupe Gondola docked at the passenger port. Time to give the steering some spin!
You run into Aldric's underlings, but they don't seem to be in a talking mood. All they care about is showing you what pirates are made of.
After finding out that Brant is the Flaming Returned, the pirates immediately surrender.

The pirates reveal Aldric's next destination to you.
Time to pay him a visit.

Aldric suggests a truce and a partnership, where he'll hand you the key under a 60/40 split in your favor once the treasure is found.
You agree to this partnership while also keeping a close eye on him. You're well prepared by the time he goes back on his words and makes his move.

You reach the treasure's location and meet Aldric once again.
Aldric plays his old trick, trying to fool you into doing all the hard work of getting the treasure.
Just as Brant uses the coin to obtain the nautical chart, Aldric snatches the chest, declaring he wants all the treasure for himself. Sure, he's free to claim the treasure for himself, but such freedom always comes with a price.
After finally making it back to the gondola, Brant shares with you stories of the past, the present, and the nautical chart.

As the adventure comes to an end, the troupe grants you the title of Honorary Captain.

Echo Recommendation

[Recommended Attributes]

On the Echo Selection page, use "Suggest" to open the filter. This allows you to check the most commonly used Mainstats and Substats for the current Resonator and quickly filter out suitable Echoes.

While switching between "All," "COST 1," "COST 3," and "COST 4" Echoes on the Echo List on the left, the recommended attributes will adjust accordingly.

[Recommended Sonata Effects]

On the Resonator - Echo page, use "Suggest" to check the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator.

Use "Auto Equip" to equip all Echoes that best match the selected Sonata Effect.

On the Sonata Selection and Sonata Gallery pages, the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator will be marked with a thumb-up icon.


[Data Updates]

The recommendations are based on data collected from recently active players and refresh every Wednesday at 00:00 (server time). Actual refresh may experience some delay.

If there is not enough data, default recommendations generated by the system will be displayed instead.
Echo Presets

Echo Presets allow you to easily save and apply customized Echo lineups for your Resonator.

[Saving Presets]

Select the "Current Setup" column and use "Save As Preset" to save the equipped Echo lineup for the Resonator.

Each preset can be named to your liking. Please ensure the names follow local laws and regulations.

You can save up to 20 Echo Presets. If you reach the limit, you will need to delete an existing preset to create a new one.

[Applying Presets]

Select any saved preset and use "Apply" to equip the preset to the current Resonator.

Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid Update]
Current Dreamscape Aid Resonators: Phoebe, Jinhsi, Shorekeeper, Verina. Use at least one Dreamscape Aid Resonator to gain a 150% Illusive Points Bonus!

Current Dreamscape Aid Effects:
- All Resonators in the team gain 30% Spectro DMG Bonus.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack grants 20 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second. Casting Resonance Skill grants 50 Dreamscape Energy, and healing a Resonator with Resonance Skill grants another 50 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Damaging a target affected by Spectro Frazzle grants 30 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second.
- Enter Lucid Dream when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500. In this mode, certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively, and the cooldown of their Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%.  Lucid Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators from the Resonator pool and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm. The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Lucid Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

A meticulously preserved Ammonoid fossil. Little Brant once stood atop a table, proudly declaring to his father that he had found a treasure hidden among the books. His father took off his glasses for a closer look, recognizing it as the Ammonoid fossil tucked away at the bottom of the bookshelf. Seizing the moment, his father recounted an adventure about unearthing the past and seeking the truth.

That Ammonoid became Brant's first treasure and marked the beginning of his journey into a world of endless adventure.

A sculpture of stacked masks, each crafted for a different play and occasion.

On stage, he is the star, the center of all eyes. With each mask, he breathes life into the tale, captivating the audience with joy and wonder. But offstage, there is no need to conceal his true self.

In that moment, he is, at last, simply Brant.

A tricorn hat, embroidered with the emblem of the Troupe of Fools.

Brant still remembers the first performance he witnessed aboard the Fool's Sail. The captain, undeterred by the crashing waves, led his crew through the Stygian Fjords and placed a tricorn atop the head of the eager young boy. The captain, with a playful wink, called him, "Captain Brant."

Years later, Brant also remembers his own first performance. Standing high on the mast, he shouted commands to raise the sails and steer the ship clear of deadly whirlpools that threatened to swallow them whole. At that moment, one of the crew reverently placed the very same tricorn upon his head. Cheers erupted as the entire crew shouted in unison, "Captain Brant! Captain Brant!"

A locket Phoebe carries with her, repurposed from an old pocket watch. Inside is a family portrait. 

It was lost to the depths of the sea during a shipwreck, but thanks to the tireless search of her kind friends, it was eventually returned to her.

"In the fleeting waves of time... in the beautiful spray of the sea, and in the light, there are words I want to tell you, over and over again."

A handcrafted souvenir from a land across the sea was the only item Phoebe kept when her family's possessions were sold off.

In the bedtime stories she once believed would never end, there was a bird with blue wings, the envoy of the Divinity. It had the power to cross through storms and bring happiness to the little girl who endured loneliness each night as she drifted to sleep.

An old, faded edition of the Codex of the Deep, handbound by a loving and devout mother. A proper, dutiful Acolyte should be well-versed in the contents of the Codex, holding the Sentinel's guidance close to heart. Phoebe always adhered to the teachings in her heart, though, if truth be told, she preferred the color of the sky to that of the sea. "The Codex says that suffering brings us closer to the Divinity. But I still hope for a peaceful and happy life for you, my child."
